jobs.title: AWS BDR
jobs.description: Aligned TG empowers organizations to harness the full potential of AWS cloud technologies, driving secure, scalable, and sustainable business outcomes. We approach every challenge with grit, embracing a results\-driven mindset to ensure our clients achieve their goals. Our mission is to deliver unparalleled cloud advisory, engineering, financial management, and security services while continuously learning and innovating to stay ahead of industry advancements. Guided by a culture of collaboration and humility—where being “Team AWSome” means leaving egos at the door—we tailor our services to meet the unique needs of technology\-enabled startups, mid\-market, and enterprise clients. With a focus on execution, agility, and excellence, we are the trusted partner businesses rely on to navigate the complexities of cloud modernization and achieve their strategic objectives. We are seeking a persistent and curious Business Development Representative to build the top of Aligned TG’s sales funnel. This role owns outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification—identifying organizations with cloud initiatives worth a conversation, earning the first meeting, and handing a qualified opportunity to an Account Executive. Two things define this role. The first is disciplined activity: a consistent daily volume of calls, emails, and social outreach across a defined target account list, sustained whether or not the week is going well. The second is qualification judgment: knowing enough about cloud migration, cost, security, and managed services to tell a real opportunity from a polite conversation, and disqualifying early rather than passing a weak meeting to an Account Executive. A significant share of Aligned TG’s pipeline moves through the AWS partner ecosystem. You will work leads sourced through AWS account teams, partner funding programs, distribution, AWS Marketplace, and joint marketing activity—including the SMB prospecting that our Small Business Acceleration Initiative agreement with AWS commits us to. You are not expected to own the partner relationship; you are expected to work the pipeline it generates with the same rigor as your own outbound. This is a quota\-carrying role measured on activity, qualified meetings set, opportunities accepted by Account Executives, and pipeline sourced—not on closed revenue. You are not expected to scope, price, or architect a solution. Your job is to earn the meeting, capture what you learned, and set the Account Executive up to win it. You do not need to be an engineer or come from a cloud background. You do need to be resilient in the face of rejection, coachable enough to change what you are doing when it is not working, organized enough to keep a CRM accurate without being asked, and willing to learn the technology well enough to be credible with a technical buyer. This role reports into the Sales organization and works in close partnership with Marketing, Solutions Architecture, and our AWS partner team. **Key Responsibilities:** * Own outbound prospecting into an assigned territory or target account list, generating qualified meetings for Account Executives through a consistent, sustained daily activity level. * Execute multi\-channel outreach across phone, email, LinkedIn, and events, working sequences to completion rather than abandoning accounts after a single attempt. * Research accounts before outreach—cloud footprint, technology stack, funding events, hiring signals, compliance drivers, leadership changes—so every touch has a specific reason behind it. * Qualify inbound leads from the website, marketing campaigns, webinars, AWS Marketplace, and events within a defined response window, and disposition every one. * Run first\-call discovery covering current environment, business drivers, timeline, decision process, and budget authority—enough to judge fit without crossing into solution design or pricing. * Hand off qualified opportunities to Account Executives with a written brief covering context, pain, stakeholders, and agreed next step, and confirm the meeting holds. * Prospect actively into the SMB segment in support of Aligned TG’s AWS Small Business Acceleration Initiative commitments, alongside mid\-market and enterprise outbound. * Partner with AWS account teams and our Partner Development Manager to identify co\-sell targets, follow up on partner\-sourced leads, and support opportunity registration through AWS ACE. * Drive follow\-up on joint marketing activity—webinars, immersion days, workshops, and field events—converting attendance and engagement into booked meetings. * Re\-engage dormant pipeline, closed\-lost opportunities, and lapsed clients on a recurring cycle rather than working only net\-new names. * Maintain accurate, current CRM records covering contacts, activity, sequence status, disposition, and opportunity handoffs, with no reliance on reminders to stay clean. * Report weekly on activity, conversion rates, meetings set, and pipeline sourc cosystem Access:** Work directly alongside AWS field teams and gain visibility into how the partner ecosystem actually sells. * **Coaching:** Direct, frequent feedback on real calls from people invested in you getting better, not in you being comfortable. * **Team Culture:** Join a “Team AWSome” culture built on humility, continuous learning, and collaborative problem\-solving. **Qualifications:** **Required Experience** * 1\+ years in outbound sales development, inside sales, or lead generation—or a demonstrated record of high\-activity, target\-driven work in another field with a clear reason for moving into technology sales. * Direct experience with cold outreach by phone and email, and a realistic understanding of the rejection volume the role carries. * Track record of meeting or exceeding activity and meeting\-set targets on a consistent basis. * Experience researching accounts and personalizing outreach rather than relying on volume alone. * Experience working in a CRM every day and keeping records accurate without supervision. * Exposure to a B2B sales cycle involving multiple stakeholders, including at least one technical or security buyer. **Technical Requirements** * AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner required within 90 days of employment, consistent with Aligned TG’s company\-wide certification standard. * Working knowledge of cloud concepts—migration, cost optimization, security posture, managed services—sufficient to hold a credible business\-level conversation with an IT or security leader, or demonstrated ability to learn them quickly. * Familiarity with sales engagement and prospecting tooling (HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar). * Ability to write a short, specific, credible prospecting email without leaning on a template to carry it. * Solid spreadsheet and list\-building proficiency for territory research and target account development. * Comfort working in project management and reporting platforms (ClickUp or similar) alongside the CRM. **Leadership \& Business Skills** * Excellent verbal communication—able to earn the first thirty seconds of a cold call and turn it into a conversation. * Concise, specific written communication that respects the reader’s time. * Commercial judgment to separate a real opportunity from a courteous conversation, and the discipline to disqualify early. * Coachability—able to take direct feedback on recorded calls and change behavior immediately. * Collaborative mindset with proven ability to partner with Account Executives, Marketing, and vendor field teams. * Organized and self\-directed, capable of managing a territory without daily direction. **Professional Attributes** * Persistent and resilient; treats a no as information rather than a verdict. * Competitive and target\-driven, with genuine ownership of the number. * Disciplined about daily activity when no one is watching. * Genuinely curious about clients’ businesses and about the technology behind them. * Confident yet humble, embodying the “Team AWSome” spirit of collaboration and respect. * Comfortable with ambiguity and energized by building process rather than inheriting one. * Proactive learner who stays current with AWS services, programs, and partner model changes. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience prospecting into mid\-market or enterprise IT, infrastructure, and security leadership (CIO, CTO, VP Infrastructure, CISO). * Experience in a cloud, MSP, VAR, or technology services organization. * Familiarity with AWS partner programs and funding mechanisms (MAP, POA, MDF, SBAI) and the AWS co\-sell motion. * Experience selling alongside a vendor or OEM field team. * Exposure to regulated industries such as healthcare, financial services, or public sector. * Experience generating pipeline from events, webinars, or field marketing programs. * Additional AWS certifications or FinOps credentials. * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager Program
jobs.description: **About Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology:** Technology is at the heart of Disney’s past, present, and future.Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product \& Technology is a global organization of engineers, product developers, designers, technologists, data scientists, and more – all working to build and advance the technological backbone for Disney’s media business around the world. We marry technology with creativity to build world\-class products, enhance storytelling, and drive innovation, scalability, and velocity across our portfolio. We are **Storytellers and Innovators. Creators and Builders. Entertainers and Engineers.** Our teams collaborate across The Walt Disney Company’s media brands and platforms —Disney\+, Hulu, ESPN, ABC, ABC News, Nat Geo, Marvel, and Star Wars—to deliver exceptional consumer experiences to millions around the globe and technical platforms and systems that drive Disney’s business. **Why You’ll Love Working Here:** * **Building the Future of Media**: Our technologists are designing and building the platforms that will power Disney’s media, advertising, and distribution businesses for years to come. * **Reach, Scale \& Impact**: Disney’s technology and products serve as the signature doorway for fans to connect with our brands and stories. These platforms carry unmatched content that matters to millions globally. * **Innovation**: We design, develop and implement groundbreaking products and platforms that shape industry norms and solve complex, distinctive technical challenges. This opportunity is part of a structured development journey that blends hands\-on experience, mentorship, and leadership growth across Disney’s world\-class product and technology teams. **About the Associate Product Manager (APM) Program** * Full\-time new hires for this role will start as a cohort in Summer 2027\. * This is a two\-year career accelerator program designed to foster the next generation of leading product management talent. * Team rotations occur at the 12\-month mark, ensuring exposure to multiple teams and product domains. **As part of the program, you will:** * Gain hands\-on experience building and launching products used by hundreds of millions of people. * Receive structured training on product management fundamentals and mentorship from Disney Product leaders. * Use data and user insights to understand business problems and help drive strategic decisions. * Participate in learning opportunities focused on strategic problem\-solving, leadership development and networking. **Job Summary:** As a **Product Manager I** **(APM)**, you will assist in the development and execution of product strategies to meet business objectives. You’ll collaborate with cross\-functional teams, conduct market research, and support the product lifecycle from discovery to launch. As part of this development program, the role offers the opportunity to learn from an experienced product team and contribute to innovative projects for The Walt Disney Company. **Responsibilities:** * Collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers to develop features for an assigned product domain. * Learn to develop and communicate a strategic vision for engaging our fans, aligning with broader company goals and market trends. * Write detailed product requirements, user stories, and documentation to drive development of features. * Work with leadership to craft product strategy, Objectives \& Key Results (OKRs), and roadmap. * Support product research by analyzing competitor offerings. * Contribute to strategy documents and presentations. * Conduct basic data analysis to inform product decisions (e.g., usage metrics, user behavior). * Support feature launches and internal communications. **Basic Qualifications:** * Strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to use data\-driven insights to inform decisions and measure performance. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills. * Experience through coursework, projects, or internships in product management or related technical domains such as engineering, software development and user experience. * Ability to recognize what makes a product valuable to the user and drive improvements to meet business goals. * Interest in product development, user experience, and technology. * Capacity to learn quickly and adapt to changing priorities in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment. * Collaborative mindset with proven ability to build strong relationships across a range of functions and work effectively in team\-oriented environments. **Required Education:** * Upcoming or recent graduate with a Bachelor’s degree or Master's degree in Computer Science/Engineering or related technical field **Location:** The primary location for this role is the Greater LA, CA area, with additional opportunities potentially available in New York, NY. Final location and team placement will be determined at the time of offer based on business needs and team alignment. Candidates should be open and receptive to opportunities across all locations listed in this job posting. The hiring range for this position in Los Angeles, CA is $$97,500\.00 \- $130,700\.00 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: Digital Systems Engineer II
jobs.description: The Digital Systems Engineer II at Kform will design, develop, configure, and integrate connected hardware and software architectures across Kform products and engineering systems. This role combines ownership of physical information technology, networking, Internet of Things (IoT), and edge\-computing architectures with full\-stack software and artificial intelligence development. The engineer will independently design and configure network switches, edge computing systems, gateways, sensors, servers, and related infrastructure while developing production software using Python, Rust, and modern web technologies. The Digital Systems Engineer II is expected to understand and take ownership of complete digital systems from the physical device and network layer through compute infrastructure, applications, data, and AI services. The engineer will make technical decisions that result in reliable, secure, maintainable, and deployable systems. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design physical and logical architectures for connected products, edge\-computing systems, IoT deployments, prototype systems, manufacturing systems, and test environments. * Configure and manage network switches, routers, wireless systems, edge devices, servers, gateways, and related infrastructure. * Design network configurations including VLANs, routing, addressing, DHCP, DNS, Power over Ethernet (PoE), firewall rules, segmentation, and device connectivity. * Define how sensors, controllers, embedded systems, gateways, edge computers, servers, and applications communicate within an overall system architecture. * Develop and maintain provisioning and configuration standards for networked devices and deployed systems. * Design and develop full\-stack software using Python, Rust, JavaScript/TypeScript, and other appropriate technologies. * Develop production backend services, APIs, data\-processing systems, automation services, device interfaces, and distributed applications. * Develop and maintain frontend applications and interfaces for system configuration, monitoring, operation, and data visualization. * Design software interfaces between hardware, networks, edge\-computing platforms, databases, on\-premises or cloud infrastructure, and user\-facing applications. * Develop high\-performance, reliability\-critical, or systems\-level services in Rust where appropriate. * Use Python for application development, automation, AI development, data processing, system integration, and engineering tools. * Architect and implement AI\-enabled applications including model integration, AI agents, retrieval systems, structured data extraction, reasoning workflows, and automated engineering processes. * Develop data pipelines connecting devices and systems to databases, applications, analytics platforms, and AI services. * Design software and system architectures capable of operating across cloud, on\-premises, edge, and disconnected environments as required. * Design and maintain containerized software deployments and associated development environments. * Develop automated provisioning, deployment, configuration management, monitoring, and testing capabilities. * Lead troubleshooting of complex issues spanning networking, hardware, operating systems, containers, APIs, databases, applications, and AI services. * Conduct integration and validation testing to verify that hardware and software systems perform as designed. * Establish logging, monitoring, diagnostics, and system telemetry necessary to understand system health and troubleshoot failures. * Review technical designs and configurations developed by other engineers and provide guidance on implementation. * Create and maintain network diagrams, system architecture diagrams, interface definitions, configuration standards, deployment documentation, and software documentation. * Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, manufacturing, product, cybersecurity, software, and test teams to define and implement complete digital system architectures. * Mentor junior engineers and assist in establishing engineering practices for software development, networking, IoT, AI, and systems integration. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical field; or equivalent demonstrated technical experience. * Demonstrated professional experience designing, configuring, and troubleshooting networked systems. * Experience configuring managed Ethernet switches and network infrastructure. * Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking, VLANs, routing, switching, DHCP, DNS, firewall concepts, and network segmentation. * Strong professional software\-development experience using Python. * Experience developing backend applications, APIs, services, and data\-driven applications. * Experience working in Linux environments. * Experience with Git and  ack applications. * Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or other container and orchestration technologies. * Experience with edge\-computing architectures and disconnected or intermittently connected systems. * Experience with IoT protocols and interfaces including MQTT, serial communications, WebSockets, REST APIs, USB, Ethernet, or related technologies. * Experience with databases, data pipelines, graph databases, vector databases, or distributed data systems. * Experience integrating large language models and other AI/ML systems into production applications. * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation, embeddings, AI agents, model routing, inference infrastructure, or AI workflow orchestration. * Experience with infrastructure automation, configuration management, and automated provisioning. * Experience designing secure systems for defense, manufacturing, industrial, robotics, or other hardware\-intensive environments. * Familiarity with cybersecurity principles for networked, edge, IoT, and deployed systems. **Skills and Abilities** ------------------------ * Strong understanding of complete digital architectures spanning physical devices, networking, compute, software, data, and artificial intelligence. * Ability to translate operational and product requirements into physical and logical system architectures. * Ability to configure and troubleshoot network infrastructure without relying exclusively on dedicated IT support. * Strong software architecture and development capabilities across frontend, backend, systems, and integration software. * Ability to determine when Python, Rust, or other technologies are appropriate for a particular engineering problem. * Ability to develop reliable interfaces between physical hardware and software systems. * Strong troubleshooting skills across multiple layers of a technical system. * Ability to independently research unfamiliar hardware, protocols, software frameworks, and technologies and implement workable solutions. * Ability to create clear, reproducible technical documentation and configuration standards. * Ability to mentor less\-experienced engineers and provide technical direction on multidisciplinary engineering efforts. **Working Conditions** ---------------------- Work in a dynamic engineering and product\-development environment involving software development, network infrastructure, physical devices, prototyping, integration, and testing. Work may include development at a computer workstation as well as hands\-on installation, configuration, troubleshooting, and validation of systems in laboratories, manufacturing environments, customer environments, and field locations. Standing, walking, connecting equipment, installing hardware, and using tools may be required. Use of personal protective equipment (PPE) may be required during manufacturing, installation, and testing activities. **Other Requirements** ---------------------- * Commitment to Kform's core values, including innovation, continuous improvement, and teamwork. * Ability and willingness to operate across traditional IT, software engineering, AI, networking, and hardware\-engineering boundaries. * Willingness to continually evaluate and adopt emerging networking, IoT, software, AI, and edge\-computing technologies when they provide meaningful technical advantages. * Ability to take technical ownership of systems and drive issues to resolution across multiple engineering disciplines. * Willingness to work flexible hours as needed to meet project deadlines and support integration, deployment, and testing activities. By fulfilling these responsibilities, the Digital Systems Engineer II at Kform will provide end\-to\-end technical ownership across physical infrastructure, networking, connected devices, software, data, and artificial intelligence, enabling Kform to develop increasingly sophisticated connected products and digital systems.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Electrical Engineer** **Cincinnati, OH** **Overview** Davies Engineering Group is looking for an upcoming Electrical Engineer graduate to contribute to innovative design and analysis projects across commercial, industrial, and pharmaceutical facilities. In this role, you’ll contribute to the electrical scope to provide meaningful solutions for our clients. You’ll apply your electrical engineering expertise, code knowledge, and best practices while expanding your skills through project work and client interactions. As you grow, you’ll gain a deep understanding of Davies Engineering standards and client expectations which will empower you to deliver high\-quality results. **What You'll Do:** You will work with other engineers and design specialists as part of a project team, and team size depends on the project scope and complexity. * Visit client sites to determine existing conditions, meet with contractors and code officials * Meet with clients to determine project scope, background data, equipment preferences * Make equipment selection using manufacturers' information * Prepare designs and details using AutoCAD and/or Revit * Prepare and edit technical specifications * Prepare construction cost estimates * Investigate problems using knowledge about electrical codes and construction methods * Institute quality control procedures to ensure correct and accurate deliverables * Review design with client representatives * Perform construction administration, including answering contractor questions, and making field visits to review construction status * Perform concept development, design, and analysis for projects including: + Power distribution systems for commercial/industrial/institutional buildings including new and retrofit projects, large chillers, boilers, and pumps, motor control centers, switchgear, substations, fire pumps, emergency generators, UPSs, grounding systems + Lighting design including interior, site, high\-bay, exit and emergency lighting systems + Communications, data and miscellaneous building systems including (fire alarm, PA, intercom, telephone, data) + Building and industrial control systems **Skills \& Experience:** * Prior co\-op or internship experience at an engineering consulting firm strongly preferred * Electrical or Architectural Engineering Degree required *(ABET accredited)* – Accepting May 2027 graduates * On track to take and pass the FE exam * Software experience preferred: AutoCAD, Revit, MS Office * Strong problem\-solving skills * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills * Desire to learn and grow in career **Why Davies?** Davies Engineering Group is named after the late Gary Davies, an engineer who inspired others to dream bigger, work harder, and do what's right \- even if it's not easy. DEG represents the continued growth and evolution of our engineering team, and we show up for our people with the same mindset. With a competitive salary, a generous bonus program, and comprehensive benefits, Davies is continuing to move forward, and we'd love for you to be a part of it.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineering Intern
jobs.description: **About Stratus** Stratus® is an integrated, multi\-disciplinary engineering, architecture, interior design, and consulting firm. Consistently ranking among the Top 500 Design Firms in Engineering News\-Record, the firm offers a deep bench of industry experts through a highly collaborative approach, delivering innovative solutions across the full project lifecycle. Operating coast to coast, Stratus® serves clients nationwide while maintaining a strategic commitment to supporting high\-growth economies and building vibrant communities that foster the professional growth of its team. Serving public\- and private\-sector clients, the firm is dedicated to delivering the highest\-quality service wherever projects take shape. Across the Civic, Commercial, Industrial, Transportation, Education, Water Resources, and Government sectors, we bring precision, insight, and purpose to every project, from targeted renovations to large\-scale infrastructure. Stratus® designs spaces, systems, and solutions that perform, endure, and make an impact, delivering on our promise of Better Plans. Better Places. **Job Summary** As an Electrical Engineering Intern, you will support engineers and designers working on power, lighting, communication, and low\-voltage systems for building and infrastructure projects. You will gain hands\-on exposure to electrical design principles, technical software, industry standards, multidisciplinary coordination, and project delivery. Throughout the internship, you will contribute to active assignments while receiving guidance, feedback, and mentorship from experienced professionals. **What You’ll Do** * Assist with electrical drawings, calculations, reports, research, and other project documentation. * Support the design and coordination of power, lighting, communication, and low\-voltage systems. * Participate in project meetings, site visits, field observations, and multidisciplinary collaboration. **What You’ll Learn** * How electrical engineering principles, design tools, codes, and technical standards are applied to real projects. * How engineering drawings, calculations, and project deliverables are developed and coordinated. * How multiple disciplines collaborate throughout the design and project delivery process. **Qualifications** *Required** Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program in Electrical Engineering or a related field. * Completion of relevant engineering or technical coursework. * Basic understanding of electrical engineering principles. * Basic proficiency with AutoCAD or Revit and Microsoft Office applications. *Preferred** Internship or co\-op experience in electrical design. * Familiarity with electrical load calculation software. * Involvement in IEEE or related professional organizations. **Why you’ll love Stratus*** A team\-oriented environment that values transparency, creativity, and shared success * Meaningful career paths, leadership opportunities, and space to specialize * Learning \& Development – Education and Professional Licensing available for future full\-time team members * Defined cohort experience designed to provide you with experience, exposure and opportunities to begin a long\-term career pathway in one of the top engineering firms in the country **Equal Opportunity Statement** *Stratus is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy\-related conditions, and lactation), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. Stratus Team’s management Team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities, access to facilities and programs, and general treatment during employment.* \#LI\-MY1

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Embedded Software Engineer** **JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Design and develop embedded control software for brake, suspension, or other chassis systems * Create embedded control software requirements for vehicle systems, working closely with hardware, software and control system product development teams * Perform software testing, system testing, and/or simulation to verify software designs * Perform software unit testing and assist in the development of tests * Interface with hardware design teams and systems engineering teams to address/resolve issues * Investigate and resolve product issues found during development, validation testing, manufacturing or warranty returns * Maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of global automotive standards and industry best practices * Collaborate with BWI’s global ECU hardware, software and control system teams to align embedded software development and test strategies and concepts across multiple sites (Brighton, China, Paris, Dayton, and Krakow) * Support ISO 26262 System Safety Process * Support Automotive SPICE\-compliant software development processes * Support vehicle application and calibration development * Contribute to vehicle and functional software issue resolution **REQUIREMENT QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or related field. * Hands‑on experience developing and troubleshooting software on embedded targets. * Strong programming skills in C and/or C\+\+ for embedded systems. * Experience with embedded systems design using preemptive, multitasking real‑time operating systems (RTOS). * Familiarity with software configuration management, version control, and defect tracking tools. * Knowledge of OS concepts, IP/network protocols, and common hardware interfaces (UART, SPI, I2C, CAN, etc.) as appropriate. * Ability to read schematics and component datasheets and to understand hardware constraints. * Strong analytical, debugging, and problem‑solving skills and attention to detail. * Good communication skills and ability to work effectively within cross‑functional engineering teams. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:** * 2\+ years of embedded software development experience (more for senior roles). * Experience in one or more domains: automotive ECUs, industrial controls, IoT devices, communications, or safety‑critical systems. * Experience with unit test frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and static/dynamic analysis tools for embedded code. * Knowledge of security practices for embedded systems and over‑the‑air (OTA) update mechanisms. * Familiarity with scripting languages (for example Python) for test automation and tooling. **TRAVEL REQUIRED (%):** \>25% travel to meet customers and suppliers with day travel to the various manufacturing facilities as required. **LANGUAGE SKILLS:** Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public. **MATHEMATICAL SKILLS:** Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume. Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry. **COMPUTER SKILLS:** Ability to use and understand Windows Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and SharePoint, Microsoft (email). This is additional to the computer skill requirements as stated in the requirement qualifications. **REASONING ABILITY:** Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. Able to read and understand engineering prints/drawings. Good level of analytical skills and interpersonal skills. Ability to work on a team. Ability to guide the efforts of support personnel. Good teambuilding skills. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS:** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to walk and to sit; use hands to manipulate objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms. The employee is occasionally required to stand, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and to talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift up to 30 pounds. Specific vision abilities include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and the ability to focus. **WORK ENVIRONMENT**: The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. jobs.title: Field Engineer - TEXAS
jobs.description: **Department:** **Operations** **Reports to:** **Project Engineer** **Works closely with: Construction Manager, Superintendents, Project Engineers \& Project Manager** **Location:** **Texas \- 100% Site based with home rotations** **Who We Are** CoVolt Power is a leading utility\-scale EPC (Engineering, Procurement \& Construction) company specializing in the design and delivery of solar, battery energy storage (BESS), and high\-voltage infrastructure. Since its founding in 2005, the company has built a reputation for de\-risking project delivery and providing creative, integrated solutions that span the power and digital infrastructure sectors. Consistently ranked as a top\-tier EPC, CoVolt Power leverages a mission\-driven approach to safety and quality, delivering thousands of megawatts in renewable assets that support a more resilient and sustainable energy future for developers, utilities, independent power producers (IPPs), and data center operators across North America. **Position Summary:** The Field Engineer (FE) is an entry\-level, field\-based position responsible for the support and execution of an assigned scope for project construction, from early phases of preconstruction through final acceptance of the project by client. The position works closely with Project Engineers, Project Managers and supports Superintendents. This position will be based at one of our project sites across the United States. Candidates selected for this role will be expected to relocate to the project site for the length of the project. **Job Responsibilities:** * Assist Superintendents on all construction aspects of solar energy projects for an assigned scope, from initial notice to proceed through final acceptance by client. * Actively partner with project team to prioritize safety, quality, stewardship, leadership visibility and communication. * Constantly solve problems and resolve issues through face to face and personal communication. * Coordinate activities associated with the overall execution of a project on an assigned scope, with oversight from the assigned Superintendent. * Support project administration to ensure project is constructed in accordance with design, budget, and schedule. * Coordination of supplier and subcontractor progress on the project. * Support RFI and Submittal process for assigned scope of work. * Specific duties include, but are not limited to, contract administration, schedule management, preparation of spreadsheets \& reports, investigation of non\-conformance issues and implementation of corrective measures, risk management, safety, and quality control. **Job Requirements:** * Bachelor's degree in construction management, Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related fieldpreferred; equivalent combination of relevant construction, engineering, renewable energy will also be considered. * Basic knowledge of technical, administration, and management of all phases of project management. * Basic knowledge of public and construction safety and security issues and regulations. * Excellent mathematical skills, including application, and use in problem solving. * Must be able to read, understand, and apply IFC drawings and job specifications for civil and electrical work. * Strong coordination, time management, active listening, verbal and written communication skills, critical thinking, and reasoning skills. * Computer literacy and proficiency using Acumatica, MS Project, and MS Office **Important Interview Policy:** To ensure a focused conversation and protect the privacy of both our candidates and team members, the use of AI note\-takers, recording devices, or real\-time transcription software is strictly prohibited during this interview. jobs.title: Fire Protection Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Summary** We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Fire Protection Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and implementing fire protection systems across a variety of industrial, commercial, and manufacturing projects. Your expertise will ensure that buildings and facilities meet all relevant fire safety codes and standards, while integrating advanced systems to safeguard personnel and assets. This position offers an exciting opportunity to lead system design initiatives, collaborate with cross\-functional teams, and drive continuous improvement in fire safety solutions. **Duties** * Develop comprehensive fire protection system designs using CAD software such as AutoCAD and Revit, incorporating building information modeling (BIM) tools for accurate visualization. * Conduct building code analysis to ensure compliance with local, national, and international fire safety standards. * Perform risk assessments and root cause analysis to identify vulnerabilities in existing fire protection systems and recommend effective improvements. * Lead project scheduling efforts to coordinate design phases, installation timelines, and testing procedures across multiple projects. * Collaborate with civil, mechanical, electrical, and systems engineers to integrate fire protection systems seamlessly into overall building infrastructure. * Utilize scripting languages like Python or MATLAB for data analysis, system simulation, or automation of design processes. * Oversee the design of mechanical systems related to fire suppression, including sprinkler systems, gas suppression systems, and fire alarm controls. * Conduct system troubleshooting during installation and commissioning phases to ensure optimal performance of fire protection solutions. * Prepare detailed schematics, technical drawings, and schematics that adhere to GD\&T (Geometric Dimensioning \& Tolerancing) standards for manufacturing and construction teams. * Lead cross\-functional communication efforts to coordinate project progress, technical challenges, and regulatory compliance updates with stakeholders. **Experience** * Proven experience practicing in an industrial or manufacturing engineering role with a focus on fire protection or related mechanical systems. * Demonstrated project management skills with the ability to handle multiple deadlines while maintaining high\-quality deliverables. * Strong background in mechanical engineering principles applied to fire suppression system design and building code compliance. * Hands\-on experience with CAD software such as AutoCAD or SolidWorks; familiarity with 3D modeling for product design is a plus. * Knowledge of programmable logic controllers (PLCs), data collection techniques, and system troubleshooting within complex engineering environments. * Experience working on construction projects involving fire safety systems from initial design through installation and testing phases. * Familiarity with building information modeling (BIM) tools for integrated project delivery in construction settings. * Excellent analytical skills for conducting root cause analysis and research related to fire safety issues or failures. * Ability to interpret schematics, technical drawings, and laboratory test results related to fire protection components. * Strong communication skills for collaborating effectively within multidisciplinary teams across engineering disciplines such as civil, mechanical, electrical, and systems engineering. Join us if you're passionate about advancing fire safety through innovative engineering solutions! We value energetic professionals eager to make a meaningful impact by designing reliable systems that protect lives and property worldwide. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Flexible spending account * Paid jury duty * Paid time off * Parental leave * Relocation assistance * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement Work Location: Hybrid remote in Montrose County, CO

jobs.title: Full Stack Web Developer
jobs.description: Location: San Diego, CA Job Type: Full\-Time Salary: $174,000 \- $185,000 **Position Overview:** We're seeking a Senior Staff or Principal engineer to own the architecture of ourinternal platforms and cloud infrastructure. These are the systems operations, finance, and lab teams rely on every day to run and scale the business. This isn't a role scoped to one product; it's broad ownership across cloud infrastructure, data architecture, and tightly coupled to lab and business operations. You'll need to be a strong full\-stack engineer who can operate independently across the stack, frontend, backend, data, and cloud infrastructure, intimately familiar with modern development practices, and a clear communicator who can sit with operations, finance, and lab leadership to translate ambiguous business needs into shipped software Deep full\-stack and cloud experience is required; curiosity and the ability to move fast across unfamiliar domains matter just as much, since this role touches nearly every part of the business. This role is a unique opportunity to own a central piece to the overall success of the company. **Responsibilities:** * Architect and build internal platforms and tools that operations, finance, and lab teams, in addition to external customers, depend on daily.Architect and build inter\-nal platforms and tools that operations, finance, and lab teams depend on daily. * Build a robust cloud infrastructure that leverage best in class tooling to manage provisioning, cost, reliability, and security as data and transaction volume scales. * Design data models and APIs that connect lab systems, lab equipment, business sys\-tems (NetSuite, ATS, CRM), and internal dashboards into a coherent operational backbone. * Help set the technical direction regarding architecture, code quality, CI/CD, testing, observability across a small but growing engineering org. * Work directly with operations, finance, and lab leadership to map requirements and priorities, translating ambiguous business needs into shipped software. * Over time build a team and mentor other engineers and act as a technical escalation point across the stack. * Contribute to CI/CD, code review, and testing practices company\-wide. **Qualifications:** Required: * 10\+ years of professional full\-stack software engineering experience, including senior/staff\-level ownership of production systems. * Deep, hands\-on experience with modern cloud infrastructure spanning architecture, deployment, cost, and reliability management. * Full\-stack programming experience spanning a modern frontend framework (e.g. React), backend services, and data modeling (SQL/NoSQL), with git\-based workflows and CI/CD. * Track record of building internal tools or platforms from ambiguous requirements, not just feature work on an existing product, that have been deployed into production use. * Experience operating as a technical leader who works directly with non\-engineering stakeholders (ops, finance, or similar). * BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent industry experience. Track record with production systems weighs more than credentials. Nice to have: * Experience in a high\-growth startup or biotech/life sciences environment. * Familiarity with regulated\-data handling (21 CFR Part 11, ISO 13485, ISO 15189, CAP / CLIA, GxP, or HIPAA). * Experience integrating with business systems like NetSuite, ATS platforms, or CRMs. * Infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform or similar) and CI/CD pipeline ownership. * Experience with LIMS or laboratory workflows * Experience with HL7 v2, FHIR, LIS, ASTM E1394, or IHE profiles for lab / EMR interoperability. *We are an equal opportunity employer. We thrive on diversity and collaboration.*

jobs.title: Healthcare Software Tester / QA Specialist (Healthcare Experience Preferred)
jobs.description: Healthcare Software Tester / QA Specialist (Healthcare Experience Preferred) **Company:** PillarThera **Location:** La Palma, California — Local candidates preferred within approximately 5 to 10 miles **Work Arrangement:** Part\-Time / Contract; On\-Site preferred **Training:** In\-person in La Palma preferred **(A) About PillarThera:** PillarThera is an AI\-powered home\-based care platform designed to connect patients, independent healthcare providers, and healthcare agencies while simplifying care coordination \& delivery, clinical documentation, scheduling, compliance, billing, and claims workflows. The platform supports healthcare professionals including: * Physical Therapists (PT) * Physical Therapist Assistants (PTA) * Occupational Therapists (OT) * Occupational Therapy Assistants (OTA) * Speech Therapists / Speech\-Language Pathologists (ST/SLP) * Registered Nurses (RN) * Licensed Vocational Nurses / Licensed Practical Nurses (LVN/LPN) * Nurse Practitioners (NP) * Certified Nursing Assistants (CNA) * Caregivers We are looking for a hands\-on **Healthcare Software Tester / QA Specialist** who can test PillarThera (Website, Android, and iOS) from the perspective of real healthcare users. **(B) Who We Are Looking For:** We strongly prefer candidates who have worked in the healthcare industry and have hands\-on experience using healthcare software. *Note: You do* ***not*** *need to be a software developer or professional QA engineer.* Ideal candidates may have experience as a healthcare provider, medical biller, healthcare administrator, agency staff member, clinical coordinator, intake specialist, authorization specialist, or similar healthcare professional. Experience using healthcare software for any of the following is especially valuable: * Patient intake and registration * Healthcare provider or agency account registration and administration * Electronic medical records or healthcare management systems * Scheduling and patient visits * Clinical documentation \- AI automation and manual review * Plan of Care (POC) workflow \- preparation, submission, certification, tracking, approval/rejection. * Insurance eligibility or benefits verification * Prior authorization * Medical billing and claims submission * Claims status and payment tracking * Provider credentialing * Electronic signatures and healthcare documents * Home health, therapy, skilled nursing, or caregiving workflows **(C) What You Will Test:** You will test PillarThera from different user roles and follow realistic healthcare workflows through the system. Depending on the testing assignment, this may include: **(1\) Patient Portal** Testing patient registration, profile setup, insurance information, service requests, provider search and matching, scheduling, documents, payments, messaging, and other patient functions. **(2\) Provider Portal** Testing provider registration, professional credentials, license and NPI information, patient/case workflows, scheduling, clinical documentation, visit\-related functions, billing, claims, payments, and other provider functions. **(3\) Agency Portal** Testing agency registration and setup, administrators, provider/workforce management, patient management, credentialing, case assignments, documentation, claims, billing, compliance, and agency workflows. **(4\) Certifier / Clinical Workflow** Testing Plan of Care review, certification\-related workflows, documentation, approvals, signatures, and communication between healthcare roles. **(5\) Administrative \& Compliance Functions** Testing user management, verification, subscriptions, transactions, documents, compliance\-related functions, system notifications, and other administrative workflows. You may also test PillarThera's AI\-assisted and workflow automation features as they become available. **(D) Key Responsibilities:** You will: * Follow provided test scenarios and test PillarThera functions step by step. * Test the system from different user roles. * Create realistic test accounts and test data when instructed. * Verify whether each function works as expected. * Identify bugs, confusing workflows, missing information, incorrect calculations, or unexpected system behavior. * Evaluate whether workflows make sense from a healthcare user's perspective. * Test on common web browsers and devices when requested. * Re\-test functions after developers make corrections. * Clearly identify whether an issue has been fixed or still exists. * Provide practical feedback on usability and healthcare workflow. * Participate in training and testing meetings in person or through Google Meet. **(E) Test Reporting:** Candidates should be comfortable preparing short, clear test reports. You do not need to write lengthy technical reports. For each issue, you should be able to document: * User Role being tested * Function / Page being tested * Test steps * Expected result * Actual result * Pass / Fail * Description of the problem * Screenshot or screen recording show comfortable using screenshot and screen\-recording tools and sharing the results with our development team. **(F) Required Qualifications:** * Hands\-on experience using computers, websites, and software applications. * Comfortable learning and testing a new web\-based healthcare platform. * Able to follow workflows and written testing instructions carefully. * Detail\-oriented and able to recognize when software behavior does not match the expected workflow. * Able to clearly describe software problems in writing. * Able to capture and share screenshots and/or short screen recordings. * Able to organize testing results by function and user role. * Good written and verbal communication skills. * Comfortable communicating with the PillarThera product and development teams. **(G) Healthcare Experience — Strongly Preferred** We strongly prefer candidates with experience in one or more of the following areas: * Physical therapy, occupational therapy, or speech therapy * Skilled nursing * Home health * Home care / caregiving * Medical billing and claims * Insurance authorization * Healthcare administration * Patient intake and scheduling * Provider credentialing * Clinical documentation Licensed or experienced healthcare professionals—including **PT, PTA, OT, OTA, ST/SLP, RN, LVN/LPN, NP, CNA, and caregivers—are encouraged to apply.** Healthcare administrative professionals with strong hands\-on software experience are also encouraged to apply. **(H) Preferred Qualifications:** Experience with one or more of the following is a plus: * EHR/EMR software * Home health or home care software * Practice management software * Medical billing or claims software * Insurance eligibility and prior authorization systems * Electronic Visit Verification (EVV) * Clinical documentation software * Provider credentialing systems * CMS\-1500 or electronic healthcare claims * Healthcare scheduling systems * Bug/issue tracking software Formal software QA certification is **not required**. **(I) Location Preference:** We prefer candidates located in **La Palma, California, or within approximately a 5 to 10\-mile radius**, because some initial training, workflow reviews, and testing sessions may be conducted in person. Qualified candidates outside the area may also be considered. Training and testing meetings can be conducted through **Google Meet** when appropriate. **(L) What Makes Someone Successful in This Role:** The ideal candidate is someone who can look at PillarThera and think: ***“If I were actually using this system to manage a patient, document a visit, obtain authorization, submit a Plan of Care, create a claim, or manage a healthcare provider, would this workflow make sense and work correctly?”*** We value practical healthcare experience and attention to detail as much as traditional software testing experience. **(K) How to Apply:** Please submit your resume along with a brief description of: * Your healthcare experience or healthcare\-related role. * Healthcare software you have used and what you used it for. * Your experience with medical billing, insurance authorization, Plan of Care, clinical documentation, scheduling, or healthcare administration, if applicable. * Your experience testing websites or software, if any. * Your general availability for part\-time or project\-based testing. * **Your current employment status** — Please indicate whether you are currently working full\-time, part\-time, as a freelancer, or as an independent contractor. If currently employed or contracted, please provide the company/organization name and your role. * **Your interest in future opportunities with PillarThera** — After gaining hands\-on experience with PillarThera through the software testing process, would you be interested in being considered for a part\-time or full\-time position with PillarThera before or after our official launch? **PillarThera — Your Pillar for Care and Recovery.** Pay: $15\.00 \- $18\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Intern II: Project Engineer
jobs.description: **New West Building Company** **Job Description** **Job Title:** Intern II – Project Engineer **Reports To:** Project Manager/Senior Project Manager/Superintendent **FLSA Status:** Non\-Exempt **Status:** Temporary. Full Time. **Date Prepared:** November 2025 **General Purpose** The Intern II \- Project Engineer is an entry\-level position providing day\-to\-day support to the project team throughout all phases of construction. This role offers hands\-on learning opportunities while assisting Project Managers, Superintendents, and Project Engineers with project documentation, coordination, and execution. **Essential Functions** **Project Coordination \& Learning** * Learn directly from Project Teams, including Superintendents, Project Managers, and Project Engineers. * Support multiple projects simultaneously at various stages of construction. * Review drawings and specifications to ensure construction accuracy and adherence to design intent. * Assist in planning, organizing, and documenting Owner\-Architect\-Contractor (OAC) meetings, including taking minutes, updating Procore, and communicating action items. **Documentation \& Technology** * Learn and utilize Procore and Bluebeam for project management, coordination, and documentation. * Manage project documents in Procore: update drawings and specifications, link RFIs to drawings, and organize project photos. * Review, track, and distribute Requests for Information (RFIs); draft RFIs with oversight from the Project Manager or Superintendent. * Assist in the review, tracking, and processing of submittals, ensuring compliance jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to work across the full stack of our surgical robotic platform: the robotics system, the ML platform, and the infrastructure that powers model training. You will build machine learning models to solve problems specific to surgical robotics, many of which do not have existing research or pre\-trained solutions to start from. **What You'll Do** * Train and build machine learning models for real\-world robotic applications. * Work across the robotics stack, the ML platform, and the infrastructure for model training. * Build models from scratch for novel problems where prior research or pre\-trained models do not apply. * Write clean, testable, production\-quality code that integrates with the broader system. * Collaborate closely with robotics, software, and clinical teams to bring new capabilities to the robot. **What We're Looking For** **Machine Learning** * Hands\-on experience training machine learning models, either in graduate studies or professional work. This is a must, not something to learn on the job. * Ability to build models from scratch for problems where existing research does not apply, rather than only fine\-tuning or retraining existing models. * Ability to scope out an ambiguous ML problem and define an approach when there is no established path to follow. **Software Engineering** * Ability to write clean, maintainable, production\-quality code. * Experience writing tests and validating software behavior. Testing is a core part of how we build, not an afterthought. * Comfortable working across multiple parts of the technical stack, from robotics to ML platform to training infrastructure. * Strong debugging and problem\-solving skills. **Ownership \& Startup Mindset** * Strong ownership mindset and ability to independently drive projects forward. * Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving environment with evolving priorities. * The project needs to be delivered, and you do what it takes to get it there. * Willingness to seek feedback, iterate quickly, and collaborate closely with teammates. **Nice to have** * Experience with computer vision or vision models. * Experience deploying high\-performance ML models in production (for example, converting trained models to ONNX or similar formats for C\+\+ inference). * Experience with C\+\+. * Experience with robotics or hardware\-adjacent systems. * Experience working in startup environments. **Why Join Andromeda?** At Andromeda, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a small, highly technical team tackling some of the hardest problems in robotics, software, and healthcare. Your work will directly impact products that are deployed in real clinical environments and have the potential to improve patient outcomes at scale. **We offer:** * Competitive salary and equity package * Flexible healthcare benefits through an individual coverage reimbursement program * Monthly health and wellness stipend * 401(k) retirement plan * Visa sponsorship available for eligible candidates * The opportunity to help build a category\-defining company from an early stage Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer (Evals and Voice Models)
jobs.description: Aircall is a unicorn, AI\-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000\+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer\-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace. Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post\-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real\-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence. Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world\-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines. At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product\-driven, and execution\-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth. **How we work at Aircall**: We're customer\-obsessed, data\-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast\-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here. Aircall's AI suite includes an AI Voice Agent and AI Messaging Agent that autonomously handle calls, WhatsApp, and SMS, plus AI Assist, which delivers real\-time coaching, call summaries, and CRM automation for sales and support teams. We are looking for someone that can build out the evaluation foundation across all of these products and other agentic products. You'll work on voice models, agent capability evals, benchmark design, LLM\-as\-judge systems, failure analysis, and the infrastructure that ties it together by establishing shared metrics, test sets, and tooling to measure accuracy, resolution quality, and safety consistently across products. You will set up repeatable pipelines for regression testing and benchmarking as models and features evolve so teams can ship confidently without re\-inventing evaluation methodology for each product. **Key Responsibilities** * Design and document comprehensive evaluation frameworks for Aircall's AI agents across voice, chat and messaging. * Train and fine\-tune voice models (TTS, ASR, speech\-to\-speech) using production and synthetic data, iterating on architecture, data mix, and training strategy to improve accuracy, naturalness, and latency. * Assess AI generated solutions across training pipelines, experimentation setups, debugging processes, and optimization strategies. * Analyze system design decisions and identify strengths, weaknesses, and potential failure points. * Design annotation guidelines and workflows for human\-labeled evaluation data, and calibrate LLM\-as\-judge systems against human raters to ensure automated evals stay trustworthy over time. * Build and maintain live quality monitoring for deployed AI agents, tracking accuracy, resolution rate, and safety signals in production, and flagging model or data drift before it impacts customers. * Own the metric contract for every published AI metrics, including definition, population, grain, rollup, validity window. * Build release gates, the offline regression suite each AI surface must pass before a prompt, model, or config change ships, measuring reliability across repeated trials, not just average pass rates. * Build voice\-specific evaluation: simulated callers across accents, languages, background noise, barge\-in, DTMF, and tool failures, with latency and ASR accuracy as first\-class quality metrics. **Minimum Qualifications** * BS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or related field * 3\+ years of experience in ML Engineering or Applied ML with 8\+ years of overall experience * Strong experience in evaluating supervised, unsupervised, LLMs and deep learning models. * Hands\-on experience in failure analysis and evaluating LLMs * Experience building automated evaluation systems * Strong communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts across technical and non\-technical audiences * Hands\-on experience training or fine\-tuning voice/speech models (TTS, ASR, or speech\-to\-speech), including data pipeline construction and experimentation. **Preferred Qualifications** * MS / PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or related field * Experience evaluating LLMs or agentic systems (e.g., LLM\-as\-a\-judge, RAG evaluation) * Experience with synthetic data generation and prompt engineering * Experience training or fine\-tuning voice models at scale, with familiarity in synthetic data generation, model distillation, or low\-latency inference optimization for production voice agents. **Why join us?** Key moment to join Aircall in terms of growth and opportunities ‍️ Our people matter, work\-life balance is important at Aircall Fast\-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit 45\+ Nationalities: cosmopolite \& multi\-cultural mindset Competitive salary package \& benefits **DE\&I Statement:** At Aircall, we believe diversity, equity and inclusion – irrespective of origins, identity, background and orientations – are core to our journey. We pride ourselves on promoting active inclusion within our business to foster a strong sense of belonging for all. We're working to create a place filled with diverse people who can enrich and learn from one another. We're committed to ensuring that everyone not only has a seat at the table but is valued and respected at it by providing equal opportunities to develop and thrive. We will constantly challenge ourselves to make sure that we live up to our ambitions around diversity, equity and inclusion, and keep this conversation open. Above all else, we understand and acknowledge that we have work to do and much to learn. Want to know more about candidate privacy? Find our Candidate Privacy Notice here. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Controls & Robotics Engineer — Vision, Inkjet, and Variable Data
jobs.description: **Manufacturing Controls \& Robotics Engineer — Vision, Inkjet, and Variable Data** =================================================================================== **Build smarter lines. Deliver measurable throughput. Leave a repeatable standard behind.** ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- At Arrow International, automation is central to advancing our print and converting operations. With process improvements accelerating and pull tab throughput projects reaching new stages, the volume of automation initiatives now surpasses the capacity of one engineer. We’re adding dedicated execution strength to move projects from inception through implementation—quickly, safely, and sustainably. **Imagine this scenario** ------------------------- You roll out a machine\-vision inspection that flags defects in real time, integrate serialization verification at line speed, and tie it into a newly refined HMI. Moments later, you adjust an Allen\-Bradley PLC routine to remove a bottleneck, then document the panel and wiring changes so the solution can be replicated across other lines. Before the shift ends, you assist Maintenance in resolving a controls fault, safeguarding uptime. **What you will build and sustain** ----------------------------------- * Robust PLC logic (Allen\-Bradley preferred) to stabilize and enhance manufacturing performance. * Operator\-friendly HMIs that provide clarity, control, and dependable feedback. * Integrated controls across print, converting, die cutting, collating, finishing, and related production lines. * Inline vision systems for inspection, quality control, and serialization verification. * Commercial inkjet, laser, and variable\-data printing integrations that fit production workflows. * Robotics programming and automation to reduce labor, elevate throughput, improve quality, and ensure repeatability. * Comprehensive electrical documentation—drawings, panel designs, and wiring standards—that enable repeatable solutions. * Standardized controls practices and documentation applicable across multiple production areas. * Equipment upgrades, process improvements, and new automation installations from planning to handoff. * On\-floor troubleshooting with Maintenance and Production to protect uptime. * Perform other duties as assigned. **How you’ll collaborate** -------------------------- Partner with Process Engineering and Controls Engineering to translate improvement ideas into integrated controls solutions. Work closely with Production, Maintenance, and Operations to ensure smooth adoption and ongoing reliability across print, converting, and die\-cutting lines. **Qualifications** ------------------ * B.S. in Electrical, Controls, or Automation Engineering (or equivalent experience). * 3–5 years of PLC programming; Allen\-Bradley preferred. * Experience developing HMIs and integrating controls in industrial/manufacturing settings. * Background supporting production equipment, automation deployments, or manufacturing process improvements. * Industrial vision experience (Cognex or Keyence) is a strong plus. * Knowledge of inkjet/laser coding, serialization, or variable\-data printing integration is highly desirable. * Robotics programming experience preferred. * Skilled at reading and creating electrical drawings, wiring diagrams, and panel layouts; disciplined documentation habits. * Proven troubleshooting ability on the production floor. * Effective communicator across Engineering, Maintenance, Production, and Operations. * Ability to balance project work with hands\-on production support. **Core proficiencies** ---------------------- * Industrial Robot Programming * Troubleshooting Industrial Automation Equipment * PLC Programming Experience * Pneumatics Troubleshooting

Consistently ranking among the Top 500 Design Firms in Engineering News\-Record, the firm offers a deep bench of industry experts through a highly collaborative approach, delivering innovative solutions across the full project lifecycle. jobs.description: **Job Title**: Operations Associate **Department:** Operations **Reports to**: CEO **Location:** Hybrid; could be primarily remote, with in\-person visits to our Cambridge, MA or Portland, ME office at least once per month. **Type:** Full\-Time (or Part\-Time During School) **Job Summary** Empallo is a cardiology startup looking for a clinical Operations Associate to support and help improve the day\-to\-day operations of our affiliated medical practices. This is a hands\-on role for someone who thrives on solving problems, learning quickly, and making sure patients and providers have a smooth experience from start to finish.
