This role is ideal for someone who is equal parts organized operator and process builder, comfortable talking with patients and providers one hour and working with engineers to automate a workflow the next. **Areas of Responsibility** * Manage patient onboarding and scheduling * Guide patients through their care journey, answering questions along the way * Coordinate diagnostics, referrals, results processing, and follow up care * Communicate with healthcare providers to support smooth care delivery * Gather actionable feedback from providers and patients to improve and automate operational workflows * Research and maintain understanding of applicable healthcare regulations to help ensure compliance across operations * Support revenue cycle management, including eligibility checks, claim submissions, prior authorizations * Follow up with payers on outstanding or appealed claims * Support invoicing * Design and implement process improvements * Wireframe automations or improvements to operational workflows * Translate user feedback into product enhancements by proactively spotting opportunities and capturing them in actionable tickets * Write clear product specifications and documentation * Contribute proactively to the engineering roadmap **Areas of Responsibility** * Clinical Operations * Product Management * Regulatory Compliance **Required Skills \& Abilities** * Strong communication and interpersonal skills; comfortable working with operational team members, patients, clinicians, engineers and executives * Cross functional collaboration experience * Ability to turn user feedback and data into clear product requirements and operational improvements * Strong organizational, time management, and follow through skills * Ability to understand and communicate US healthcare regulatory, compliance, and operational requirements clearly * Comfortable working in a fast paced startup environment * Proficiency with Google Workspace, including Docs, Sheets, and Slides * Experience with, or willingness to learn, tools related to: * Customer relationship management (CRM) * Electronic health records (EHRs) * Software development project tracking and roadmap planning * Revenue cycle management (RCM) **Education** * Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from a community college, vocational or professional certificate program, or undergraduate program, in a related field * Relevant certifications (e.g., certified nursing assistant, medical assistant) are a plus **Why Join Us** * Meaningful exposure to how processes and tools are built and improved from day one * Direct exposure to operations, product and engineering * Work directly with a healthcare team building something new and impactful Pay: From $20\.00 per hour Application Question(s): * Recent graduate (past 5 years) Experience: * medical assistant: 1 year (Preferred) Location: * Portland, ME 04101 (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Portland, ME 04101

jobs.title: Principal Consultant, Climate & Sustainability
jobs.description: We are looking for a senior, strategically minded sustainability advisor to join our Boston team. You will own a portfolio of US enterprise clients, lead complex engagements end\-to\-end, and be the person our clients call when the question is hard and the answer matters. This is a senior role with genuine ownership. You will help shape how we deliver, which clients we pursue, and how our US practice grows. You will work alongside our Boston team of consultants day to day, report to the US Managing Director and work with our advisory, engineering and product teams across the Nordics, with a direct line into how our platform evolves. The role is deliberately broad: part trusted advisor, part analyst, part commercial builder. If you are looking for a narrow, well\-defined lane inside a large consultancy, this is not that. If you want to build something and have your fingerprints on it, it is. **About Us:** CEMAsys was founded in Norway in 2007 as one of the Nordics' first sustainability advisory and climate technology firms, and has spent close to two decades helping complex, multi\-facility organizations turn fragmented operational data into emissions accounting, operational efficiency and real environmental intelligence. In May 2026, **CEMAsys** was acquired by **Energi.AI**, an AI\-native environmental intelligence company. Together, we are a team of around 45 people, headquartered in Oslo with offices in Boston, Copenhagen and Stockholm. We combine strategic advisory with our own platform, built and maintained by our in\-house tech team, with AI agents doing much of the data collection and transformation. That combination is the point \- most of our clients buy both: consultants who understand their sector and their operational and regulatory reality, and software that makes the numbers data\-driven, auditable and repeatable year after year. We work with enterprise organizations in textile, chemicals, construction, healthcare, banking and financial services, real estate and utilities and more. Our Boston office is the platform for our growth in North America, and this role is central to building it. We are a small team that takes this work seriously and enjoys it. You will be surrounded by people who are genuinely motivated to make a difference together with our clients. **What You Will Do:*** Own and grow a portfolio of US enterprise clients, acting as their senior advisor on strategy, operational performance, reporting and assurance\-readiness. * Turn messy operational data into decision\-grade analysis that a CFO or COO will act on \- energy and resource *cost*, efficiency, risk \- and work with our product and engineering teams to make that analysis repeatable inside the platform rather than rebuilt in a spreadsheet every year. * Translate the regulatory landscape \- California SB 253 and SB 261, the state\-level rules following California, CSRD for US subsidiaries of EU parents, ISSB / IFRS S1 and S2 \- into practical roadmaps clients can actually execute. * Lead GHG inventories across Scope 1, 2 and 3 under the GHG Protocol, science\-based target setting (SBTi), climate risk and scenario analysis, and materiality and double materiality assessments. * Design and facilitate executive workshops, steering committee sessions and client meetings with structure, confidence and a clear point of view. * Drive business development with our commercial team \- scoping, proposals, pricing and pitching to prospective clients \- and own retention and expansion revenue within your portfolio. * Handle complex deliveries and challenging client situations with judgment and composure. * Mentor consultants earlier in their careers and contribute to our internal methodology, quality standards and knowledge base. **What You Bring:*** 10\+ years of experience in sustainability, climate or ESG \- in consulting, or in an in\-house role with significant advisory and program ownership. * Bachelor's or Master's degree in sustainability, environmental science or engineering, business, economics, finance or a related field. * Deep, hands\-on command of GHG accounting under the GHG Protocol (Scope 3 in particular), California climate disclosure rules, CDP, SBTi, and climate risk and scenario analysis. * Strong quantitative and analytical ability \- comfortable inside large and imperfect datasets, and able to defend the methodology behind the numbers to a CFO or an auditor. * A demonstrated track record of owning client relationships and delivering commercial outcomes, not only technical deliverables. * You use AI tools in your *daily* work and are comfortable working alongside engineers and agent\-based data pipelines \- not only in Excel and PowerPoint. * Authorized to work in the US without sponsorship, based in or relocating to the Boston area, and able to travel occasionally to client sites and to our Nordic offices. **Nice to Have:*** Experience implementing, evaluating or working inside ESG software rather than only around it. * Experience preparing sustainability disclosures for limited or reasonable assurance. * Working knowledge of CSRD / ESRS and ISSB / IFRS S1 and S2, for US subsidiaries of EU parents. * Experience in one of our core sectors: healthcare, textiles, financial services, real estate, utilities or manufacturing. **Who You Are:** We are looking for an engaged, results\-oriented advisor with strong client focus, commercial instinct and an appetite to grow. The role suits someone who is at home in an advisory seat, builds long\-term client relationships, and contributes actively to both our clients' success and our own.* **Client focus.** You build strong relationships through proactive advice, genuine listening and a solutions\-oriented approach. * **Commercial mindset.** You spot business opportunities and act on them, with client value as the starting point. * **Drive and motivation.** You are self\-directed, purposeful and visibly committed to getting to a result. * **Perseverance.** You keep focus and motivation when things get difficult, and you find a way around obstacles. * **Growth mindset.** You actively seek feedback, learning and development to improve your own performance and ours. * **Collaboration.** You work well with others, prioritize the team's success and build relationships based on trust. * **Constructive feedback.** You give feedback that is honest, respectful and useful \- and you take it the same way. * **Time management.** You plan and prioritize effectively, and you deliver on time and to a high standard. **What We Offer:*** Competitive base salary plus performance\-based bonus. * 401(k) with company match. * 20 days of paid time off per year, plus paid US public holidays. * Medical, dental and vision coverage. * Paid parental leave. * Hybrid working \- a minimum of three days per week in our Boston office, with flexibility for the rest. * A dedicated budget for professional development and certification. * Two trips a year to our Oslo HQ. * A real mandate: at our size your work is visible, your judgment counts, and you help decide how the US business grows. **How to Apply:*** Apply by October 11, 2026\. * Please upload your resume and a short cover letter telling us why this role and why now. * Questions about the role? Contact Amalie Goperod, Managing Director – **amalie@cemasys.com.** **Equal Opportunity:** CEMAsys and **Energi.AI** is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applicants from all backgrounds, and we make *hiring* decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other protected characteristic. Building a diverse team is a continuous focus for us \- and we would rather hear from you than have you rule yourself out. If you meet most of what is above, please apply.

jobs.title: Process Automation Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details** **Division:** **Nucor Steel West Virginia LLC** **Location:** **Apple Grove, WV, United States** **Other Available Locations:** **N/A** **Welcome to Nucor, where our unique culture sets us apart. Joining Nucor means becoming part of North America's largest steel and steel products manufacturer, offering unmatched career opportunities and stability. We are known for our innovative sustainability practices and are the continent's largest recycler. Our vibrant culture, built on personal connections and teamwork, empowers every team member with the freedom to innovate and contribute to our collective success. Experience a workplace where safety, efficiency, and meaningful personal connections define every day, enriching both our teammates and the communities we serve.** **Nucor supports its teammates with top\-tier benefits like Medical, Dental, Vision, and Disability Insurance, 401K and Roth accounts, Profit sharing, Pay\-for\-performance bonuses, Paid parental leave, Tuition reimbursement, Stock program, Scholarships and more.** **Basic Job Functions:** ------------------------ Nucor Steel West Virginia is seeking a **Process Automation Software Engineer.** The Process Automation Software Engineer works closely with operations, maintenance, information technology, and process automation teams to ensure the safe, reliable, and efficient operation of the plant. This role is responsible for the Universal Middleware System (UMS), Nucor's in\-house manufacturing execution and integration platform that connects level 2 automation systems with plant and enterprise systems. This is a hands\-on software engineering role in a heavy industrial environment focused on designing, developing, testing, deploying, and supporting full\-stack applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and web\-based tools that enable reliable data collection, movement, and visibility across plant operations. The engineer owns solutions end\-to\-end, from understanding operational requirements and designing maintainable systems to troubleshooting production issues and supporting applications in a 24/7 manufacturing environment. A significant portion of the role involves system integration, including interfacing OEM automation systems, translating data between platforms, optimizing data flow, diagnosing communication issues, and ensuring end\-to\-end traceability of production data. The engineer will also support continuous improvement initiatives by building scalable solutions that improve plant performance while establishing a strong foundation for future reporting, analytics, process optimization, and AI\-driven technologies. Success in this role requires strong software engineering fundamentals, system integration expertise, and a willingness to learn the steelmaking process. data for analytics, AI, and Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) applications. * Demonstrate ownership, strong communication, effective troubleshooting, and collaborative teamwork. ***Nucor is an jobs.title: Process Engineering Intern
jobs.description: **About Stratus** Stratus® is an integrated, multi\-disciplinary engineering, architecture, interior design, and consulting firm. Consistently ranking among the Top 500 Design Firms in Engineering News\-Record, the firm offers a deep bench of industry experts through a highly collaborative approach, delivering innovative solutions across the full project lifecycle. Operating coast to coast, Stratus® serves clients nationwide while maintaining a strategic commitment to supporting high\-growth economies and building vibrant communities that foster the professional growth of its team. Serving public\- and private\-sector clients, the firm is dedicated to delivering the highest\-quality service wherever projects take shape. Across the Civic, Commercial, Industrial, Transportation, Education, Water Resources, and Government sectors, we bring precision, insight, and purpose to every project, from targeted renovations to large\-scale infrastructure. Stratus® designs spaces, systems, and solutions that perform, endure, and make an impact, delivering on our promise of Better Plans. Better Places. **Job Summary** As a Process Design Intern, you will support engineers and designers working on industrial process systems, equipment layouts, material and energy flows, and production\-focused projects. You will gain hands\-on exposure to technical design tools, project documentation, field conditions, multidisciplinary coordination, and project delivery while contributing to active assignments with guidance from experienced professionals. **What You’ll Do** * Assist with process flow diagrams, P\&IDs, calculations, equipment data, reports, and other project documentation. * Support process equipment evaluation, system layouts, material and utility balances, and design coordination. * Participate in project meetings, site visits, field observations, and collaboration with mechanical, piping, electrical, instrumentation, and structural teams. **What You’ll Learn** * How process design principles, engineering tools, codes, and technical standards are applied to industrial projects. * How process flows, equipment requirements, operating conditions, and design deliverables are developed and reviewed. * How process designers coordinate safety, constructability, operations, and multidisciplinary project requirements. **Qualifications** *Required** Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program in Chemical, Mechanical, Process Engineering, or a related field. * Completion of relevant coursework in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, mass transfer, or process design. * Basic understanding of process systems and engineering calculations. * Basic proficiency with AutoCAD or similar design software and Microsoft Office applications. *Preferred** Internship, co\-op, laboratory, or project experience related to industrial process design. * Familiarity with process simulation tools, PFDs, P\&IDs, equipment specifications, or process safety concepts. * Involvement in AIChE, ASME, or related professional organizations. **Why you’ll love or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, pregnancy\-related conditions, and lactation), gender characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. Stratus Team’s management Team is dedicated to this policy with respect to recruitment, hiring, placement, promotion, transfer, training, compensation, benefits, employee activities, access to facilities and programs, and general treatment during employment.* \#LI\-MY1

jobs.title: Product Manager – Firmware OTA & Lifecycle Management (Job ID 3022037)
jobs.description: **Locations and Workstyle:** **Irving, TX** and **Boca Raton, FL**: Hybrid schedule – onsite a minimum of four days per week, with one remote day. Five days onsite may be required based on business needs. **Blue Bell, PA**: Primarily remote; candidates should be within commuting distance of the Blue Bell office and able to work onsite as needed. Option to come onsite more frequently if desired. We are looking for a Product Manager to own the end\-to\-end firmware release lifecycle across our connected product platforms. In this role, you will partner with teams across Product, Engineering, Security, Quality, Operations, Customer Care, and external partners to ensure devices remain secure, reliable, current, and supportable throughout their lifecycle. You will serve as the central owner for release planning, over\-the\-air (OTA) deployment strategy, adoption, and post\-release performance. Success in this role requires balancing customer impact, security priorities, operational risk, and business objectives while driving disciplined execution across multiple stakeholders. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex operational challenges, coordinating across teams, and using data to improve release outcomes. What You’ll Do * Develop integrated release plans covering validation, security reviews, certifications, dependencies, communications, operational readiness, and deployment milestones. * Lead release readiness reviews and establish rollout stages, customer segmentation strategies, success criteria, rollback plans, and escalation procedures. * Coordinate release execution across Engineering, Security, Quality, Customer Care, Field Operations, and external partners. * Monitor deployment health, adoption, update success and failure rates, version distribution, and exception trends. * Create dashboards and reporting that provide visibility into release performance, customer impact, and operational risk. * Drive recovery efforts for unsuccessful or stalled deployments and ensure issues are resolved through closure. * Lead post\-release reviews, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives. * Serve as the primary owner and coordination point for legacy OTA platforms and migration\-related activities. * Translate technical risks and system behavior into clear business impacts and customer\-facing recommendations. * Manage vendor relationships, release dependencies, service expectations, and escalations. What You’ll Need * Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Product Management, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of experience in Product Management, Technical Program Management, Device Lifecycle Management, or a related field. * Experience coordinating customer\-facing software or firmware releases across cross\-functional teams. * Experience defining release requirements, rollout plans, readiness criteria, deployment metrics, and escalation processes. * Working knowledge of embedded firmware, connected\-device ecosystems, OTA update systems, cloud services, and release pipelines. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to assess risk and make data\-driven decisions. Compensation \& Benefits: The salary range for Engineer I is $88,000\.00 – $132,000\.00 based on experience and qualifications. Certain roles are eligible for annual bonus and may include equity. These awards are allocated based on company and individual performance. We offer employees access to healthcare benefits, a 401(k) plan and company match, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits and paid time off among others. Employees accrue up to 120 hours in their first year. Your accrual rate increases after your first year. We also offer 6 paid holidays. *In the event a position is commission\-based, compensation is solely based on the individual’s sales volume. This applies only to commission roles.* Los Angeles Applicants: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Philadelphia Applicants: Background checks will be conducted during the employment process. Any information will be reviewed through an individualized assessment in accordance with the Philadelphia Fair Criminal Record Screening Standards Ordinance. ***ADT is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. ADT strives to ensure every employee and applicant feels valued. Visit us at jobs.adt.com/diversity to learn more.***

jobs.title: SCADA Engineer Intern – I - Critical Infrastructure
jobs.description: Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS \& EPMS solutions for mission\-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program\-level governance. Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high\-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything. **Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.** **Position Title:** SCADA Engineer Intern – I – Critical Infrastructure **Position Location:** Remote \- work virtually from anywhere in the United States, Atlanta, GA, or Dallas, TX **JOB SUMMARY** The SCADA Engineering Intern supports the development, testing, and documentation of SCADA systems for mission\-critical (Data Center) infrastructure projects. This is a hands\-on learning opportunity for students or recent graduates interested in software development, industrial automation, controls, and AI\-enabled engineering. The intern will work under the guidance of experienced engineers and contribute to clearly defined project assignments. Previous professional SCADA experience is not required. Candidates should demonstrate technical curiosity, attention to detail, a willingness to learn, and an interest in industrial automation. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** **SCADA Development \& Support** * Assist with developing SCADA graphics, tags, alarms, scripts, templates, and reusable components * Support basic PLC and SCADA integration activities * Help translate documented requirements and sequences of operation into functional SCADA configurations * Follow established development standards, naming conventions, and engineering processes * Make corrections and improvements based on engineering review and feedback **Testing \& Documentation** * Execute assigned test procedures and document the results * Support quality reviews, defect tracking, and basic troubleshooting * Verify completed work against documented requirements * Assist with technical documentation, test records, tag lists, alarm lists, and engineering notes * Clearly communicate identified issues, questions, and completed work **Development Tools \& AI** * Use Git for source control, including branches, commits, and pull requests * Use Docker and VM environments to create and develop projects * Use Azure DevOps to manage work items, repositories, testing, and documentation * Use approved generative AI and agentic AI tools for coding, testing, research, documentation, and workflow improvement * Review and validate AI\-generated work before using it **Training \& Technical Growth** * Participate in Ignition 8\.3 SCADA platform training with the potential opportunity to earn an certification * Gain practical exposure to Rockwell Automation PLCs and other industrial control systems * Learn SCADA architecture, HMI design, alarming, scripting, data modeling, industrial networking, and communications * Participate in technical discussions, demonstrations, and supervised project activities * Apply feedback and demonstrate continuous improvement **Project Support** * Complete assigned tasks on time and within the defined scope * Communicate progress, questions, and technical issues to the assigned engineer * Participate in supervised testing, commissioning, or field activities when available * Follow established engineering, cybersecurity, safety, and quality requirements * Perform other related duties as assigned **Completion of Assigned Tasks and Deliverables on Time and on Budget** *Performs Other Related Duties as Assigned* **POSITION REQUIREMENTS (BEGINNER LEVEL FOR ALL THE FOLLOWING UNLESS OTHERWISE NOTED)** * Basic understanding of programming, networking, databases, controls, or automation * Familiarity with Git or another source\-control tool * Foundational understanding of generative AI or agentic AI concepts * Interest in SCADA systems, PLCs, industrial automation, and mission\-critical infrastructure * Ability to follow technical instructions and documented processes * Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn * Ability to communicate questions, progress, and technical issues clearly * Ability to work effectively with engineering and project teams * Ability to protect confidential company and customer information ***PREFERRED (NOT REQUIRED)*** o Exposure to Python, Java, JavaScript, SQL, C\#, or a similar programming language o Experience with Git, GitHub, Azure Repos, or Azure DevOps o Familiarity with Docker, containers, Kubernetes, or container orchestration o Familiarity with APIs, JSON, databases, or AI\-assisted development o Exposure to PLCs, HMIs, SCADA platforms, or industrial communication protocols o Familiarity with Ignition, Rockwell Automation, Modbus, BACnet, ITIES** * Ignition 8\.3 SCADA development and platform administration * Potential Ignition Core certification opportunities * Rockwell Automation PLCs and other industrial control technologies * SCADA graphics, alarming, scripting, data modeling, testing, and system integration * Git, Azure DevOps, source control, work\-item tracking, and code reviews * Docker, containerized applications, Kubernetes, and orchestration fundamentals * Generative AI, agentic AI, and AI\-assisted engineering workflows * Mission\-critical infrastructure projects * Mentorship from experienced SCADA, software, controls, and system integration professionals **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** The following physical demands must be met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Ability to remain in a stationary position for extended periods while working on a computer * Ability to move through offices, job sites, control rooms, and equipment spaces as needed * Ability to occasionally lift or move tools or equipment weighing up to 50 pounds **TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS** * This is primarily a remote or office\-based position * Limited supervised travel may be available for training, testing, commissioning, or project\-site exposure * Travel will depend on project requirements, internship timing, and intern availability **EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS** * Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree, certification, apprenticeship, or technical program in: o Computer Science o Software Engineering o Electrical or Computer Engineering o Controls or Automation o Information Technology o Industrial Technology o Artificial Intelligence o A related technical discipline **BENEFITS** *Smart Tech Contracting offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include* * Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO\-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option) * Dental and vision plans * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26 * 401k with company match and self\-directed brokerage account option * PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year * Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents * Short and long\-term disability, AD\&D coverage * Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance * Paid parental leave after one year of employment CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is STC's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non\-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. Smart Tech Contracting is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E\-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce. Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award\-winning team! **NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:** STC does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to STC in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where STC has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of STC and STC will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service. **The pay range for this role is:** 27\.50 \- 27\.50 USD per hour(Remote (United States))

The ideal candidate will have strong experience across modern web technologies, and engineering best practices. Responsible for participating in the design, development, testing, debugging, maintaining, and documenting software components in accordance to Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) best practices. Establish estimates and work plans for design, development, implementation, and rollout tasks. Communicate with the appropriate teams to ensure that assignments are delivered with the highest of quality and in accordance to standards. Demonstrate the company's core values of respect, honesty, integrity, diversity, inclusion and safety.From one tiny Cincinnati grocery store more than a century ago, we've grown into what today is the nation's largest grocer with nearly 2,800 stores in 35 states operating under 28 different names. As America's grocer, we take pride in bringing diverse teams with a passion for food and people together with one common purpose: To Feed the Human Spirit. With a history of innovation, we work tirelessly to create amazing experiences for our customers, communities AND each other, with food at the heart of it all. Here, people matter. That's why we strive to provide the ingredients you need to create your own recipe for success at work and in life. We help feed your future by providing the value and care you need to grow. If you're caring, purpose\-driven and hungry to learn, your potential is unlimited. Whether you're seeking a part\-time position or a new career path, we've got a fresh opportunity for you. Apply today to become part of our Kroger family! **What you'll receive from us:** **The Kroger Family of Companies offers comprehensive benefits to support your Associate Well\-Being, including Physical, Emotional, Financial and more. purchases, including food, travel, technology and so much more. * Up to $21,000 in tuition reimbursement over your career, through our industry\-leading Continuing Education program. * Vast potential for growth, through an abundance of industry\-leading training programs and diverse career pathways. **For more information about benefits and eligibility, please visit** **our Benefits Page** **!** network and security architecture **Desired** * Any experience in Cloud software service including designing for scale, performance and reliability * Any experience in system architecture * jobs.title: Software Engineer (Full Stack)
jobs.description: **About Kobalt Labs** Kobalt is the AI\-native compliance operating system for financial institutions (FIs). Compliance is critical for FIs to get right, but most of their work still happens manually, in legacy technology or Excel. Banks, credit unions, and fintechs across the country use Kobalt to run third party due diligence, screen marketing collateral, and stay current with the ever\-changing regulatory landscape. Since our Series A, we've grown revenue more than 5x and work with some of the most notable names in financial services, including Chime, Upstart, and Affirm. **The Role** Engineers at Kobalt own products end\-to\-end, from understanding the customer problem and shaping the technical approach through building, shipping, and operating the solution in production. As a Full Stack Software Engineer, you'll build the core product experiences our customers use every day. Risk and compliance teams manage complex, highly structured workflows involving large amounts of data, documents, approvals, and collaboration. You'll figure out how to make those workflows fast and intuitive, then build the frontend and backend systems that make them work. This role is a good fit for an engineer who cares deeply about the product they're building: how information is structured, how users move through a workflow, where complexity belongs, and how the underlying technical design enables a great experience. **What You'll Do** * Build and ship new product features end\-to\-end across Kobalt's frontend and backend. * Own major features from technical design through launch, working closely with other engineers and Customer Success. * Build intuitive user experiences for complex risk and compliance workflows. * Develop AI\-powered features that help customers automate work that has historically been manual. * Improve the performance, reliability, and architecture of our application as we scale. * Work directly with customers to understand how they use Kobalt and turn their feedback into better products. **Qualifications** * 3\+ years of software engineering experience building production web applications. * Strong experience building modern, interactive frontend applications and the backend systems that support them. * Excellent product and UX judgment, particularly for complex or data\-dense applications. * Strong understanding of frontend architecture, application state, APIs, data modeling, and relational databases. * Ability to take a product problem from initial concept through technical design, implementation, and production. * High attention to detail and a strong bar for the quality, performance, and usability of what you ship. **Compensation and Benefits** * $250k base salary \+ equity, with equity based on experience and scope * Lunch provided in\-office * 100% employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for employees and dependents * Paid time off and paid company holidays

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer (SF/NY)
jobs.description: **About Ode with Anthropic** ============================ How do you turn a decades\-old dataset into an industry\-leading medical coding agent? Teach an AI receptionist to book appointments in Spanish? Automatically generate working data connectors from API docs? Build agents that write, test, and deploy their own software packages? Anthropic is defining frontier AI. Ode is the team bringing frontier AI into practice. We are a team of experienced builders who care deeply about getting complex AI systems into production, with strong conviction about what makes them succeed. As Anthropic’s services venture, we tackle the hardest, most consequential AI problems for companies with real stakes, working closely with their Applied AI and Product teams to turn frontier technology into real world impact. We're backed by Anthropic, Blackstone, Hellman \& Friedman, Goldman Sachs, General Atlantic, Leonard Green \& Partners, Apollo Global Management, GIC, and Sequoia Capital. We're headquartered in SF with offices in NYC, Raleigh\-Durham, and Dubai. **The Role** ============ This role is designed for former engineering leaders (IC or EM) or founders who are comfortable owning end\-to\-end technical outcomes but specifically want to continue being impactful as individual contributors and spend more time in the code. You'll work on a small, high\-caliber team (2–5 engineers and a PM) building AI products for our clients. You'll set technical direction, write code, and be the person the team looks to when something is hard. You'll spend roughly 75% of your time in code and 25% working directly with clients — often their CTOs — understanding problems, walking through tradeoffs, and making sure what we’re building meets their needs. Most engineers take a decade to see this range of hard problems across this many domains. Here, you'll do it in your first year. To make this possible, we are religious about being the best company in the world to learn Applied AI engineering practices. **What You Bring** ================== * **8\+ years of engineering experience, with deep care for the craft.** You've shipped multiple complete products end\-to\-end and write elegant, production\-ready code across multiple disciplines. * **Specific interest in applying software engineering fundamentals to AI systems.** You care about balancing frontier model capabilities with good system design. * **Comfort talking with senior technical stakeholders.** You navigate conversations skillfully, and care about people using what you build. * **High ownership mindset.** You jump in without instruction, embrace a "no job too big, no job too small" mindset, and want to shape strategy and culture. * **Low ego, high integrity.** You help others and ask for help. You hold a high bar for honesty–with yourself and your team. **Our Engineering Philosophy** ============================== We have a distinct approach to building AI systems: applying standard software engineering discipline to the non\-deterministic world of frontier AI. We design systems around testable hypotheses, curate durable data sets, and ensure what we ship keeps working long after we've handed it over. After shipping 30\+ AI products, we have strong opinions on what makes AI products succeed and how to get them into production. We think you'll find it refreshing if you've seen how most companies approach AI. **How Ode Is Different** ======================== A typical engineer here ships two to three products per year and learns from dozens more. You have outsized autonomy on each product — but you won't have a year to polish a single system. The upside is constant time on the frontier of models and tooling, and a muscle for AI product development that's hard to build anywhere else. Most engineers look back at this as the biggest growth period of their career. But it's possible you won't like it — we recommend using the interview process to hear what our engineers think. **Our Values** ============== * **Overdeliver**: We are writing the playbook on how to create enterprise value with LLMs, and building our reputation as the world’s best applied AI team. * **Overuse AI:** We obsessively explore and experiment with Claude to push the frontier of applied AI and share what we learn with our teammates. * **Over”engineer” the Culture:** We’re building a culture that attracts and retains top applied AI talent, and we stress test large decisions through the perspective of our world class builders. **Location** ============ **San Francisco, CA** **New York, NY** Work Arrangement: 4 days in\-person, Fridays remote **Benefits** ============ * Competitive Compensation Package: Attractive salary aligned with your experience and skills. * 401k with Matching: Invest in your future with our company\-matched retirement plan. * Unlimited PTO: Take the time you need to relax and rejuvenate. * Exceptional Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Comprehensive health benefits to keep you and your family healthy. * Health FSA: Manage out\-of\-pocket health expenses effectively. * Commuter Benefits: Make your travel to work easier and more affordable. * Life Insurance: Providing peace of mind for you and your loved ones. * Team Events and Activities: Regular events to build camaraderie and a strong team spirit. **Ready to join us?** ===================== Compensation Range: $275K \- $400K

jobs.description: **About Stratus** Stratus® is an integrated, multi\-disciplinary engineering, architecture, interior design, and consulting firm. Consistently ranking among the Top 500 Design Firms in Engineering News\-Record, the firm offers a deep bench of industry experts through a highly collaborative approach, delivering innovative solutions across the full project lifecycle. Operating coast to coast, Stratus® serves clients nationwide while maintaining a strategic commitment to supporting high\-growth economies and building vibrant communities that foster the professional growth of its team. Stratus® designs spaces, systems, and solutions that perform, endure, and make an impact, delivering on our promise of Better Plans. contractor, and other project partners. **Qualifications** *Required** Currently enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree program in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or a related field. * RISA, RAM, Mathcad, or similar analysis and design software. * Involvement in ASCE, SEI, or related engineering organizations. **Why you’ll love Stratus*** A team\-oriented environment that values jobs.title: System Integrator Intern – I – Critical Infrastructure
jobs.description: Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS \& EPMS solutions for mission\-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program\-level governance. Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high\-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything. **Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.** **Position Title:** System Integrator Intern – I – Critical Infrastructure **Position Location:** Remote \- work virtually from anywhere in the United States, Atlanta, GA, or Dallas, TX **Summer 2027 Internship Dates: May 17th, 2027\- August 13th, 2027** **JOB SUMMARY** The System Integration Intern supports the installation, startup, testing, commissioning, and deployment of Building Automation Systems (BAS), Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS), PLC, and SCADA systems on mission\-critical infrastructure projects. This is a hands\-on field\-focused internship designed for students and early\-career individuals interested in industrial automation, controls, commissioning, and system integration. Interns will work alongside experienced System Integrators, Controls Engineers, and SCADA Engineers to learn how physical equipment, field devices, PLCs, networks, and software systems operate together. Interns will gain experience working at the intersection of controls hardware, industrial networking, PLCs, SCADA software, and field deployment activities. The role serves as a bridge between physical system installation and software implementation, helping interns understand how automation systems are deployed, validated, commissioned, and supported in real\-world environments. This position includes significant project\-site exposure and provides opportunities to participate in construction, startup, testing, commissioning, deployment, and Integrated Systems Testing (IST) activities. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** **Installation, Startup \& Field Support** * Assist with verification of controls installations and field wiring * Support point\-to\-point checkout and I/O verification activities * Assist with startup and testing of BAS, EPMS, PLC, and SCADA systems * Help verify field devices, sensors, actuators, instrumentation, and network communications * Support troubleshooting efforts during startup and commissioning activities * Document field observations, deficiencies, and corrective actions **Testing \& Commissioning** * Participate in system startup, commissioning, and Integrated Systems Testing (IST) activities * Assist with execution of test procedures and validation of system operation * Support functional testing of equipment and control sequences * Help verify system operation against project requirements and sequences of operation * Assist with owner demonstrations and turnover activities when appropriate **Controls \& Automation Exposure** * Gain exposure to Rockwell Automation PLC platforms and industrial control systems * Assist with PLC startup, troubleshooting, and communications testing * Learn SCADA fundamentals, including Ignition 8\.3 deployment and operation * Learn software deployment, gateway administration, and system validation practices * Gain exposure to industrial communication protocols including Ethernet/IP, Modbus, BACnet, MQTT, and OPC UA * Assist with validating connectivity between PLCs, SCADA systems, databases, APIs, and enterprise applications * Gain exposure to operational technology (OT) and information technology (IT) integration concepts * Learn how industrial protocols are used to integrate PLCs, SCADA systems, BAS systems, EPMS systems, field devices, and enterprise applications **Technical Documentation \& Digital Tools** * Complete daily reports, field notes, issue logs, and testing documentation * Assist with updating redlines, as\-built documentation, and punch lists * Use Microsoft Office and digital project tools to organize project information * Gain exposure to Git, Azure DevOps, and software development workflows * Utilize approved AI\-enabled tools to improve reporting, documentation, and learning **Technical Growth \& Development** * Participate in Ignition 8\.3 training with the potential opportunity to earn an Ignition Core Certification * Participate in OSHA 10 safety training and other professional development opportunities as applicable * Learn commissioning, startup, deployment, and troubleshooting best practices from experienced field personnel * Gain practical exposure to mission\-critical infrastructure environments * Participate in technical training, toolbox talks, and project coordination meetings * Demonstrate continuous improvement through feedback, learning, and hands\-on experien  met by the employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Frequently standing, walking, climbing ladders, and working in active construction environments * Working in mechanical rooms, electrical rooms, rooftops, and confined spaces * Lifting and carrying equipment weighing up to 50 pounds * Working in varying environmental conditions, including heat, cold, humidity, dust, noise, and outdoor weather * Using hand tools, test equipment, laptops, and instrumentation for extended periods * Traveling to customer sites and working extended hours during project startup and commissioning activities as required **TRAVEL / RELOCATION REQUIREMENTS** * Approximately 50–75% travel is required based on project assignments * Travel may include overnight stays, extended assignments at customer project sites, and temporary relocation for the duration of major construction projects * Employees who reside within a reasonable commuting distance of the assigned project site will be expected to travel to and from the site daily rather than utilize overnight accommodations * Must possess and maintain a valid driver's license and be able to travel by automobile and commercial air as required * Availability to work extended schedules, weekends, holidays, and multiple shifts during critical project milestones, startup, commissioning, and Integrated Systems Testing (IST) **EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS** * Currently pursuing or recently completed technical education in: o Industrial Automation o Electrical Engineering o Mechanical Engineering o Controls Engineering o Engineering Technology o Computer Engineering o Industrial Technology o A related technical discipline **BENEFITS** *Smart Tech Contracting offers a very competitive benefits package; highlights include* * Choice of comprehensive medical plans (including two PPO\-style plans and a HDHP w/ HSA option) * Dental and vision plans * Comprehensive medical, dental and vision benefits extended to spouse / domestic partner and dependent children up to age 26 * 401k with company match and self\-directed brokerage account option * PTO including additional paid time off during the last week of the year * Company paid life insurance coverage for employees and their eligible dependents * Short and long\-term disability, AD\&D coverage * Professional development opportunities, tuition reimbursement and professional licensing assistance * Paid parental leave after one year of employment CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC residents only: In accordance with CO, CA, IL, NY, WA, and Washington DC law, the range provided is STC's reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount may differ based on non\-discriminatory factors such as experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location. Smart Tech Contracting is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and participates in the E\-Verify program with the Department of Homeland Security. We encourage diversity in our workforce. Are you ready to challenge yourself and redefine standards in the AEC industry? Apply now and join our award\-winning team! **NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:** STC does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to STC in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where STC has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of STC and STC will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service. **The pay range for this role is:** 27\.50 \- 27\.50 USD per hour(Remote (United States))

jobs.description: **Category/Area of Expertise:** IT \& Technology **Job Requisition:** 549022 **Address:** USA\-NC\-Salisbury\-2110 Executive Drive **Store Code:** Infrastructure \- Network (5118702\) Ahold Delhaize USA, a division of global food retailer Ahold Delhaize, is part of the U.S. family of brands, which includes five leading omnichannel grocery brands \- Food Lion, Giant Food, The GIANT Company, Hannaford and Stop \& Shop. Our core office locations include Salisbury, NC.** **Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis.** **Duties and Responsibilities** * Own and maintain enterprise wireless engineering standards, approved configurations, implementation requirements, and technical design criteria in alignment with established enterprise architecture. * Review, validate, and approve enterprise wireless network designs developed by internal teams and external partners. * Evaluate wireless designs for RF coverage, capacity, roaming, interference, security, scalability, resiliency, and performance. * Review and approve site surveys, predictive designs, heat maps, access point placement, capacity models, and related implementation documentation. * Establish wireless design criteria and provide technical direction to partners, project teams, and internal stakeholders. * Serve as the internal subject\-matter expert for enterprise wireless engineering, technologies, standards, and best practices. * Provide technical governance and evaluate exceptions to established wireless standards and reference architectures. * Engineer and support enterprise wireless management, monitoring, assurance, and troubleshooting capabilities using Aruba Central. * Use and support Cisco Catalyst Center for network visibility, assurance, automation, analytics, and troubleshooting. * Lead wireless capacity planning, performance tuning, RF optimization, lifecycle planning, and resiliency testing. * Develop and support automation for configuration deployment, validation, compliance, monitoring, and operational workflows. * Support enterprise network security practices including segmentation, secure wireless access, authentication, role\-based access, and zero\-trust principles. * Lead technical troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis for complex wireless and network incidents. * Coordinate with Network Operations, Security, Infrastructure, vendors, and managed service partners during major incidents and problem\-management activities. * Evaluate new wireless technologies, platforms, features, and capabilities and make recommendations for enterprise adoption. * Support broader enterprise networking initiatives involving LAN/WAN, routing, switching, network services, and network operations as needed. * Mentor engineers, provide technical leadership, and contribute to the development of engineering skills across the team. * Develop and maintain engineering standards, implementation requirements, technical documentation, operational procedures, and runbooks. * May be called upon to support critical escalations and must be available during urgent IT incidents as needed. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience. * 8\+ years of enterprise network engineering experience, including significant experience focused on wireless engineering, design, architecture, and support. * Advanced knowledge of enterprise wireless technologies, including RF fundamentals, coverage and capacity planning, roaming, interference, channel planning, authentication, security, and troubleshooting. * Demonstrated experience reviewing, validating, and approving large\-scale enterprise wireless designs, including partner\-developed solutions. * Hands\-on experience with Aruba wireless technologies and Aruba Central. * Experience with Cisco Catalyst Center and Cisco enterprise networking technologies. * Strong understanding of routing, switching, VLANs, network segmentation, authentication, and enterprise network security. * Experience with automation or scripting for network configuration, validation, compliance, or operational workflows. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to lead resolution of complex technical problems. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to provide technical direction across internal teams, vendors, and business stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with wireless survey and design platforms such as Ekahau, Hamina, AirMagnet, or equivalent. * Experience supporting large\-scale, distributed, multi\-site enterprise wireless environments. * Aruba, Cisco, CWNP, or equivalent advanced wireless certifications. * Experience with location services, wireless analytics, IoT connectivity, and advanced wireless assurance capabilities. * Experience with software\-defined networking, APIs, automation, and network telemetry. * Familiarity with zero\-trust networking and identity\-based network access. * Experience providing technical governance and oversight of managed service providers and third\-party engineering partners. Salary Range NC: $146,960 \- $220,440 Actual compensation offered to a candidate may vary based on their unique qualifications and experience, internal equity, and market conditions. Final compensation decisions will be made in accordance with company policies and applicable laws. \#LI\-RC1 \#LI\-HYBRID At Ahold Delhaize USA, we provide services to one of the largest portfolios of grocery companies in the nation, and we're actively seeking top talent. We believe in collaboration, curiosity, and continuous learning in all that we think, create and do. While building a culture where personal and professional growth are just as important as business growth, we invest in our people, empowering them to learn, grow and deliver at all levels of the business.

Create P\&IDs including line numbers, equipment and instrument tags, etc. **Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** * **MUST be proficient in Plant 3D and Plant P\&ID.** * Create 3D solid models of equipment using pipe, rolled plate, nozzles, formed heads, wide flange beam, flat bar, round stock, etc. AutoCAD 3D. * Generate 2D fabrication drawings from 3D solid models. AutoCAD 3D. * Ensure dimensional accuracy of fabricated items. * Update drawings as appropriate during engineering and fabrication/assembly process as * Update existing drawings to reflect necessary changes or standardized drawing format required. * Coordinate with and consult other with upstream and downstream stakeholders to design, layout, or detail components to avoid supply chain, design, and fabrication issues. * Review and analyze proposals, specifications, sketches, and “go\-bys” to assess factors affecting component designs. * Lay out, draw, and reproduce illustrations for reference manuals and technical publications that describe operational maintenance on various components and/or machinery. * Utilize COMPRESS for vessel code calculations and extract data for vessel designs. * Perform cost analysis with an effort to reduce material and labor cost in the fabrication of equipment. * Model OEM components when OEM 3D models are not available. * Managed CAD part number and specification databases. * Interpret structural analysis reports and implement appropriately in design. * Utilize parametric design to minimize design modifications. * Interface with manufacturing personnel to improve shop efficiency through smart design principles. * Exhibit commitment to Company core values in all work activities. * Perform other duties as assigned. **Qualifications** * **MUST be proficient in Plant 3D and Plant P\&ID.** * 3\-5 years’ AutoCAD 3D experience required. * Associate degree (AA) or equivalent from two\-year college or technical school related to the field of Engineering. * 2\-3 years’ related experience and/or training; jobs.title: Principal Mechanical Engineer
jobs.description: **Introduction to the Job** --------------------------- In this role, you will serve as a principal technical leader for optomechanical architecture and design across new product development and sustaining engineering initiatives. You will collaborate closely with optical, mechanical, systems, controls, thermal, manufacturing, service, quality, and supplier teams to deliver stable, precise, reliable, and manufacturable optomechanical solutions throughout the product lifecycle. jobs.description: **Company Description** **About AbbVie** AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience \- and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at www.abbvie.com. Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube. **Job Description** AbbVie’s Business Technology Solutions (BTS) Information Research (IR) organization is seeking a Data Engineer, AI Enablement to help deliver trusted, well\-structured, AI\-ready data products within ARCH, AbbVie’s R\&D Convergence Hub. As part of the DELOS team — Data Exploration and Linked Outcome Solutions — this role helps build the reliable data foundations needed to advance analytics, reporting, knowledge graph capabilities, machine learning, and AI\-enabled use cases across R\&D. In this role, you will independently design, develop, and operate scalable data pipelines and curated data products that make high\-value research data easier to find, connect, understand, and use. The work spans data curation, normalization, modeling, metadata, lineage, quality controls, governance, documentation, and publication to the ARCH knowledge graph. Rather than developing AI models directly, you will ensure that data science, AI engineering, and research partners have the reliable, accessible, and appropriately governed data they need to deliver trusted outcomes. Working closely with R\&D stakeholders, data scientists, machine learning engineers, platform teams, architects, and data owners, you will help translate scientific and business needs into dependable data solutions. You will also help scale delivery by providing technical guidance to contracted engineers supporting the same data products, translating requirements into clear work, reviewing outputs, helping remove barriers, and ensuring results meet agreed quality, documentation, and acceptance standards. Under the direction of the Associate Director – Data Strategy, AI \& Knowledge Enablement, this role is an opportunity to contribute at the center of AbbVie’s R\&D data transformation. The data foundations you build will help determine which analytics, knowledge graph, and AI use cases are possible across research — and how confidently the organization can use their output to support scientific decision\-making. **Responsibilities** * **AI\-Ready Data Product Engineering:** Design, build, and operate curated, reusable data products that make high\-value R\&D data easier to find, connect, understand, and use. Collect, integrate, normalize, model, and transform data from databases, applications, APIs, licensed external sources, and other systems into ARCH and related data environments. * **Trusted Data Foundation Enablement:** Establish reliable, scalable data foundations that support analytics, reporting, knowledge graph capabilities, machine learning, and AI\-enabled use cases. Ensure data assets are structured, documented, accessible, governed, traceable, and fit for downstream consumption. * **AI, RAG \& Knowledge Graph Readiness:** Prepare data and documents for AI and knowledge discovery use cases by cleaning, standardizing, enriching, labeling, organizing metadata, supporting chunking, and embedding workflows, and producing vector database\-ready assets. Enable publication of curated data to the ARCH knowledge graph. * **Data Quality, Governance \& Documentation:** Apply data quality and governance practices, including accuracy and completeness checks, metadata, lineage, access controls, privacy, license terms, assumptions, quality rules, and appropriate\-use guidance so data consumers can understand and trust the assets they use. * **Technical Coordination \& Delivery Support:** Collaborate with data scientists, machine learning engineers, software engineers, platform teams, architects, data owners, and R\&D stakeholders to translate scientific and business requirements into usable AI\-ready data products. Provide technical guidance to contracted engineers, clarify work, review outputs, help remove barriers, and support delivery against agreed quality and acceptance standards. * **Operational Reliability \& Continuous Improvement:** Monitor pipeline performance, data freshness, cost, failures, and delivery issues; troubleshoot and resolve problems before they impact data consumers. Contribute to reusable engineering patterns, automation, process improvements, and consistent ways of working across data product workflows. * **Compliance \& Standards:** Follow applicable Corporate and Divisional policies, including GxP compliance, data security, software development lifecycle practices, data governance standards, and relevant regulatory or contractual requirements. **Qualifications** **Required: porting authority. * Strong communication, planning, and organizational skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts and keep stakeholders informed. * Data product engineering mindset, with the ability to shape reusable, well\-structured data assets that are practical, scalable, and fit for analytics and AI\-enabled use. * Data curation and stewardship mindset, with attention to quality, metadata, lineage, governance, standards, documentation, and appropriate use. * Technical fluency across data platforms, pipelines, integration patterns, orchestration, cloud environments, and data delivery practices sufficient to work effectively with engineering and platform teams. * Operational discipline across monitoring, troubleshooting, prioritization, issue resolution, automation, reusable patterns, and continuous improvement. * Technical coordination and influence, with the ability to clarify priorities, guide work, review outputs, resolve ambiguity, and coordinate across internal and external contributors. * Stakeholder communication, with the ability to frame tradeoffs, risks, dependencies, and progress in a clear and practical way for technical, scientific, and business audiences. **Preferred:** * Pharmaceutical or healthcare industry experience preferred. * Experience supporting research, discovery, translational, clinical, scientific, or other life sciences data environments. * Familiarity with graph databases, knowledge graphs, ontology\-based data structures, semantic data, metadata\-driven data products, or linked\-data concepts. * Experience working with AWS\-based, cloud\-based, lakehouse, or modern data platform technologies such as Databricks, Spark, Snowflake, Neo4j, or similar tools. * Experience working with regulated data environments, including data governance, documentation, security, privacy, license terms, or compliance expectations. * Exposure to analytics, machine learning, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, AI\-search patterns, or AI\-ready data product delivery. * Familiarity with Agile practices or planning tools such as Jira, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, prioritization, acceptance criteria, and delivery tracking. **Additional Information** Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: * The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it This range may be modified in the future. * We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees. * This job is eligible to participate in our short\-term incentive programs.
