jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer - AdTech
jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **Position Summary** We are seeking a highly skilled **Senior Data Engineer** to join our Data Engineering team to design, build, robust and scalable solutions to support data\-driven applications analytics and business intelligence solutions. You will partner closely with business stakeholders, analysts, product teams, and fellow engineers to engineer scalable, cloud\-native data pipelines. Leveraging the modern GCP data stackyou will own the full data lifecycle \- from data modeling and ETL/ELT development to performance tuning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement. **Location:** Must work a hybrid work schedule in one of our hub locations (Chicago area, Boston area, New York City, Dallas area, Phoenix area, Hartford CT, or Woonsocket RI). **Required Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience working with SQL and relational database management systems * 3\+ years of experience in Cloud Data Engineering Platforms such as AWS, GCP, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake etc. * 3\+ years of experience in on\-prem Data Engineering Platforms such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, Teradata etc. * Programming and modifying code in languages like SQL, Python, and PySpark to support and implement Cloud based and on\-prem data warehousing services. * Hands\-on experience with dimensional data modeling, schema design, and data warehousing * Hands\-on experience with troubleshooting data issues * Hands\-on experience with various performance improvement techniques * Willingness to identify and implement process improvements, and best practices as well as ability to take ownership to work within a fast\-paced, collaborative, and team\-based support environment * Excellent oral and written communication skills **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with data platforms such as BigQuery, Teradata, Snowflake, Azure, AWS, or GCP. * Experience supporting healthcare, pharmacy benefit management (PBM), or specialty pharmacy data environments. * Familiarity with real\-time data integration, CDC (Change Data Capture), or event\-driven data architectures. * Experience with workflow orchestration and automation tools. * Exposure to cloud migration initiatives and hybrid data architectures. * Experience with monitoring, observability, and operational support best practices. **Education** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field or equivalent work experience. **Anticipated Weekly Hours** 40**Time Type** Full time**Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $92,700\.00 \- $222,480\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. jobs.title: Lead AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Carzato** Carzato builds the digital retailing software that powers how people actually buy cars online. For eight years, our platform has run on dealer and OEM websites with configuration, financing, trade\-in valuation, and new vehicle reservations. Today it operates across more than 1,000 dealerships. Our next release rebuilds that experience around AI: natural\-language vehicle research and conversational search, grounded in live inventory, pricing, and incentive data. We've done the research, modeled the economics, and set the architecture. It launches early next year. That's the distribution problem most AI products never solve, and we already have 1,000\+ sites ready to run it on day one. What we need now is the engineer who builds it and the platform underneath it. **The Short Version** Carzato has been building automotive digital retailing software for eight years. Our next release is AI\-native, conversational vehicle research and search grounded in live inventory and pricing data. It's in active development now, launching early next year, and it ships across our entire dealer network at once. We're hiring a Lead AI Engineer to build it and own the platform beneath it. **What You'll Actually Do** * Design and build RAG pipelines against inventory and pricing data that changes daily , such as retrieval, chunking, grounding, re\-ranking * Own the AI platform architecture: model routing, provider integration, caching, fallback behavior * Build the backend services, APIs, and data infrastructure AI features depend on * Define evaluation and monitoring so we catch quality drift before dealers and shoppers feel it * Manage cost and latency as first\-class constraints , such as our volume, per\-session economics decide what's viable * Write specs and coordinate delivery with our offshore development team * Work directly with product, design, and leadership to move from validated direction to shipped product **What We Need From You** **Non\-negotiable:** * 3\-5 years shipping production software you were accountable for * Strong proficiency in Python and/or TypeScript * Real backend and system design depth: APIs, data modeling, distributed systems * Experience with a major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) * Production experience integrating LLMs or ML models into real applications * Working knowledge of RAG: embeddings, vector search, retrieval quality, grounding * Daily, substantive use of AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) in real work; you can describe specifically where they help and where they mislead * Comfort operating in a fast\-moving environment, and the judgment to know when to ask versus decide **Strong plus:** * LLM evaluation frameworks and systematic output quality measurement * Agentic workflows and multi\-step task automation * Vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma, pgvector) * Cost and latency optimization at production scale * Automotive, e\-commerce, or marketplace experience * ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow) * CS, Software Engineering, or related degree or an equivalent body of shipped work **Why This Seat:** * **You arrive before launch.** Most engineers join AI products already built by someone else. This one is yours from v1\. * **Distribution is already solved.** Over 1,000 dealer sites. Your work ships to the full network ; no growth hacking, no waiting for users. * **Technical ownership of a domain, not a ticket queue.** You set the AI architecture. No platform team to negotiate with, no committee between you and the decision. * **Eight years of stability, greenfield engineering.** Established company, real revenue, proven platform; and the AI stack is a blank page. * **Direct line to leadership.** You report to the VPs and Leadership. Short path from idea to decision. * **Remote, with real autonomy.** We measure output, not hours. **How We Work** Small, senior team. High autonomy, short feedback loops. We ship a working v1, put it in front of users, and iterate. We care about what's in production, not what's in the deck. We care more about engineering depth and demonstrated AI fluency than a specific credential list. If you're strong on fundamentals and you've been building seriously with LLMs, we want to talk. Pay: $140,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: **About Charta Health** ----------------------- In an industry where the focus should rightly be on delivering quality care to patients, healthcare providers remain burdened by the complexities of non\-clinical operations. Charta is changing that. We're building the operating system for modern healthcare organizations. Our AI platform streamlines critical workflows across revenue cycle, clinical operations, and administrative functions, helping providers and payers operate more efficiently and deliver better patient care. Backed by Bain Capital Ventures, Charta is on a mission to make every healthcare dollar accountable and every chart accurate, reimagining healthcare infrastructure from the ground up. ### **About the Opportunity** As a Software Engineering Intern, you will contribute to production systems that power AI\-driven workflows for healthcare providers. This role blends core software engineering with forward deployed problem\-solving, giving you exposure to both building scalable internal platforms and developing practical, customer\-facing solutions. You will work directly with healthcare providers to understand their unique challenges and translate them into practical, data\-driven solutions using AI and machine learning. This role requires a blend of technical expertise, problem\-solving skills, and a strong customer\-centric mindset. You will thrive in a dynamic environment, rapidly deploying and iterating on solutions to deliver immediate value. What you'll do: * Collaborate closely with healthcare clients to understand their workflows and identify opportunities to leverage AI and machine learning * Customize and deploy Charta Health's AI\-driven platforms to address specific client needs * Rapidly prototype and iterate on solutions, adapting to client feedback and evolving requirements * Break down complex projects into actionable steps and deliver results in ambiguous environments * Explore and integrate a wide range of AI/ML technologies, adapting to the diverse needs of our clients * Provide technical expertise and support to clients, ensuring successful deployment and adoption of our solutions * Work closely with our internal engineering team to provide feedback and contribute to product development * Design, build, and improve core platform systems that power analyses, data pipelines, and AI workflows across all customers * Contribute to scalable infrastructure and tooling that make deployments faster, more reliable, and easier to maintain * Help define internal engineering standards, abstractions, and reusable components that turn one\-off solutions into durable product capabilities * Stay up\-to\-date with the latest advancements in AI/ML and apply them alongside strong software engineering practices You'd be a great fit, if you have: * Proficiency and practical coding skills (Python and TypeScript), with a focus on delivering tangible results. * Solid understanding of common algorithms and data structures (e.g., arrays, linked lists, trees, hash tables) and practical ability to select and implement them appropriately. * Experience systematically isolating and diagnosing issues within code, leveraging debugging tools, log analysis, and stack traces effectively * Ability to efficiently navigate unfamiliar codebases, understand architectural patterns, and contribute quickly to existing projects. * Practical knowledge of writing and running unit and integration tests to verify code correctness. * Adaptability and the ability to quickly learn and master new technologies and concepts. * A priority on delivering business value over solving purely theoretical challenges. * A desire to explore a wide range of technologies and problems, rather than specializing in one area. * The ability to thrive in ambiguous environments and rapidly produce results. * The ability to excel at breaking down complex projects into actionable steps. * Resilience and resourcefulness, allowing you to overcome obstacles and find creative solutions. * Ambition and a desire for a high\-growth opportunity. * Strong emotional intelligence, excellent communication, and interpersonal skills. * Excitement about working with external customers and building strong relationships. * A genuine interest in the medical field and a passion for improving healthcare. * Completed at least your 2nd year of a Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical degree Nice\-to\-have: * Experience in a startup environment * Experience and/or demonstrated interest in healthcare * Experience with Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering. * Experience with neural networks and machine learning * Degree in Computer Science / Engineering or related field What we offer: * Competitive salary * Team dinners and snacks in the office to keep you at your best * Growth opportunities in a fast\-paced, innovative tech startup * Ongoing professional development and access to cutting\-edge AI and healthcare tools * Lively, in\-person work culture at our SF Headquarters or NYC office * $40–$60/hour based on experience **Our Commitment to Diversity** ------------------------------- We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Job Requisition 2021591 Technical Leader - CX Engineering Productivity
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 09/17/2026 \*\*\*This is a hybrid role and we are looking for candidates local to RTP, NC or San Jose, CA only\*\*\* Meet the Team The Engineering Productivity team makes Cisco CX Engineering faster, safer, and more effective at scale. We own the developer platform, build and test infrastructure, CI/CD, developer tooling, and AI\-assisted development — the systems every engineer touches from the first keystroke to production. We eliminate toil, shorten feedback loops, and build paved roads that engineers choose because they're the fastest way to ship. We're the connective tissue across Platform, Application, Product, Security, and Operations, and we bridge those silos through deep technical expertise, strong relationships, and a relentless focus on developer experience. If you thrive where your work directly determines how quickly and confidently engineers build, test, and release software — including AI/ML systems — and where you can shape technical strategy across the organization, this is the team for you. Your Impact As an Engineering Productivity Technical Leader, you'll serve as a key technical liaison and force multiplier across the organization: Strategic Leadership **Drive Productivity Strategy:** Shape technical strategy across the developer platform, CI/CD, build and test infrastructure, tooling, and AI\-assisted development — aligning initiatives with business objectives in an AI\-first world. **Build Bridges:** Connect Platform, Application, Product, Security, and Operations to find and remove the friction that slows engineers down, delivering solutions that transcend organizational boundaries. **Champion a Productivity Culture:** Evangelize measurement (DORA, SPACE), golden paths, and continuous improvement of the developer experience across traditional and AI/ML workflows. Technical Excellence **Build the Internal Developer Platform:** Design self\-service platforms, golden paths, and paved roads that let teams provision, build, and deploy without waiting on anyone. **Optimize the Inner Loop:** Deliver fast local and cloud development environments, dev containers, and quick feedback so engineers spend less time waiting and more time building. **Modernize CI/CD and Build Systems:** Deliver fast, reliable pipelines with build caching and incremental builds, merge queues, and quality gates that catch problems early without slowing delivery. **Instrument Developer Productivity:** Establish metrics and observability for the whole software delivery lifecycle — DORA metrics, cycle time, build and test health, and DevEx signals — so decisions are grounded in data. **Integrate AI into Development:** Bring AI code assistants, AI\-assisted review, test generation, and agentic development workflows into the everyday toolchain to accelerate productivity. **Ensure Platform Reliability:** Keep the productivity platform, CI/CD, and developer tooling themselves resilient and performant, with ambitious availability targets for the systems engineers depend on daily. Influence\& Collaboration **Partner Externally:** Build relationships with vendors, open\-source communities, and industry peers to stay ahead of emerging tools and bring innovations to Cisco. **Partner Internally:** Build relationships across Platform, Application, Security, Operations, and Product teams to understand technical and business needs. Gather and prioritize requirements from engineering and security stakeholders, run feedback loops on developer experience and tooling adoption, and lead technical reviews and knowledge\-sharing initiatives to drive continuous improvement in productivity, automation, and quality. **Mentor\& Develop:** Provide technical leadership and coaching, elevating capabilities in platform engineering, developer experience, and automation. **Stay Future\-Ready:** Keep abreast of emerging trends in developer productivity, platform engineering, build systems, and AI\-assisted and agentic development. Be ready to rapidly implement and iterate on cutting\-edge solutions that make engineers more productive. **Minimum Qualifications:** * 10\+ years in engineering productivity, developer platforms, DevOps, build/release, or infrastructure engineering with demonstrated technical leadership progression * BS or MS in Engineering, STEM or related field * Proven track record designing and implementing developer platforms, tooling, or CI/CD and build systems that serve multiple teams **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience building internal developer platforms, platform\-as\-a\-service offerings, or developer portals (e.g., Backstage) * Experience in productivity measurement and delivery practices, including DORA metrics, SLOs, quality gates, and CI/CD * Cross\-organizational influence with the ability to build consensus and drive adoption of technical strategies and tooling * Expertise with CI/CD and GitOps platforms (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, ArgoCD, Flux) and mode  and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. We are Cisco, and our power starts with you. jobs.title: Manager - Senior Lead Software Engineer, Development
jobs.description: Citrin Cooperman offers a dynamic work environment, fostering professional growth and collaboration. We’re continuously seeking talented individuals who bring a problem\-solving mindset, fresh perspectives, and sharp technical expertise. We know you have choices, so our team of collaborative, innovative professionals are ready to support your professional development. At Citrin Cooperman, we offer competitive compensation and benefits and most importantly, the flexibility to manage your personal and professional life to focus on what matters most to you! We are looking for a Senior/Lead Software Engineer to join our technology team in a remote role, supporting the firm's Audit \& Assurance practice. This is a senior individual\-contributor position for an engineer who owns hard problems end to end: shipping production software, integrating systems that were never designed to work together, and building the AI and agentic capabilities that are changing how our A\&A teams deliver. As the technical anchor for our most complex builds, you will set the engineering standard for a growing forward\-deployed team and bring critical build capability in\-house. Our internal engineering function is early in its journey, so you will help build it from the ground up, shaping the practices, architecture, and standards that are still being written, with an outsized hand in defining them. **Responsibilities:** * Own complex, cross\-system software solutions end to end, from architecture through production and ongoing support. * Design and ship AI and agentic solutions (LLM\-based automation, retrieval, and workflow orchestration) that meet production, security, and governance standards. * Set the technical bar for the team: architecture patterns, code quality, testing, CI/CD, and documentation. * Partner with functional and product owners to turn business problems into durable solutions, not one\-off fixes. * Ensure every build meets the firm's data integrity, enterprise architecture, security, privacy, and regulatory standards. * Operate hands\-on across the full stack, moving between deep problem\-solving, architecture, and stakeholder translation as the work requires. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent hands\-on experience. * 7\+ years building and shipping production software, with a track record of owning complex systems end to end. * Deep hands\-on engineering with a modern stack (JavaScript/TypeScript, C\#, Next.js, Python, or similar), plus fluency in SQL. * Proven experience designing and integrating across disparate systems and APIs * Hands\-on experience deploying on cloud platforms such as Google Cloud, Azure, AWS, and similar. * Hands\-on experience building AI or agentic solutions in production (LLM integration, retrieval, orchestration, or automation) with the judgment to do it safely at enterprise scale. * Hands\-on experience working with LLMs via API (OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, and similar), including prompt design, tool/function calling, and managing cost, latency, and reliability tradeoffs. * Experience with, and a point of view on, modern AI\-assisted development using tools like Cursor, Claude Code, and similar, and how to apply them to move faster without sacrificing quality. * Strong software engineering jobs.description: **THIS IS A NON\-CIVIL SERVICE POSITION** **Salary Range:** ***$137,909\.00 \- $227,648\.00 Annually*** **Get to Know Us** Welcome to the City of Baltimore! Experience the reward of a fulfilling career and enjoy the added element of excitement in a vibrant, diverse atmosphere. The City of Baltimore offers limitless opportunities to help drive social impact, both on the job and in the community, while serving its citizens. Join us in making Baltimore a great place to live and work. In the City of Baltimore, we hire great people and provide them with the skills and opportunities to grow toward their career aspirations. If you are looking for a career change or interested in learning more, explore our opportunities and benefits programs. We are excited to have you as a part of the City of Baltimore Team! The city offers medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, optional life, AD\&D, and FSA plans. This office also supplies wellness programs, support groups, and workshops. You can learn about our benefits here: https://humanresources.baltimorecity.gov/hr\-divisions/benefits **Job Description** The Deputy Chief Information Officer (Technology) serves as BCIT’s senior technical executive, responsible for leading the City’s enterprise technology environment across Applications, Information Security, Infrastructure, Public Safety Services \& Emergency Communications, and Digital Services. This role supports the CIO by providing strategic direction, establishing enterprise architecture and cybersecurity governance, and ensuring the reliability, security, and modernization of all major technology platforms. The Deputy CIO (Technology) oversees mission‑critical systems, guides major capital and operating investments, leads technical succession planning, and ensures technology initiatives align with citywide priorities and resident‑focused service delivery. This position is essential to maintaining a secure, modern, and resilient technology foundation for Baltimore City. **About the Opportunity** The Baltimore City Office of Information \& Technology (BCIT) is seeking a seasoned technology executive to serve as its Deputy Chief Information Officer (Technology). Reporting directly to the Chief Information Officer, the Deputy CIO (Technology) serves as the senior technical executive of BCIT and is the CIO's principal deputy for the design, delivery, security, and reliability of the City's technology environment. In this role, the Deputy CIO (Technology) provides unified leadership across BCIT's technology portfolio , spanning Applications, Information Security, Infrastructure, Public Safety Services \& Emergency Communications, and Digital Services. The Deputy CIO (Technology) is responsible for integrating these functions into a secure, modern, and highly reliable technology platform that supports the daily operations of Baltimore City government and the delivery of resident\-facing services. This leader will bring both deep technical expertise and strong executive judgment to ensure BCIT's technology divisions operate with excellence, security, and resilience while aligning every function to BCIT's mission, values, and citywide priorities set by Mayor Brandon Scott. **Essential Functions** *Executive Leadership \& Deputy CIO Functions* * Serve as the CIO's principal technology deputy , acting on behalf of the CIO in their absence and representing BCIT in interagency, mayoral, and public\-facing engagements as directed. * Provide unified strategic and operational leadership across all divisions reporting to this role, including Applications, Information Security, Infrastructure, Public Safety Services \& Emergency Communications, and Digital Services. * Translate the CIO's strategic direction into technical architecture, engineering standards, and measurable performance targets across the Technology portfolio. * Serve as a senior member of BCIT's executive leadership team, contributing to agencywide strategy, culture, and organizational effectiveness. * Champion a culture of security\-mindedness, engineering excellence, continuous improvement, and inclusive leadership across all supervised divisions. * Represent BCIT before the City Council, oversight bodies, and mayoral leadership as directed—including participating in budget hearings, responding to audit findings, and briefing legislative committees on technology and cybersecurity matters. *Enterprise Architecture, Technology Strategy \& Governance* * Collaborate with the CIO and Deputy CIO (Operations) to develop and execute BCIT's strategic plan and technology roadmap. * Establish and maintain enterprise architecture standards and technology governance frameworks that ensure consistency, interoperability, and security across all Technology divisions. * Evaluate emerging technologies and technical directions, advising the CIO on investments that position the City to modernize services and improve operational effectiveness. * Serve as a key participant in the IT Cit orking closely with cybersecurity, enterprise architecture, or infrastructure functions, including governance, risk management, and standards enforcement. Experience overseeing systems supporting public safety, emergency communications, or other mission\-critical, high\-availability operations is strongly preferred. Demonstrated experience leading enterprise application, infrastructure, or digital modernization initiatives in a complex organization. Experience in a government or large public\-sector institution preferred ***OR*** ***Equivalency Notes:*** An equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered. Non\-supervisory experience or education may not be substituted for the required supervisory experience. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Exceptional executive leadership and technical management skills, with a proven ability to lead multiple complex technology divisions simultaneously. * Deep technical fluency across enterprise applications, cybersecurity, network and systems infrastructure, and digital service delivery, with the ability to engage credibly with engineers and executives alike. * Strong knowledge of cybersecurity governance, including identity and access management, vulnerability management, security operations, and incident response practices. * Strong working knowledge of enterprise architecture, application rationalization, and IT portfolio governance, including the ability to evaluate technical roadmaps and enforce standards across a diverse technology environment. * Experience overseeing mission\-critical, high\-availability systems—particularly those supporting public safety and emergency communications—with an understanding of the heightened resilience and security requirements involved. * Strong people leadership skills—able to develop, inspire, coach, and hold accountable a diverse team of senior technical managers and directors; demonstrated commitment to succession planning and building leadership depth. * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical matters for n on \-technical leaders hip such as elected officials, City Council, oversight bodies, agency executives, and the public. * Demonstrated ability to manage organizational change at a senior executive level, including building buy\-in, navigating political complexity, and sustaining momentum through technology transitions. * Strong fiscal and contract management acumen, including experience overseeing large\-scale technology budgets and complex vendor relationships across multiple divisions. * Experience identifying and managing enterprise technology and cybersecurity risk, with the ability to develop mitigation strategies and maintain continuity of critical systems. * Proven commitment to equity, inclusion, and resident\-centered digital service delivery. **Additional Information** **Background Check** Eligible candidates under final consideration for appointment to positions identified as positions of trust will be required to complete authorization for a Criminal Background Check and/or Fingerprint must be successfully completed. **Probation** All persons, including current City employees, selected for this position must complete a mandatory six\-month/1\-year probation. Applicants requiring accommodations during the hiring process should contact the Department of Human Resources directly. Do not attach your request for accommodation to the application. **BALTIMORE CITY IS AN EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

We are not just looking for someone who knows a single telecom technology—we are looking for a distributed systems engineer who has built large\-scale, high\-concurrency communications platforms where milliseconds matter. Distributed Backend \& Next\-Gen Architecture (Go)** * Architect, write, and maintain production\-grade microservices in **Go (Golang)** to power Convoso's next\-generation SaaS platform. * Design high\-throughput, low\-latency distributed systems that seamlessly coordinate call routing, reporting, AI processing, and customer data synchronization across services. * Utilize modern messaging and event\-streaming technologies (NATS, JetStream, Kafka) to handle massive event volumes reliably and asynchronously. #### **2\. Real\-Time Telephony \& Media Pipeline** * Build, scale, and optimize real\-time voice and communication pipelines using FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, SIPGo, Pion WebRTC, Asterisk, and RTPengine. * Manage high\-concurrency Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) traffic, media streaming, and call control logic with ultra\-low latency constraints. * Interface directly with carrier infrastructure to ensure high call quality, instant call placement, and fault\-tolerant voice routing. #### **3\. High\-Performance Data Engineering \& Analytics** * Work with high\-performance, large\-scale database architectures tailored for both transactional workloads (**PostgreSQL**) and massive operational analytics (**ClickHouse**). * Optimize system queries, data structures, and state management to ensure real\-time reporting and dashboard responsiveness under heavy load. #### **4\. Scalability, Performance \& Cloud Operations** * Identify bottlenecks across real\-time pipelines and optimize code, networking, and memory allocation for maximum speed and resource efficiency. * Deploy, operate, and support resilient software across large\-scale cloud production environments with high uptime requirements. * Participate in system design reviews, promote software engineering best practices, and collaborate closely with product and infrastructure teams. **Who You Are:** #### **Technical Stack \& Domain Expertise** * **Primary Language:** Professional experience building large\-scale, high\-concurrency backend software in Go (Golang). * **Real\-Time Communication Stack:** Hands\-on experience with real\-time communications platforms and protocols, including FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, SIPGo, Pion WebRTC, Asterisk, or RTPengine. * **Distributed Event Streaming:** Proven track record building event\-driven architectures using NATS, JetStream, or Apache Kafka. * **Database Mastery:** Experience operating both relational databases (PostgreSQL) and analytical column\-oriented databases (ClickHouse) at scale. * **Networking \& Protocols:** Working command of SIP, WebRTC media streams, network packet flow, and core telephony concepts. #### **Core Architectural Competencies** * **Distributed Systems Design:** Proven experience architecting systems composed of many interdependent microservices operating at high velocity. * **Real\-Time Performance Focus:** Demonstrated track record building software where ultra\-low latency is critical (e.g., immediate call connection, sub\-second event processing). * **System Scalability:** Experience scaling production infrastructure to seamlessly support rapid growth in users, events, and concurrent traffic. * **Target Backgrounds:** Backgrounds from communication platforms and CPaaS providers (e.g., Twilio, SignalWire, Telnyx, or similar high\-scale VoIP/telecom ecosystems) are highly desirable. ### **WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE** * You focus on solving complex platform engineering problems over simply checking technology boxes. * You bring a deep curiosity for high\-performance systems and enjoy building infrastructure that processes millions of real\-time interactions daily. * You write clean, scalable Go code that strengthens the reliability, speed, and capability of Convoso's flagship product suite. **Work Perks Worth The Hype:** * Competitive compensation package * Stock options * 100% covered premiums for employees; Medical, Dental, Basic life insurance, Long term disability * Affordable Vision plan and optional FSA * PTO, Paid Sick Time, Holidays, Bereavement time, Parental Leave * Your birthday off * 401k program with generous company match * No cost Employee Assistance Program and Travel Assistance * Monthly Gym membership reimbursement * Monthly credits toward food \& beverage * Company Outings * On and offsite team building events * Paid training for departments * Apple laptop (most roles) * And a team of highly experienced and kind colleagues! HQ Office: * Casual office environment \& dress * Daily catered lunches * Fully stocked kitchen (Dietary restriction\-friendly) * Happy Hours * On\-site Car Wash * Free Parking **Compensation:** The base salary range is: $190,000 \- $210,000 The Base Pay Range for this position is based on the industry benchmark for position, function, level and the company's compensation strategies. However, final offers may vary from the amount listed based on geography, candidate experience and expertise, and other objective business. Convoso's compensation package also includes equity for all eligible U.S full time roles and exceptional benefits, including generous 401k match. **Your California Privacy Rights:** As a California resident who is an applicant to be an employee of Convoso, you have certain rights under California law with respect to information collected by Convoso in the course and scope of its evaluation of your application. Born out of an obsession to make shopping, eating, and living easier than ever, we're collectively disrupting the multi\-billion\-dollar commerce industry from the ground up. At our core, we are bold and ambitious people that like to get our hands dirty and make a hands\-on impact. At Coupang, you will see yourself, your colleagues, your team, and the company grow every day. Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always\-on, high\-tech, and hyper\-connected world. **Job Overview:** As our Sr. Staff Backend Engineer for the Inventory and Promise Platform team, you will empower Coupang Fulfillment \& Transportation to operate faster, better, and cheaper through modern, reliable, and data\-driven technologies. In this role, you will be a key contributor to an area of the business that is rapidly expanding and is recognized for its Rocket Delivery service. The team already builds services that process thousands of requests per second, generate trillions of won annually in business decisions, and manage business rules that move millions of products. We are responsible for improving order coordination with technology to deliver products to millions of online shoppers. The role will involve technical leadership on rearchitecting and building a brand new Inventory and Promise platform which powers customer's shopping experience by giving inventory visibility to the customer to be able to order and gives out promised delivery dates for their order. Additionally, the platform also powers fulfillment orchestration once an order is placed. **Key Responsibilities:** * Serve as a technical lead on our most demanding, cross\-functional projects involving Inventory and Promise. * Independently come up with quality architecture and design of systems for new microservices and machine learning pipelines. * Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straightforward solutions. * Possess expert knowledge in performance, scalability, enterprise distributed architecture, and engineering best practices. * Assist in the career development of others, actively mentoring individuals and the community on advanced technical issues and helping managers guide the career growth of their team members. * Exert technical influence over multiple teams, increasing their productivity and effectiveness by sharing your deep knowledge and experience. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Math, or a closely related field * 10\+ years of experience in backend software development * Demonstrated experience in building and maintaining highly available, distributed systems **Preferred:** * Experience with scalable distributed systems and understanding of machine learning algorithms. * Strong understanding of backend scalable software architecture, distributed systems, and message\-oriented architecture. * Experience with full\-stack, high\-scale production systems with fault\-tolerance and monitoring. * Experience with building stream\-processing systems, using solutions such as Kafka and Spark\-Streaming. * Data caching and storage techniques and creating distributed software architectures with horizontal scale. * Operationalizing software in a large\-scale environment with high availability requirements. * Experience in the eCommerce domain involved in supply chain systems around Inventory and Promise. * Software development experience with Java, Scala, and Python. * Experience with AWS; jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two\-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on\-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity. The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments. This is a Sr. Software Development Engineer (SDE) role in the CTIO team that delivers the cutting edge innovation for our sensor (lightweight agent) for Linux, Windows, and Mac OS platforms. The Sr. SDE’s in the team own design and development of core features on the platform. Features will cross\-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking. Many features are also built in a way that they will have shared components across Linux, Windows, and MacOS. The team operates under the Agile development principles and ships frequently. The CTIO team at CrowdStrike is responsible for defining and executing the company's technology vision and strategy, driving innovation and overseeing the development and evolution of the Falcon platform. The CTIO ensures CrowdStrike maintains its position as a technology leader by fostering engineering excellence, aligning technical capabilities with business objectives, and anticipating emerging threats and market trends. **What You’ll Do:** * Collaborate with all the sensor development teams, across the company, on architecture and strategic initiatives. * Conceptualize and develop new product features. * Provide guidance and support to development teams in designing and implementing software for cross\-platform delivery (Windows, macOS, Linux). * Take ownership of features throughout the entire lifecycle, from initial design to final delivery, including presenting product demonstrations at the conclusion of each sprint. * Engage in cross\-functional collaboration with teams situated in various locations. **What You’ll Need:** * Deep knowledge of C/C\+\+. * Extensive, fundamental understanding of Linux, Windows, OR Mac OS internals. * Proven experience in debugging memory corruption issues, process contentions, and system performance bottlenecks. * Demonstrated experience collaborating with teams to successfully deliver major features and releases. * Ability to lead, mentor, communicate, collaborate, and operate effectively within a geographically distributed team. * Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes. **Bonus Points:** * Demonstrated strong background in developing scalable, light\-weight, and highly performing systems * jobs.title: Lab Test Technician
jobs.description: The Test Technician works in the testing lab setting up and running performance tests on Culligan water treatment products using their understanding and experience in the use of common tools, test equipment, instrumentation and test setup practices. The Test Technician performs functions that lead to the improvement or recertification of current products and the development and launch of new products and components. This role reports to the Engineering Manager but works independently or in conjunction with Test Engineers to plan and accomplish goals. **Responsibilities:** * Assemble test units and test equipment in the testing lab. * Perform industry standard and lightly customized tests from sketches and schematics. * Perform multiple testing projects simultaneously. * Collect samples and measurements according to the Standard Operating Procedures. * Manage multiple performance tests simultaneously. * Report accurate and timely testing results in laboratory notebooks and computer databases. * Prepare reports as requested based on collected data. * Handle and dispose of chemical solutions under supervision of Engineering Manager. * Maintain Standard Operating Procedures to support current processes. * Follow established safety guidelines and properly maintain safety equipment. * Sustain, clean and keep lab organized. * Develop moderately complex automation deployments within the lab. * Propose and implement 5S organization improvements. * Assist Test Engineers in test project planning as needed. * Develop technical competency in the understanding and application of Culligan standard product technologies and Culligan products. * Perform other tasks as needed. **Requirements:** * Associates Degree or higher in Engineering Technology or Test Engineering preferred * 2\+ years experience carrying out test plans in a laboratory environment. * Proficient in MS Word and Excel. * Entry\-level knowledge or ability to learn basis of automation for lab software deployment * Basic data analysis skills. * Mechanically inclined and have hands\-on build and test experience. * Ability to do basic plumbing and electrical wiring * Effective communication and presentation skills with the ability to work collaboratively within a team. * Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and stand for long periods of time **Competencies:** To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies in this position. *Resourcefulness Detail Oriented Analytical \& Troubleshooting Skills* *Initiative Organization/Planning Oral \& Written Communication* *Self\-Starter Team Player Judgement/Decision Making* *Target Salary Range: $55,000 – $70,000 salary a year. Exact pay will be based on factors including, but not limited to relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, level, geographic location, and business and organizational needs. Full\-time positions are eligible for competitive benefits, including paid time off, health, dental, vision, life, disability benefits and 401(k).* *\#LI\-LV2* Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: We are looking for a talented **Product Engineer** to join our team specializing in **Engineering** in **Columbus, IN.** **In this role, you will make an impact in the following ways:** * Drive product quality and reliability by investigating technical issues, identifying root causes, recommending corrective actions, and owning problem resolution through completion. * Support successful product development and support programs by executing key business processes within Product Preceding Technology (PPT), Value Package Introduction (VPI), and Current Product Support (CPS). * Apply structured engineering methodologies such as ESW, iDFMEA, FIRG, design reviews, and 7\-step problem solving to improve decision\-making and reduce product risk. * Influence quality product decisions by collaborating with technical managers, project leaders, manufacturing engineers, suppliers, and other stakeholders to provide data\-driven recommendations. * Advance projects effectively by using engineering knowledge and sound judgment to make decisions related to testing, analysis, project execution, and cross\-functional coordination. * Take ownership of increasingly complex components, systems, and products, resolving technical challenges while balancing performance, quality, cost, and schedule considerations. * Improve engineering processes and operational effectiveness by independently executing established work systems and contributing ideas that enhance efficiency, consistency, and product outcomes. * Strengthen team performance and technical capability by coordinating technicians and student employees, contributing to team goals, influencing within work groups, and continuously expanding your technical expertise. **To be successful in this role you will need the following:** * Apply strong engineering and systems thinking skills to understand complex product interactions, define requirements, evaluate risks, and make design decisions that optimize overall system performance and reliability. * Use data\-driven decision making by applying statistical methods, design of experiments, regression analysis, hypothesis testing, and other analytical tools to solve problems and guide product development decisions. * Translate customer and stakeholder requirements into effective designs by leading cross\-functional design integration efforts and ensuring solutions meet technical, manufacturing, quality, and business objectives. * Develop expertise in mechanical systems and controls engineering by understanding the interaction between mechanical, hydraulic, electronic, chemical, and software\-controlled systems to deliver robust product performance. * Execute product development activities effectively by planning, coordinating, monitoring, and delivering projects while balancing quality, schedule, resource, and risk considerations throughout the product lifecycle. * Proactively identify and mitigate product risks through failure mode avoidance, interface management, modeling, simulation, verification, validation, and structured problem\-solving methodologies. * Manage product configurations and engineering changes by maintaining accurate specifications, drawings, bills of material, and technical documentation while ensuring product integrity throughout its lifecycle. * Collaborate across functions and build strong partnerships with engineering, manufacturing, suppliers, project teams, and other stakeholders to achieve shared objectives and drive successful outcomes. * Communicate complex technical information clearly through design reviews, technical reports, requirements documentation, and stakeholder presentations that support informed decision\-making. * Deliver results in challenging situations by making timely, high\-quality decisions, prioritizing effectively, and maintaining focus on customer, product, and business needs. * Continuously develop your technical expertise by seeking feedback, expanding your knowledge of products and technologies, and pursuing both formal and informal learning opportunities. * Leverage diverse perspectives and experiences to enhance innovation, strengthen problem\-solving, and improve team and business performance. **Education, Licenses, Certifications:** * College, university, or equivalent Bachelor's degree in Engineering or appropriate STEM field is required. * Post\-graduate (Master's) degree relevant to this discipline area may be required for select roles. * This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations. **Experience:** * Entry level/Early career professional. * Preferred candidates would have relevant experience working in either a temporary student employment environment (intern, co\-op, or other extracurricular team activities) or as an early career professional in a relevant technical discipline area. * Knowledge of MS Office tools is also preferred **Additional Information:** * The Columbus Midrange Engine Plant (CMEP) primarily manufactures the Cummins 6\.7L diesel engine for Ram Truck. The CMEP Product Engineering team is responsible for the design, support, and technical ownership of the product currently being manufactured. The core work of the team is to evaluate, validate, and implement changes for this product as well as identify and mitigate warranty issues. This is a dynamic and fast\-paced environment where you get to see the impact of your work daily. * A successful candidate will work cross\-functionally with customers, plant quality, product quality, manufacturing engineering, industrial engineering, materials, operations, and other functions. Provide information on the status of improvement projects to customer. Working as a team, candidate will deliver superior results by finding the optimal solution and bringing it to fruition. **Compensation:** Please note that the salary range provided is a good faith estimate on the applicable range. The final salary offer will be determined after considering relevant factors, including a candidate’s qualifications and experience, where appropriate. **Job** Engineering **Organization** Cummins Inc. **Role Category** On\-site with Flexibility **Job Type** Exempt \- Experienced **ReqID** 2433884 **Relocation Package** Yes **100% On\-Site** No **Cummins and E\-Verify** At Cummins, we are an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer dedicated to diversity in the workplace. Our policy is to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified persons without regard to race, gender, color, disability, national origin, age, religion, union affiliation, sexual orientation, veteran status, citizenship, gender identity and/or expression, or other status protected by law. Cummins validates the right to work using E\-Verify and will provide the Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), with information from each new employee’s Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. Visit http://EEOC.gov to know your rights on workplace discrimination.

jobs.title: Senior UX Designer
jobs.description: At Curriculum Associates, we believe in the potential of every child and are changing the face of education technology with award\-winning learning programs like i\-Ready that serve a third of the nation’s K–8 students. For more than 50 years, our commitment to making classrooms better places, serving educators, and supporting accessible learning experiences for all students has driven the continuous improvement of our innovative programs. Our team of more than 2,500 employees is composed of lifelong learners who stand behind this mission, working tirelessly to serve the educational community with world\-class programs and support every day. Are you a designer who loves thinking through complex challenges and finding creative solutions? Curriculum Associates is looking for a talented and collaborative **Senior UX Designer** to design clear and intuitive experiences for our Educator platform. Working closely with the Lead UX Designer, this Senior UX Designer should be a strong analytical and conceptual thinker who can transform ideas into products and demonstrate strong technical, organizational, and communication skills. The right person will work closely with subject matter experts, editors, product managers, engineers, and visual designers to transform educator needs into powerful interactive experiences. **The Impact You’ll Have** -------------------------- * Participate in concept development with editorial, design, and development teams. * Use iterative and collaborative design techniques to transform new concepts into products, from low\-fidelity diagrams, storyboards, sketches, and wireframes to high\-fidelity functional prototypes. * Develop effective documentation for varied audiences and collaborate closely with Agile development teams to ensure proper implementation of the designs. * Maintain, update, and improve existing products. * Participate as a contributor to an interdisciplinary team in the definition, planning, and prioritization of user requirements, and proactively identify and solve potential problems within assigned projects throughout the UX design process. **What We’re Looking For** -------------------------- Proven Experience * 5\+ years designing rich interactive experiences, preferably for educators and students. * A track record of achievement in creating innovative and thoughtful products that improve user experience, as demonstrated by a portfolio submission. Portfolio submission is required to be considered for the position. Deep Understanding of User Experience Design * A proven understanding of UX/UI processes and best practices, including evidence\-based user\-centered design, user engagement principles, and information architecture. * Experience designing AI\-enabled interfaces and workflows, such as conversational chatbots, personalized content, and predictive or adaptive systems, as well as familiarity with current AI best practices and ethics. * Proficiency in UX/UI prototyping tools, preferably Figma, as well as experience with and curiosity for using generative AI tools, such as Figma Make or Claude Code, for rapid ideation, prototyping, and iteration as part of the design process. * Strong knowledge of mobile and web interaction patterns. * Strong information design and communication design skills. * Strong ability to capture and document user, stakeholder, and business requirements. * Experience using user and market research to drive creative decisions and design rationale. * Curiosity and passion for exploration and consumption of all forms of media, apps, and interactive software, and the vision to apply them to educational contexts. * An understanding of accessible design, including Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) and Universal Design for Learning (UDL). * Desire to pursue professional growth to stay current with accessible UX and AI design trends. Mastery of Soft Skills * Highly detail\-oriented with developed organizational skills, including the ability to independently prioritize tasks and meet deadlines without oversight. * Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. * A love for collaboration, with proven ability to work as a confident design representative on a cross\-functional product team in a fast\-paced environment. * Effective at organizing and leading team meetings, with demonstrated presentation skills to deliver UX recommendations and design rationales to stakeholders, project teams, and leadership. **We’d Also Love to See** ------------------------- * Experience in K–8 curricula. * Previous classroom teaching experience or experience working closely with educators and students is highly desirable. **Travel** ---------- Travel 2–4 times annually. **Location** ------------ This is a hybrid position, local to either North Billerica, MA, or Brooklyn, NY, with a minimum of one day per week in the office. **Pay Range** ------------- This role’s range is $69,250–$118,250\. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that Curriculum Associates considers in making compensation decisions based on our Compensation Philosophy. Actual base pay within that range will vary based upon several factors, including, but not limited to, prior experience and relevant skill sets. At Curriculum Associates, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances for each case. This role is also eligible to participate in the company bonus plan. The Company recognizes that minimum wage varies by location and will ensure all compensation decisions comply with applicable state and local laws. **Benefits** ------------ Benefit\-eligible employees and their families are covered by medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance. Employees can enroll in the company’s 401(k) plan and receive an employer match. Employees have access to a flexible vacation and sick policy, in addition to twelve paid holidays and a winter office closure between Christmas and New Year’s, as well as a number of additional perks and benefits. *Curriculum Associates, LLC is an equal opportunity employer. Curriculum Associates will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment based on any legally\-recognized basis, including, but not limited to: race (including ancestry, national origin, ethnic characteristics, interracial marriage or association, and traits historically associated with race such as hair texture and protective hairstyles), color, religion and creed (including all aspects of religious observance, practice and belief), sex (including pregnancy, lactation, childbirth or related medical conditions, breastfeeding, sex assigned at birth, difference of sex development and variations of sex characteristics), affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, citizenship or immigration status, physical or mental disability, genetic information (including testing and characteristics), veteran or uniformed servicemember status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.* *If you need special assistance or an accommodation for a disability in order to apply for a posted position, please contact our People and Culture department at* *people@cainc.com* *for US based job postings. Contact* *people\-india@cainc.com* *for India job postings.* ***US\-based Candidates:*** *Curriculum Associates uses E\-Verify to confirm the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. To learn more about E\-Verify, including your rights and responsibilities, please visit:* *https://www.e\-verify.gov/employees/employee\-rights\-and\-responsibilities* *Information that you provide when applying for employment with Curriculum Associates, LLC may be subject to the California Privacy Rights Act.*

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description: ***DEPLOY has been retained by a Dallas, Texas based firm that provides unique SaaS products to automotive dealerships across the United States.*** ***DEPLOY is a Mid Level Machine Learning Engineer for an in office role in Dallas.*** DEPLOY's client will hire smart and ambitious doers and set them loose in an exciting and complex technology business where they will build, sell, and deploy call tracking, CRM integration and Artificial Intelligence solutions in a dynamic business environment. Our solutions attack one of the biggest business problems in existence today: ***The Phone.*** ***As a member of the Machine Learning (ML) Team you will:*** ***Design \& Deploy ML Models:*** ***Develop, fine\-tune, and deploy NLP and LLM\-driven models using frameworks like PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face, ensuring they are robust, scalable, and production\-ready.*** ***Build APIs \& Pipelines:*** ***Construct APIs and automated pipelines that integrate real\-time or batch data (e.g., call transcripts) to power conversational AI features in our products.*** ***MLOps \& Model Monitoring:*** ***Implement MLOps best practices—model versioning, automated CI/CD pipelines (Azure),*** ***containerization (Docker), orchestration (Kubernetes)—to ensure reliable, repeatable*** ***deployments.*** ***Employ infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform, AWS CDK) to maintain scalable, cloud\-based ML environments on AWS (SageMaker, EC2/Fargate).*** ***Experiment Tracking \& Performance:*** ***Track experiments, artifacts, and metrics using MLFlow, Weights \& Biases, or ML Studio.*** ***Continuously monitor performance (Prometheus, CloudWatch), troubleshoot issues, and optimize models for latency, accuracy, and scalability.*** ***Cross\-Functional Collaboration:*** ***Partner with data engineers, product managers, and senior ML engineers to align technical solutions with business goals.*** ***Contribute to evolving data pipelines and guide improvements based on user feedback and performance metrics. Mentorship \& Best Practices:*** ***Participate in code reviews, pair programming, and technical discussions.*** ***Serve as a mentor to junior team members, sharing best practices in ML engineering, MLOps, and model lifecycle management.*** ***Our Ideal Candidates:*** ***3\+ years in ML engineering, with hands\-on NLP/LLM expertise, ideally deploying transformer\-based models (e.g., GPT, BERT) in production.*** ***Strong Python skills and experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch/TensorFlow/Hugging******Face), plus familiarity with cloud\-based ML (AWS SageMaker, EC2\), containerization (Docker),*** ***and orchestration (Kubernetes).*** ***Working knowledge of CI/CD (Azure), infrastructure\-as\-code (Terraform/CDK), and experiment tracking (MLFlow, W\&B, ML Studio).*** ***A proactive, collaborative approach; eagerness to learn from senior engineers and improve both ML and MLOps skill sets.*** ***Experience with AWS event\-driven and streaming architectures (e.g., EventBridge, SQS) to manage large\-scale, real\-time data handling and ingestion pipelines.*** ***Understanding of security, compliance, and reliability best practices in ML deployments.*** ***Prior work with voice recognition, sentiment analysis, or conversational AI frameworks.*** ***What's in It for You?*** ***Competitive salary package (immediate PTO).*** ***Full benefits package.*** ***Fidelity 401k with company match.*** ***Fun perks including a monthly gym reimbursement, a monthly wellness reimbursement, and a monthly reading allowance.*** ***Weekly catered breakfast, Employee of the Month rewards, regular company events, and bi\-weekly happy hours.*** ***Opportunities for continued career growth within the organization.*** ***Fun and collaborative work environment.***

jobs.title: Assistant to the County Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- Assist in directing engineering, surveying, construction, and maintenance activities for county road infrastructure. **Job Duties** -------------- * Manage infrastructure projects, including drafting/design, estimates, bid documents, and contract administration. * Negotiate right\-of\-way acquisitions and prepare related documents. * Perform construction inspection on grading, paving, bridges, culverts, and erosion control projects. * Maintain project records and prepare reports. * Coordinate department recordkeeping and assist public with document research. * Lead and perform survey crew activities; maintain and purchase surveying/engineering equipment. * Review engineering and surveying data for accuracy. * Update and maintain inventory maps. * Conduct PCC and HMA plant inspections. * Train staff on equipment and safety procedures. * Participate in department meetings and training. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience. * 1–3 years relevant experience. * Ability to obtain Iowa DOT certifications (Aggregate, HMA, PCC). * Valid Iowa driver’s license. **Required Knowledge \& Skills*** Civil engineering principles for roads and bridges. * DOT, FHWA, and National Bridge Inspection standards. * Engineering design, surveying equipment, CAD, technical analysis. * Strong communication, recordkeeping, and supervisory skills. **Supplemental Information** ---------------------------- The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required of employees assigned to this job. The job description does not constitute an employment agreement between the employer and employee and is subject to change by the employer as the needs of the employer and requirements of the job change. *Dallas County is an Equal Opportunity Employer.* *Women, minorities and persons with disabilities are encouraged to apply.* *Dallas County participates in E\-Verify.*

jobs.title: Process & Equipment Optimization Engineer
jobs.description: At Daniels Health, we are passionate about creating safer, more sustainable medical waste management solutions that protect people and the planet. As we continue to grow and innovate across our treatment facilities, we are looking for a **Process Engineer** who thrives on optimizing complex systems and driving meaningful operational improvements. This role will be be hybrid, working out of one of our facilities with 25% travel to our plants across the United States. If you love diving into data, improving industrial processes, and partnering with cross‑functional teams to make an impact, this role is for you. ### **What you will do** * Own and continuously improve medical waste treatment processes and equipment, including autoclaves, boilers, shredders, conveyors, and supporting systems. * Analyze process performance to identify bottlenecks, downtime drivers, and opportunities for mechanical, controls, or automation improvements. * Design and optimize facility layouts to enhance material flow and reduce handling or waste. * Support equipment startups, commissioning, validation, and post‑installation optimization at facilities across North America. * Develop and standardize process control strategies, SOPs, documentation, and data structures across the network. * Enhance and maintain industrial control systems (PLC/HMI) and data acquisition tools to ensure safe, reliable, and measurable operations. * Build and support real‑time monitoring, alarms, reporting, and dashboard systems that improve operational visibility. * Use operational and equipment data to conduct root‑cause analyses and drive continuous improvement initiatives with operations and maintenance teams. ### **What we are looking for** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field. * 5\+ years in process engineering, industrial automation, or control system integration. * Experience with autoclaves, pressure vessels, or steam boiler systems (preferred). * Proficiency in PLC/HMI programming. * Familiarity with data acquisition systems, IIoT technology, and industrial networking (EtherNet/IP, Modbus, OPC). * Strong understanding of tooling/fixture design. * Proficiency in AutoCAD, SolidWorks, or similar design tools. * Ability to travel 25% * Ability to work on site 50% of the time at one of our facilities ### **Why work for us** * **Job stability** – As an essential service to healthcare, Daniels Health offers year\-round, recession\-proof employment * **Comprehensive benefits** – Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage starts on Day One; plus paid short\-term disability, company\-sponsored life insurance, and optional accident and long\-term disability plans * **Safety\-first culture** – We go above and beyond standard PPE protocols to ensure your safety when handling medical waste * **Supportive environment** – Be part of a mission\-driven team that values your contribution and invests in your growth * **Opportunities for growth** \- We offer the ability to advance your career across operations, engineering, and leadership as our North American footprint expands. With over 39 years of industry leadership, Daniels Health is privately owned and committed to reinvesting in its people and infrastructure. You’ll be part of a team that values authenticity, encourages entrepreneurial thinking, and supports career growth. If you're looking for a stable, mission\-driven role where your leadership makes a real impact, we’d love to hear from you. At Daniels Health, you’ll be part of a team that values safety, innovation, and people. **Apply today** and take the next step in your career with a company that’s transforming healthcare waste management for good. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer – Agent Runtime
jobs.description: **The Role** ------------ We are looking for a **Senior Applied AI Engineer** to join the Agent Runtime team behind **Alwin**, our new Agentic Automation Platform for audit and finance. Alwin agents run for long times, work through multi\-step audit procedures over client evidence, and return finished work papers with every number traced back to source. Humans review and sign off. The runtime is the layer every agent depends on: the model access, the base system prompt and context, the tools (document extraction, retrieval, sandboxes, MCP integrations), the orchestration of agents and sub\-agents, and the observability and evals that tell us whether an agent is performing to objective standards. You will own the *applied AI* half of that layer. Product teams build audit\-specific agents on top of it; you decide how the base agent reasons, what tools it gets and at what abstraction, how it manages context over long horizons, and how we measure and hill\-climb accuracy, speed and cost. This is a hands\-on role in a small team with a large blast radius. Your work goes in front of hundreds of thousands of audit and finance professionals, and the problems are largely open: there is no playbook for production agents in a regulated domain, so you will help write it. **About DataSnipper** --------------------- DataSnipper is the Agentic Automation Platform for audit and finance. Known worldwide for our Excel add\-in, we are now building Alwin by DataSnipper: purpose\-built agents that execute audit and finance workflows end\-to\-end, with every output traceable back to source evidence and a human signing off. Headquartered in Amsterdam with offices in New York, Tokyo, Kuala Lumpur and Sydney, we are used by hundreds of thousands of professionals at the world's largest firms. Our mission: automate the mundane, unlock the meaningful. **What You Will Do** -------------------- ### **Agent Engineering** * Own the base agents: system prompt, context engineering, memory and state management for tasks that span many turns and hours of execution * Design how agents use the tool layer, including document extraction, retrieval, code and file sandboxes, and MCP integrations, choosing the right level of abstraction so agents handle edge cases without wasting effort on mechanical steps * Implement agentic patterns such as sub\-agent composition, planning modes, human\-in\-the\-loop gates, and model routing across multiple providers * Ship end\-to\-end: from prototype with our audit domain experts, through evaluation, to production on Alwin * Define and build automatic processes that improve the agent continuously over time * Keep costs under control and implement cost\-efficient approaches to AI\-centric workflows ### **Evaluation \& Quality** * Extract signal from long agent trajectories: attribute outcomes to specific reasoning steps and tool calls, classify failure modes, and turn them into fixes * Hill\-climb accuracy, latency and token cost, and make the trade\-offs explicit for the teams building on the runtime ### **Reliability \& Collaboration** * Instrument agent behaviour with our observability stack and use production traces to drive improvements * Partner with Agent Experience teams, Document Intelligence and the AI Platform team to turn their needs into runtime capabilities that are self\-service rather than a request queue * Stay on the frontier: evaluate new models, techniques and agent patterns, and bring the ones that hold up into production **What You Will Bring** ----------------------- ### **Must\-Have** * **5\+ years** of software engineering experience with strong, production\-grade **Python** * Experience **shipping and operating an LLM\-powered product in production**: you have dealt with hallucinations, latency spikes, tool failures and cost explosions at scale, and can explain what broke and how you fixed it * Hands\-on experience building **agentic systems**: control loops, tool selection, planning versus execution, retries and fallbacks, not only prompt\-and\-parse pipelines * Experience with **evaluation**: you have built datasets, run offline and online experiments, and used the results to make an AI system measurably better * Fluency with **LLM APIs and agent frameworks** across more than one model provider * Proficient with **AI\-assisted engineering** and excited about working with coding agents daily * Strong fundamentals in **software architecture and system design**, and a track record of reliable, well\-tested delivery * Excellent communication; you can work directly with auditors and product partners to define what "correct" means ### **Nice\-to\-Have** * Experience with Durable workflow engines or long\-running background task systems * Experience with **RAG and retrieval pipelines** over large, messy document corpora * **Document AI**: VLMs, OCR, structured extraction and their metrics * Sandboxed code execution, MCP, or multi\-agent orchestration in production * Domain experience in **audit, accounting or fintech** * Familiarity with **OWASP GenAI** security practices and working in a regulated, privacy\-sensitive environment **What We Expect** ------------------ * **Ownership**: You own work end\-to\-end, anticipate issues, and ensure high\-quality delivery with minimal support. We expect you to influence the technical direction of the team. * **Growth Mindset**: You encourage open feedback exchange and provide clear, balanced feedback that helps others grow * **Collaboration**: You build strong cross\-functional relationships and influence peers through expertise, data, and empathy * **Adaptability**: You navigate ambiguity calmly, model positive behavior, and help peers adjust through clear communication * **Judgment**: You exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations, balance speed and accuracy, and adjust priorities proactively **What we offer** ----------------- * Excellent salary \+ stock participation plan * Flexible paid time off * Comprehensive medical and dental coverage * 401K match * Paid parental leave * Company\-sponsored lunch * Hybrid mode of work (at least 3 days onsite in our New York City office) * Being part of one of the fastest\-growing scale\-ups in the Netherlands * Make an impact by disrupting the finance industry with us * A flexible and growing organization with lots of opportunities to learn and develop * International working environment, with a team of friendly and driven colleagues * Access to OpenUp and Talkspace, the mental health and wellness platform * Multiple social activities for team building Compensation Range: $230K \- $290K
