jobs.title: Senior Systems Engineer
jobs.description: Position Overview: The Sr. Systems Engineer is a key contributor, providing leadership and expertise in driving new and sustaining engineering product deliverables through all development phases. The Sr. Systems Engineer will leverage quantitative approaches for design, system, and technology integration activities to demonstrate visible and measurable progress for successful delivery as defined within Fujifilm Sonosite’s Product Development Process (PDP) and in compliance with FDA CFR and ISO/IEC guidelines. The person in this position will participate in the leadership of R\&D from within the cross\-functional team that identifies opportunities, collaborates with external partners, develops and manages requirements, generates system architectures and component concepts, implements the solutions in hardware and software, analyzes data, and ensures robust verification and validation testing along with cost, risk, and lifecycle management. Company Overview: At FUJIFILM Sonosite, we reinvent how healthcare is delivered with point\-of\-care ultrasound technology. As the leader in bedside ultrasound systems, our innovations save lives—from premature babies in NICUs to trauma patients in emergency rooms. We’re looking for purpose\-driven team members ready to build technology that impacts real\-world scenarios, including natural disasters and even war zones. By joining FUJIFILM Sonosite, you’ll be part of a team that thrives on collaboration, out\-of\-the\-box thinking, and a passion for life\-saving innovations. Let’s make a difference together. Our headquarters in Bothell, Washington, blends riverside charm with urban amenities, quality schools, and an ever\-evolving downtown—all part of the vibrant Seattle metro area. Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers Job Description: **Essential Job Functions:*** Lead cross\-functional project teams in the design and development of medical imaging systems through phase gate product development process from concept to launch. * Ensure that products and processes comply with applicable industry guidance, standards, and regulations. * Work with clinicians, end users, and marketing to define and evaluate new innovative product concepts to address unmet customer and business needs. * Support sustaining engineering initiatives for the strategic products manufactured in\-house or at contract manufacturing sites. * Support program management with strong project management skills to effectively manage technical product deliverables (DHF). * Communicate effectively with multidisciplinary teams to monitor project progress, manage critical path activities, and ensure adherence to project milestones and timelines. Communicate project status through verbal and written reports as needed to Senior Management. * Facilitate engineering change request quorum to manage the project scope and defects. * Work with Quality and Regulatory Affairs to support regulatory activities specifically related to the introduction of new products (i.e., country registrations, submission and follow\-up of 510k), as well as responding to internal and external audits (i.e., FDA, ISO, other regulatory bodies). * Participate in post\-market investigations as needed. **Knowledge and Experience:*** An undergraduate degree in an engineering or science discipline (Biology, Biomedical Engineering, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Material Science, Mechanical Engineering, or other related discipline); Graduate Degree is a plus. * Minimum of 7\-9 years of R\&D experience with a proven track record of leading a team of Systems, BME, SW\-E, ME, and/or EE engineers in the development and commercialization of products within a regulated industry, preferably medical imaging. * Experience designing and developing system architectures is a plus. * Demonstrated ability to understand clinical scenarios, conceptualize technical solutions, explain concepts to implementation engineers, test and evaluate designs and prototypes. * Knowledge of medical device risk management per ISO 14971 is preferred. * Experience designing products and processes per industry standards; exposure to medical device safety standards (IEC 60601\-1, etc.) is highly desired. **Skills and Abilities:*** Ability to lift 25lbs with or without accommodations. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * Strong interpersonal skills to work with other groups in an effective manner. * Strong analytical skills. * Organizational skills to synthesize many inputs to create and communicate the big picture and make necessary decisions. * Ability to work in a fast\-paced, small team environment with minimal direction. * Handle open\-ended problems \& ambiguity well. **Salary and Benefits:*** $110,000/yr. \- $160,000/yr. depending on experience \+ variable target bonus *(Compensation will vary based on skills, experience and location; it is not typical to be hired at or above the top of the salary range).* * Insurance: * + Medical, Dental \& Vision + Life \& Company paid Disability * Retirement Plan (401k): * + 4% automatic Company contribution + Fujifilm matches 50 cents for every dollar you contribute, up to 6% of your salary * Paid Time Off: * + You can accrue up to 120 hours of PTO in your first year of employment + PTO increases based on years of service * Employee Choice Holidays: * + 32 hours additional paid time off, based on date of hire in the calendar year * Paid Holidays: * + Eight (8\) paid holidays per year FUJIFILM Sonosite offers a fantastic compensation package, including benefits, and a 401k program. Visit us today to learn more about our exciting technologies and how you can make a difference. To apply and obtain further details regarding key responsibilities and experience requirements, check out our careers page at www.Sonosite.com/about/careers. \#CB \#LI\-MW EEO Information: Fujifilm is committed to providing equal opportunities in hiring, promotion and advancement, compensation, benefits, and training regardless of nationality, age, gender, sexual orientation or gender identity, race, ethnicity, religion, political creed, ideology, national, or social origin, disability, veteran status, etc. ADA Information: If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre\-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to our HR Department (ffss\-hr@fujifilm.com or (425\) 951\-1200\).

jobs.title: Sr System Engineer- MSAT Systems
jobs.description: Build the analytics backbone that powers smarter manufacturing. As FUJIFILM Biotechnologies' Senior System Engineer — MSAT Applications, you will own and evolve the platforms that let our Manufacturing Science \& Technology (MSAT) teams see, understand, and control processes in real time. From SIMCA\-online and TIBCO Statistica to PAT and historian integrations, you’ll make sure these GxP systems are secure, validated, reliable, and fast—so scientists and engineers can make data\-driven decisions that improve yield, reduce deviations, and speed life\-changing therapies to patients. Why this role matters * Turn data into decisions: Your work enables robust multivariate monitoring and real\-time analytics that drive right\-first\-time performance and continuous improvement. * Protect our license to operate: You’ll embed cGxP, data integrity (ALCOA\+), and validation into mission\-critical systems—strengthening audit and inspection outcomes. * Scale impact across sites: By standardizing and integrating MSAT tools across manufacturing and development, you’ll uplift reliability and insight network\-wide. What you’ll do * Platform ownership + Administer and support SIMCA\-online, Statistica Server, and PAT platforms. + Manage Windows Server instances, services, and dependencies; ensure uptime and capacity planning. + Maintain databases (SQL Server/Oracle) for configuration, results storage, and audit trails. * Integrations and data lifecycle * + Integrate with DCS/SCADA (e.g., DeltaV), historians (e.g., OSIsoft PI/AVEVA), MES (e.g., Syncade), LIMS/ELN, OPC UA/DA/MQTT gateways, and file/API\-based exchanges. + Manage data retention, archival, and restoration aligned to corporate data governance policies. * Compliance, data integrity, and validation * + Ensure cGxP, ALCOA\+, and security requirements across integrations; partner with QA/CSV on risk\-based validation (GAMP 5, CSA) and audit readiness. * Security and access control + Implement RBAC/least\-privilege, AD/LDAP integration, and SSO where applicable. + Manage audit trails, e\-signatures, certificates, and secure configurations. + Coordinate vulnerability management, patching, and endpoint protection aligned with GxP and downtime windows. * Operations and support + Provide tiered support; run incident/problem/change management with root\-cause analysis and CAPA. + Monitor system health, job queues, connectors, and data flows; tune performance and troubleshoot latency. + Coordinate vendor relationships, licenses, and support contracts; plan upgrades and patch cycles. + Implement business continuity, backup/restore validation, and disaster recovery testing. + Configure systems to meet evolving business requirements. * Audit and inspection readiness * + Prepare and support internal/external audits and health authority inspections. + Maintain complete, contemporaneous records of configurations, deviations, and changes. * And other job duties that may be assigned from time to time. Minimum qualification requirements * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a scientific field. * 8\+ years of relevant experience in Information Technology or Engineering. * 3\+ years’ experience with MSAT\-type applications (e.g., SIMCA\-online, Statistica, synTQ, AspenTech) or historian applications. Preferred requirements * Experience in manufacturing or process development systems. * Strong Windows Server/Active Directory administration; scripting (PowerShell); SQL Server/Oracle fundamentals. * Experience with OSIsoft PI/AVEVA, OPC UA/DA, and DCS/SCADA or MES integrations. * Proven change/incident/problem management using ITIL practices. What you’ll bring to thrive * Fluency in manufacturing data flows and MSAT use cases; ability to translate requirements into robust configurations. * Hands\-on validation expertise and documentation rigor (CSV mindset) with an eye for audit readiness. * Strong troubleshooting instincts; performance tuning across integrations, connectors, and data pipelines. * Clear, proactive communication across MSAT, Engineering, IT, QA/CSV, and vendors; influence without direct authority. * Judgment to balance speed, compliance, and standardization; escalate risks appropriately. Scope and collaboration * Individual contributor with ownership of systems that support manufacturing and process development business units. * Work cross\-functionally with MSAT, Engineering, and IT globally to ensure platforms meet business needs and scale reliably. * Recognized as a subject\-matter resource for applications within scope; your decisions drive operational reliability and insight. Work environment * General office/hybrid; ability to travel to an FLBG site up to once per quarter. * Global stakeholders and users across time zones. Your impact from day one * Keep critical MSAT analytics platforms secure, validated, and available—reducing downtime and deviations. * Accelerate data\-driven process understanding, enabling faster tech transfers, better yields, and stronger compliance. * Standardize and integrate tools that scale across sites—amplifying value for scientists, engineers, and ultimately, patients. This is a global position that will support all our FUJIFILM Biotechnologies sites. Benefits and compensation will be governed by the location that you are based from and considered your home site. As part of any recruitment process, FUJIFILM Biotechnologies collects and processes personal data relating to job applicants. The organisation is committed to being transparent about how it collects and uses that data and to meeting its data protection obligations and may share this as part of the global recruitment process with hiring managers in Europe and the United St ates.

Manage resource allocation, establish architectural standards, and ensure teams have the necessary tools and support. * **Stakeholder Management** * Act as the primary liaison with technical strategy, program management, project engineering, and project management teams, providing guidance and alignment across complex company initiatives. * Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders and executive leadership. * Facilitate meetings and workshops to drive program objectives and decision\-making. Prepare and present regular program status reports and key issue updates to senior management and stakeholders. * **Continuous Improvement** * Promote a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence within the engineering team. * Adhere to best practices and design standards when coordinating with other programs and projects to identify and implement efficiencies that extend beyond the scope of a single program. * Evaluate program performance and implement process improvements. * Identify and address dependencies and risks that may impact program success. * Promote best practices and lessons learned across projects and teams. * Drive innovation and efficiency in technology solutions and project execution across multiple teams, departments, and companywide. Ensure team takes full advantage of advances in technologies used by the company and across the industry to improve and add new services for our customers. * **Focus Areas** – Facilities **COMPETENCIES:** * ACCOUNTABILITY\- Takes ownership for actions, decisions, and results; openly accepts feedback and demonstrates a willingness to improve. + Ability to remain current within the industry standards and best practices. * BASIC PRINCIPLES \- Interacts with people in a way that builds mutual trust, confidence, and respect; adheres to GCI’s Code of Conduct for Employees – the Basic Principles. * COLLABORATION \- Works effectively with others to accomplish common goals and objectives; maintains positive relationships even under difficult circumstances. + Ability to influence without authority and guide a team towards common goals by demonstrating strong leadership skills, building trust, and maximizing relationships across the company. + Ability to professionally mediate conflicts and foster technical alignment. * COMMUNICATION\- Conveys thoughts and expresses ideas appropriately and professionally. + Excellent communication and interpersonal skil gnments. Works under moderate supervision with latitude for independent judgment. Supports higher level staff in implementing more complex projects. **Minimum Qualifications:** **Required:** \* *A combination of relevant work experience and/or education sufficient to perform the duties of the job may substitute to meet the total years required on a year\-for\-year basis* * High School diploma or equivalent. * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science, Project Management, Business, IT/IS, or related discipline. \* * Minimum of seven (7\) years of progressive professional engineering experience. \* **Preferred:** * Master’s degree in Engineering. * Broad experience in the telecommunications industry within any of the following fields: Broadband Internet, ISP Infrastructure, Urban \& Rural Fiber Optic Networks, Mobile \& Fixed Wireless, Microwave \& Satellite Communications, Capacity Planning, Lifecycle Management, Information Technology \& Security. Other relevant telecom industry or job specific certifications: Project Management Professional (PMP), Program Management Professional (PgMP), Agile or Scrum certifications. * **DRIVING REQUIREMENTS** : * This position may require access to reliable transportation for occasional travel between retail store locations, offices, worksites, or other locations as needed. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS and WORKING CONDITIONS:** * GCI headquarters are based in Anchorage with project work occurring throughout the state of Alaska as well as locations in Oregon and Washington state. * Must be willing to travel up to 25% of the time to include rural locations off the road system. * Work is primarily sedentary, requiring daily routine computer usage. * Ability to work shifts as assigned, work in standard office/home office setting, and operate standard office equipment. * Ability to accurately communicate information and ideas to others effectively. * Physical agility and effort sufficient to perform job duties safely and effectively. * Ability to make valid judgments and decisions. * Available to work additional time on weekends, holidays, before or after normal work hours when necessary. * Must work well in a team environment and be able to work with a diverse group of people and customers. * Virtual workers must comply with remote work policies and agreements. The company and its subsidiaries operate in a 24/7 environment providing critical services to Alaskans and may need to respond to public health and safety matters or other business emergencies. Due to business needs employees may be contacted outside of the core business hours to respond to the immediate emergency. As such, you will be requested to provide emergency after hours contact numbers, to include your home and cell phone numbers if you have those services. **Culture, Engagement, and Connection:** At GCI, we foster an environment where the unique perspectives of our employees, customers, and fellow Alaskans are celebrated. performance and validation results. * Provide analysis\-based recommendations that support requirements, component and system design, controls, validation, supplier assessment, technical issue MATLAB/Simulink or equivalent engineering models. * Experience debugging model interfaces, initialization, variants, numerical behavior, or system\-integration issues. * Experience using Python, contribute to standard work, engineering deliverable reviews, technical documentation, and team knowledge sharing. **Preferred Skills and Experience** * Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering or an equivalent discipline, preferably focused on power electronics, power systems, electric drives, power semiconductors, or systems modeling. jobs.title: Civil Engineering Intern - Spring/Summer 2027
jobs.description: As a Civil Intern at Gessner Engineering, you will contribute to the completion of Civil Engineering projects by supporting engineering teams in the drafting and design of project deliverables. Internships with Gessner Engineering uniquely feature opportunities to grow not only in your technical proficiency, but to develop as a well\-rounded industry professional. Gessner delivers on this by granting our interns opportunities to work on active projects, receive training and mentorship from engineering professionals, collaborate across disciplines, experience leadership development, and more. **Duties \& Responsibilities*** Collaborate with a diverse group of industry professionals, from EITs to Senior PEs and PMs. * Coordinate across internal disciplines like survey, structural, geotechnical, etc. and external sub consultants if necessary. * Assist with design for a variety of projects including site plans, land development, and municipal infrastructure. * Visit project sites to assist with data collection and construction observation duties. * Manage time and workload effectively, including planning, organizing and prioritizing with attention to detail. * Work under the supervision and mentoring of civil engineers and designers. Accountable for the successful completion of engineering projects. **Learning Objectives** * Civil 3D basics * Design simple pipe networks for storm sewer, water, sanitary, and electrical utilities * Detail of basic design components * Perform Drainage Analysis with modeling * Model pond sizing * Develop Drainage and water reports * Construction Documents Sheet Set Up * Paving and Construction Joint Design * Sizing Storm Sewer * Creating cost estimates for projects * Requesting necessary information from city engineers * Create Drainage Area Maps * Develop Preliminary Engineering Reports * Culvert Analysis * Pay App Site Visit **Qualifications** * Education + Required \- Must be actively enrolled as a junior, senior or graduate student working towards a Bachelor of Science or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering + Preferred\- 3\.0 GPA or above * Experience/Skills + Preferred \- Experience with Microsoft Office, Civil 3D + Required \- Ability to clearly communicate in both oral and written communication to individuals and groups + Be solutions minded. Always find a way to be part of the solution. + Be collaborative. Must have a positive attitude, work well with co\-workers and clients. + Take initiative. Seek out every opportunity to do and to learn. * Availability + Spring Interns are required to maintain consistent ability to work 16\+ hours per week. + Summer Interns are required to maintain consistent ability to work 35\+ hours per week. Gessner Engineering does not sponsor employment visas (e.g., H\-1B, OPT, CPT, TN, or similar) at this time. *Gessner Engineering is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status or characteristic. Race/Color/Gender/Sexual Orientation/Gender Identity/Religion/National Origin/Disability/Veteran.*

jobs.title: Electrical Process Controls Designer (Entry Level)
jobs.description: **Job Description:** **This posting is for New Graduate opportunities.** **General Summary:** Under the direct supervision of the Process Controls senior staff, the Process Controls Designer is responsible for applying electrical analysis, design and drafting skills to develop engineering design documents for process controls, power, and associated low voltage systems. This role involves providing computer\-aided design (CAD) support for electrical engineering projects and ensuring coordination with mechanical systems. The Process Controls Designer will collaborate closely with engineers and other stakeholders during the design phase to produce accurate and integrated construction documents. Field measurements, document corrections, and adherence to applicable codes and standards are key aspects of this position. This role offers an opportunity to contribute to innovative projects while developing technical expertise in electrical design and drafting. **Essential Job Functions:** * Apply engineering knowledge and understanding to design and analyze electrical systems for the installation, interconnection, and control of electrical, mechanical, and building system components in compliance with applicable codes. * Understanding of the NEC and NFPA standards, as they apply to the electrical design. * Create engineering documents using computer aided design (CAD) technology utilizing Autodesk Revit and/or AutoCAD. Provide CAD support to more senior staff. * Produce construction documents that adhere to company standards and industry best practices. * Collaborate with the project team to identify, address, and resolve design and document coordination challenges, ensuring the delivery of well\-coordinated construction documents. * Create and maintain a structured project file within Autodesk Forma to centralize essential documentation, including calculations, schedules, correspondence, reference materials, and other essential documentation supporting the electrical design. * With assistance, update project specifications for the process control system to ensure functionality, compliance with codes, and alignment with project requirements. * Review project submittals (shop drawings) for conformance with contract documents; specify action required for conformance. * Conduct field measurements and site inspections to verify existing conditions, ensure compliance with design specifications, and gather data for project development. * Perform additional duties as assigned to support project goals and team objectives. **Employment Qualifications:** **Education**: * Bachelor of Science degree in Engineering **Experience:** * Prior internship experience in the process controls industry preferred * Engineer in Training (EIT) License preferred **Skills/Competencies**: * Microsoft Office, emphasis on Excel and Word * Basic knowledge in the use of Building Information Modeling (Building Information Model) software (Autodesk Revit and AutoCAD) * Strong technical and analytical skills including knowledge of principles relating to circuit theory, power systems, and electronics as they relate to electrical systems design. **About Us** At Ghafari Associates, we don’t just design buildings—we help shape the future of the industries we serve. As a global leader in architecture, engineering, and consulting, we partner with clients to deliver forward\-thinking solutions that transform how people work, manufacture, and connect. Our strength lies in our people. We bring together curious minds, technical experts, and creative problem\-solvers who thrive on collaboration and innovation. Whether supporting major industrial programs or advancing federal and commercial projects, our teams are empowered to make a meaningful impact—both for our clients and within our communities. We are committed to investing in our employees’ financial, physical, and emotional well\-being, as well as their professional growth. Through robust training, licensure support, internships, mentorships, and tuition reimbursement, we provide the resources our people need to build rewarding careers while making a lasting difference in the communities we are proud to call home. Ghafari Associates is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws. As a federal contractor, Ghafari Associates maintains affirmative action programs for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans in accordance with applicable laws. **Pay Transparency** Ghafari Associates will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. **Accommodation** Ghafari Associates is also committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals with disabilities in the employment application process. If you need an accommodation due to a disability to use our online system to apply for a position, you may also apply for positions in the following ways: * By fax at: 313\.436\.8624, Attn: Human Resources * By mail at: 17101 Michigan Ave., Dearborn, MI 48126, Attn: Human Resources * In person at: 17101 Michigan Ave., Dearborn, MI 48126 * By email at: hr@ghafari.com If there are any questions about the accommodations offered above, please contact 313\.441\.3000 for assistance.

jobs.title: Field Service Technician
jobs.description: **Job Summary** Responsible for progressing through structured learning and on\-the\-job training to support the installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of equipment, machinery, and technical systems at customer sites. This role is designed to develop the foundational technical, safety, and customer service capabilities required for advancement to the Field Service Engineer position. **Responsibilities** * Participate in structured training to develop technical proficiency in preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, laser theory, parts identification, tooling, and installation procedures. * Assist with on\-site installation, maintenance, and repair activities in accordance with established procedures, safety requirements, and customer expectations. * Learn to use required service tools, systems, and software, including Windows\-based applications, Microsoft Outlook, Microsoft 365, OneDrive, and designated technical analysis tools. * Research and help resolve hardware and software issues under the guidance of experienced field service personnel. * Support root cause analysis by gathering data, documenting findings, and contributing to corrective action planning as directed. * Provide logistics support, including moving parts into position at customer sites, coordinating shipment of parts, and documenting parts identification and replacement activity. * Maintain training schedules, track on\-the\-job development, and demonstrate continuous improvement in technical capability and job performance. * Communicate and escalate issues promptly to supervisors or designated team members to support timely problem resolution. * Work overtime as needed to meet business and customer requirements while maintaining compliance with all safety standards and procedures. **Qualifications/Requirements** **Required Skills:** * High school diploma or GED required; associate degree, military experience, or comparable technical training preferred. * Demonstrated aptitude, initiative, and willingness to learn in a technical service environment. **Preferred Skills:** * Effective verbal and written communication skills. * Ability to develop knowledge of laser theory, installation processes, and maintenance practices. * Ability to learn and apply designated technical systems and analytical tools, including eGwork, Nettool, ReDeeM, Fabscape, macros, and related applications. * Ability to learn and perform specific portions of Field Service Technician duties in accordance with prescribed methods and standards. * Ability to develop troubleshooting skills for diagnosing and resolving computer hardware and software issues. * Demonstrated potential to develop effective time management, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and multitasking skills. * Critical thinking skills and the ability to progress in learning during the first year in the role. **Additional Information** **Physical movement requirements include the ability to remain in a stationary position, move throughout the work area, access equipment and materials, and travel within customer or company facilities as needed.** **Mental Requirements:** * Ability to read, comprehend, and apply technical documents, procedures, and data. * Ability to develop strong problem\-solving skills, maintain concentration, and apply close attention to detail when addressing technical issues. * Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively. * Ability to communicate clearly and professionally with internal and external customers. * Ability to follow established processes, protocols, and safety requirements. * Ability to apply established procedures accurately and in a timely manner. * Ability to inspect work areas and identify potential safety concerns. * Ability to manage workload demands, competing priorities, and ambiguity in a professional manner. * Ability to complete work within established deadlines. **Emotional Intelligence Requirements:** * Ability to remain composed and professional in situations involving stress, deadlines, or challenging interactions. * Ability to manage priorities effectively to achieve targeted performance outcomes. * Ability to maintain effective and collaborative working relationships with managers, peers, customers, and other stakeholders, using tact and professionalism as appropriate. * Ability to recognize how communication style and behavior affect others and adjust appropriately to support effective teamwork. * Demonstrates self\-motivation, sound professional judgment, and leadership potential appropriate to the role. * Demonstrates accountability for work quality, accuracy, and follow\-through. **Diversity \& Inclusion Commitment** At Komatsu we come from diverse backgrounds, with unique perspectives, experiences, and contributions. We are committed to creating a workforce that is reflective of the communities we work and live in. We believe that our people are part of our shared purpose. We are authentic, ambitious, and innovative in our pursuit of Diversity \& Inclusion. United, we are on a journey towards a sustainable future that creates value together. **Company Information** Komatsu is a world leader in manufacturing construction, mining, forestry, and industrial heavy equipment. Founded in 1921, Komatsu has a long history of quality, reliability, innovation, and excellence. Headquartered in Tokyo, Japan, Komatsu facilities, distributors and dealers are in more than 140 countries and employ more than 60,000 people. Komatsu offers a diverse and challenging work environment, where you can grow your skills and career, and contribute to a sustainable, clean\-energy future. If you are looking for a company that values your talent and potential, be a part of something big and join a team that is shaping the world! If you want to learn more about Komatsu, please visit our website at https://www.komatsu.com/ . Please visit our careers website to apply online at https://komatsu.jobs/job/Field\-Service\-Technician\-Gigaphoton/36395\-en\_US Pay: $55,000\.00 \- $65,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Employee discount * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Paid training * Parental leave * Referral program * Retirement plan * Tools provided * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Support Engineer Tier I
jobs.description: **Position Summary** This Tier I Support Engineer role is responsible for remote and/or onsite troubleshooting technology issues for our clients. All service tickets are tracked through our CRM software and primary communication methods with clients include phone and email. The role reports to the Service Desk Management Team. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** The essential functions include, but are not limited to the following: Configuration, management, and troubleshooting/repair in the following areas: * Server virtualization (VMWare \& Hyper\-V) * Routing \& switching * Hardware troubleshooting * Desktops * Laptops * Printers * Firewall management/configuration * VoIP/UCaaS system management * MDR, AV, and EDR management * Wireless management * RDS/Citrix management * SAN management * Backup management * General ability to troubleshoot a varied range of software platforms * Participate in comprehensive training programs to continue improving skills and knowledge needed to excel in this position and stay updated with industry best practices **Additional responsibilities:** * Effectively communicate with hardware/software vendors to support customer needs * Customer facing communication including phone calls, emails, and in person discussions * Participation in an on\-call rotation with other support engineer staff for after\-hours/emergency calls * Occasional travel to customer locations for troubleshooting that cannot be completed remotely or for software/hardware deployments **Minimum Qualifications (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities)** * Bachelor's degree, or 1\-3 years equivalent in experience and/or certifications * 1\-3 years IT support (preferred) * 1\-3 years Active Directory (preferred) * 1\-3 years Microsoft 365 management * Logical approach to problem\-solving * Organization \& time management * Ability to effectively communicate with team members and clients * Willingness to collaborate in a team environment **Physical Demands and Work Environment** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. The employee will work in an indoor office environment with controlled temperature and lighting. This position requires the employee to remain in a stationary position for extended periods of time. Occasionally, the employee may be required to move about the office and warehouse space to review and stage project materials. Occasional lifting of materials weighing up to 20 pounds may be required. Occasional travel to jobsites may be required. Pay: $50,000\.00 \- $60,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Lead DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. We are driven by our passion for success and we are proud to deliver best\-in\-class payment technology and software solutions. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow. Job Posting Description**Ready to take your career global?** ===================================== Make your mark at one of the biggest names in payments. We’re looking for a **Lead DevOps Engineer** to join our ever\-evolving **AI/ML Data Platform team** and help shape the future of global commerce. In this role, you will drive the reliability, scalability, and performance of the platforms that power data and artificial intelligence (AI) innovation across Global Payments. Your leadership will help accelerate how teams deliver secure, resilient, and high\-impact solutions, enabling faster business outcomes and exceptional client experiences. Working at the intersection of cloud engineering, automation, and platform strategy, you will influence enterprise\-wide technology decisions, foster engineering excellence, and create the foundation that supports Global Payments’ mission to deliver innovative payment solutions and power the future of commerce worldwide. **What you'll own** ------------------- * **Shape the cloud platform strategy** by designing scalable, secure, and resilient infrastructure that enables data and AI initiatives to grow efficiently and deliver measurable business value. * **Accelerate software delivery outcomes** through automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC), improving deployment consistency, reducing operational risk, and increasing engineering productivity. * **Drive continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) excellence** by building and optimizing enterprise\-grade pipelines that reduce time\-to\-market and improve release reliability. * **Influence platform reliability and performance** through proactive monitoring, testing, and operational improvements that maximize system availability, security, and user confidence. * **Champion DevOps best practices across teams** by partnering with engineers, sharing expertise, and creating scalable solutions that strengthen collaboration, innovation, and long\-term platform success. **What you'll bring** --------------------- * Proven success leading engineering initiatives, cloud transformations, or complex infrastructure projects with measurable business and technology outcomes. * Deep expertise in cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with a strong understanding of modern cloud architecture principles. * Advanced experience with Terraform, Ansible, and Infrastructure as Code practices that improve scalability, consistency, and operational efficiency. * Strong proficiency with Docker, Kubernetes, GitHub, and GitHub Actions, with demonstrated success building and managing modern cloud\-native environments. * Comprehensive understanding of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), DevOps methodologies, and CI/CD automation, with the ability to influence engineering excellence across teams. **It’s a bonus if you have** ---------------------------- * Experience supporting AI, machine learning, or data analytics platforms and translating business needs into scalable technical solutions. * Demonstrated success leading DevSecOps, platform engineering, or technical modernization initiatives that improve security, governance, and developer experience. * Ability to build alignment across cross\-functional teams, influence stakeholders without direct authority, and foster a culture of learning and knowledge sharing. **About the team** ------------------ Our inclusive and global teams win together every day. We’re proud to have the best minds in the industry, who you can learn from as you grow your career. The people, the energy, the connections – it’s unmatched. Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders. **What makes a Globalpayer?** ----------------------------- Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do. Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders. Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global. **Our perks \- what we’ll bring for you** ----------------------------------------- We know it’s bigger than just your career. It’s your life, and your world. That’s why we offer global benefits and programs to support you at every stage. jobs.title: AI Test Automation Engineer
jobs.description: At Globant, we are working to make the world a better place, one step at a time. We enhance business development and enterprise solutions to prepare them for a digital future. With a diverse and talented team present in more than 30 countries, we are strategic partners to leading global companies in their business process transformation. Join Globant as an **AI Test Automation Engineer** and lead the quality transformation for our flagship agentic banking platform . We are looking for an automation expert skilled in **Python, pytest, and LLM/Agentic system testing** to solve one of tech's newest challenges: systematically validating non\-deterministic AI behavior . In this role, you will build automated evaluation datasets, inspect agent execution traces, and deploy LLM\-as\-a\-judge frameworks to gate production releases with absolute confidence . ### **SCREENING REQUIREMENTS** Idea candidates must meet all primary technical gates : * **Automation Mastery:** 4\+ years of test automation experience using **Python** and **pytest** (custom fixtures, mocking, and CI pipeline integration) . * **LLM \& Agentic System Testing:** 1\+ years of hands\-on experience evaluating non\-deterministic AI applications . * **LLM Evaluation Engineering:** Proven track record building **LLM\-as\-a\-judge** scoring scripts and maintaining versioned evaluation datasets (golden paths, edge cases, regression suites) . * **Agent Deep\-Dives \& Traces:** Ability to validate tool selection and parameters, inspect multi\-step agent execution traces (e.g., LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework), and mock agent endpoints for CI workflows . * **Adversarial \& Guardrail Testing:** Experience designing negative\-path test suites for prompt injections, hallucinated financial actions, and trust\-level boundaries (Suggest / Approve / Act) . * **Observability \& CI Integration:** Hands\-on integration of test stages into **GitLab CI** (or equivalent) using LLM observability tools like **OPIK** or similar trace analysis platforms . ### **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * **Agent Test Design \& Automation:** Design and implement deterministic pytest suites to validate agent behavior, intent handling, tool\-call correctness, strict JSON schemas, and failure paths . * **LLM Evaluation Engineering:** Build and maintain LLM\-as\-a\-judge evaluation scripts that score agent outputs for correctness, tone, and compliance, defining scoring thresholds and pass/fail release gates . * **Mocking \& Trace Analysis:** Build mocks and fixtures for LLM endpoints and core APIs so agent loops run repeatably in CI pipelines . Execute, mock, and capture traces from LangGraph or Microsoft Agent Framework agent loops within test suites . * **Guardrail \& Security Testing:** Continuously validate that agents refuse prompt injection attempts, do not hallucinate actions, and strictly follow compliance guardrails . * **CI/CD Integration \& Reporting:** Integrate test suites into GitLab CI with DevOps, leverage OPIK for trace analysis, and deliver automated quality evidence gating weekly drops . ### **REQUIRED EXPERIENCE \& QUALIFICATIONS** * **Test Automation (Essential):** 4\+ years of test automation with strong Python and pytest . Experience testing APIs, contract testing, and strict JSON schema validation . * **AI \& LLM Testing (Essential):** 1\+ years of experience with behavioral acceptance criteria, evaluation datasets, and LLM\-as\-a\-judge techniques . Practical understanding of managing non\-determinism via statistical thresholds and automated judges . * **Frameworks (Essential):** Hands\-on familiarity with agentic frameworks (LangGraph, Microsoft Agent Framework, LangChain, or LlamaIndex) sufficient to execute and mock agent loops . * **Observability \& Domain (Desirable):** Experience with OPIK or equivalent trace analysis platforms . Prior experience testing in banking, fintech, or regulated financial environments . * Knowledge of Arabic language is plus. This job can be filled in **Egypt/MENA Region** . Create with us digital products that people love. We will bring businesses and consumers together through AI technology and creativity, driving digital transformation to impact the world positively. We may use AI and machine learning technologies in our recruitment process. Globant is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Globant is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know. Final compensation offered is based on multiple factors such as the specific role, hiring location, as well as individual skills, experience, and qualifications. In addition to competitive salaries, we offer a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about life at Globant here: Globant Experience Guide .

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager, University Graduate, 2027 Start
jobs.description: This role will begin accepting applications on September 22, 2025, targeting cohort starts between April and August 2027*.* You must complete your application \*before\* end of day on October 6, 2025 to be considered. Thank you in advance for your patience while our team reviews all applications. All applicants will be notified by the end of Spring 2027 with an update.* + In the “Resume" section, attach an updated CV or resume. No cover letter needed. + In the “Higher education" section, fill out the fields accordingly and select “Now attending” under "Degree status." Then, upload a current or recent unofficial or official transcript in English. Applicants in San Francisco: Qualified applications with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Mountain View, CA, USA; New York, NY, USA; San Bruno, CA, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; San Jose, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Currently enrolled in or graduated from a degree program within Product Management, Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Internship or Teaching Assistant experience in product management, software development or a similar technical field. * Experience leading entrepreneurial efforts or outreach within organizations while building cross\-functional relationships. * Experience preparing and delivering technical presentations to an audience through internships, coursework, or extracurriculars. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience with methodologies aimed to drive product development and delivery. * Experience applying AI/ML concepts to build products or features through relevant internship, capstone projects, or other academic work. * Technical experience with programming languages, data analysis, business case/modeling, pricing, or design. * Ability to start full\-time in the primary cohort onboarding cycle between April and August 2026\. * Ability to communicate in English fluently to support cross\-functional business relationships in the region. * Excellent problem\-solving, organizational, investigative, and critical thinking skills. **About the job** ----------------- At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day. In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development. One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users. Google aims to build products that organize the world's information and make it universally accessible to our users. As a Product Manager at Google, you could be working on new technologies, platforms, consumer facing products, and/or enterprise systems. The end goal will be to match you with the team that best aligns with your interests, experience, and where you will have the most impact. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $116000 \- $165000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Understand markets and user requirements in depth. * Launch products and features, test their performance, and iterate quickly. * Work collaboratively with Engineering, Marketing, Legal, and UX on technologies. * Develop innovative solutions to problems by collaborating as needed across regions, product areas, and functions. Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form.
