jobs.title: IT Intern
jobs.description: **About us** ============ HMH is a leading provider of drilling solutions, offering a wide range of products and services that are designed to be the safest and most efficient in the industry. Apart from our expertise in land and offshore operations, we are continuously expanding our knowledge within subsea mining, geothermal, onshore and offshore construction, as well as offshore wind industries. With offices in 16 countries across five continents, HMH maintains a strong global presence. HMH is a frontrunner in developing and providing automation and digital solutions for our drilling customers to support their endeavor to improve efficiency and environmental footprint. Equipped with its brilliant team of engineers, HMH is committed to actively exploring opportunities in other industries. For us, this means new opportunities and challenges that we need creativity and great minds to solve in our efforts to innovate our future. **Do you want to join our team?** --------------------------------- At HMH we value our employees. We offer exciting job opportunities that will give you the opportunity to grow in your role and give you the professional development you deserve. In addition to competitive pay and benefits, you will join a casual and inclusive work environment. Our environment is based on respect and having a good day at work, so you can expect to join a knowledgeable, global team who help each other to succeed. The IT Intern will be responsible for: * Assist in the installation, configuration, and maintenance of hardware and software systems * Provide technical support to end\-users, troubleshooting hardware and software issues * Assist with the setup and maintenance of computer networks, including routers, switches, and firewalls * Assist with account and access administration directly and via the Azure cloud * Participate in the development, testing and evaluation of new software applications and systems * Help maintain inventory of IT equipment and software licenses * Assist in the documentation of IT processes and procedures * Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in information technology The Intern will also learn about the following: * Incident Management and end user support * Cloud administration via Microsoft Azure (Entra, Intune, Autopilot, etc.) * Network and security * Software development and integration * IT Project Management * IT operations and infrastructure * User training and documentation **Skills/Requirements** * Currently enrolled and working toward completion of Bachelor or Graduate degree from an accredited university or college in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field * Minimum GPA of 3\.0 * Strong interest in technology and a desire to learn and grow in the IT field * Basic knowledge of IT hardware, software, cloud, AI, and networking concepts * Familiarity Microsoft 365 – Windows 10/11 and full MS Office 365 suite * Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills using tools such as Excel and PowerBi * Strong written and spoken communication and interpersonal skills * Ability to work independently and as part of a team * Attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks * Professionalism and a strong work ethic **Additional Information** * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis, now or in the future, without employer sponsorship for employment visa status. * No relocation assistance provided. * **Internship is 12 weeks, May 24 \- August 13, 2027** **Location** Houston, TX **\*\*This position is not open to visa sponsorship\*\***

jobs.title: Scrum Master/Data QA Engineer
jobs.description: **Halvik Corp** delivers a wide range of services to 13 executive agencies and 15 independent agencies. Halvik is a highly successful WOB business with more than 50 prime contracts and 500\+ professionals delivering Digital Services, Advanced Analytics, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Cyber Security and Cutting\-Edge Technology across the US Government. Be a part of something special! **Position Overview** Halvik is seeking a Scrum Master / Data QA Tester to support the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) IPNDS modernization effort. This role combines Agile/Kanban delivery facilitation with hands\-on quality assurance for enterprise data pipelines and analytics products. The position will work closely with the Product Owner, Business Analyst, data engineers, technical leads, architects, and DevSecOps/CloudOps teams to maintain delivery flow, remove blockers, execute data\-focused testing, manage defects, and support controlled releases across Dev, Test, and Production environments. **Core Responsibilities** * **Strategic Execution:** Facilitate Agile/Kanban delivery ceremonies and working sessions, including daily flow reviews, backlog replenishment, refinement, planning, delivery reviews, retrospectives, and blocker follow\-up. Maintain Jira boards, workflow status, WIP visibility, dependencies, delivery metrics, and action items. * **Operational Oversight:** Develop and execute test plans, test cases, regression suites, and release\-readiness checks for data pipelines, data products, and analytics solutions. Track testing progress, defects, retesting, and exit criteria through completion. * **Collaboration:** Partner with the Product Owner and Business Analyst to understand acceptance criteria and expected outcomes, and coordinate with data engineers, architects, BI developers, security, and DevSecOps/CloudOps teams to resolve blockers, defects, and release dependencies. The separate Business Analyst role will retain primary ownership of business requirements and detailed functional analysis. * **Technical Performance:** Perform data\-focused QA using SQL and analytical tools, including source\-to\-target reconciliation, record\-count and field\-level validation, business\-rule checks, duplicate/null detection, incremental\-load validation, rerun/recovery testing, and verification of downstream reports and datasets. Validate Bronze/Silver/Gold processing and data quality controls where applicable. * **DefectRelease Management:** Log, prioritize, and track defects; maintain traceable test evidence; coordinate UAT support and release checklists; validate deployment prerequisites and approvals; and perform post\-deployment smoke/regression testing in coordination with Data Engineering and DevSecOps/CloudOps teams. **Minimum Requirements** * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. * **Experience:** Minimum of 5 years of combined experience in Scrum Master/Agile delivery, software or data quality assurance, testing, or related roles supporting enterprise data, analytics, or application systems. * **Technical Proficiency:** Working\-to\-intermediate SQL skills for data validation and troubleshooting; hands\-on experience with Jira or similar Agile tools; experience testing ETL/ELT, data warehouse/lakehouse, APIs, or analytics solutions; familiarity with defect management, regression testing, UAT support, and release validation. * **Compliance:** Must meet applicable U.S. DOT contract security and suitability requirements and follow established change management, data protection, access control, testing, documentation, and release governance processes. * **Certifications:** Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), SAFe, Kanban, ISTQB, or comparable Agile/testing certification preferred; equivalent demonstrated experience will be considered. **Preferred Expertise** * Demonstrated success supporting U.S. DOT/BTS, FAA, or other Federal data/technology programs; experience with aviation, transportation, or other high\-volume regulated data is a plus. * Experience testing Databricks/Delta Lake or similar data platforms, including source\-to\-target reconciliation, data quality controls, batch/incremental pipelines, SQL validation, regression testing, and production\-release support. * Familiarity with CI/CD and controlled Dev\-Test\-Prod promotion, Git\-based workflows, test automation using Python or comparable tools, and collaboration with DevSecOps/CloudOps teams. Strong facilitation, communication, analytical, and problem\-solving skills. **Halvik offers a competitive full benefits package including:**Company\-supported medical, dental, vision, life, STD, and LTD insuranceBenefits include 11 federal holidays and PTOEligible employees may receive performance\-based incentives in recognition of individual and/or team achievements.401(k) with company matchingFlexible Spending Accounts for commuter, medical, and dependent care expensesTuition AssistanceCharitable Contribution matching *Halvik Corp is an* *equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.*

jobs.title: Sr. Databricks Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Halvik Corp** delivers a wide range of services to 13 executive agencies and 15 independent agencies. Halvik is a highly successful WOB business with more than 50 prime contracts and 500\+ professionals delivering Digital Services, Advanced Analytics, Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning, Cyber Security and Cutting\-Edge Technology across the US Government. Be a part of something special! **Position Overview** The Senior Databricks Data Engineer / Technical Lead will support the U.S. Department of Transportation (DOT) data modernization effort by designing, building, migrating, and operating secure, scalable data pipelines in a Databricks Lakehouse. This is a highly hands\-on role focused on legacy and external\-source migration, metadata\-driven ingestion, Medallion Architecture, data quality and reconciliation, production operations, and transition to the AWS/OneDOT environment. **Core Responsibilities** * **Strategic Execution:** Lead the design and implementation of reusable ingestion and transformation patterns for legacy and external data sources into Databricks, including support for migration to the AWS/OneDOT environment. * **Operational Oversight:** Build and operate Bronze, Silver, and Gold pipelines; manage batch and incremental loads, orchestration, dependencies, retries/recovery, monitoring, alerting, and production support. * **Collaboration:** Partner with the Technical Project Manager, Data Architects, business/data SMEs, BI developers, Cloud/DevSecOps, security, and governance teams to translate requirements into implementable data solutions. * **Technical Performance:** Develop and optimize Python, PySpark, and SQL workloads using Databricks, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Auto Loader and/or Lakeflow capabilities, and Databricks Jobs/Workflows with a focus on reliability, performance, and cost. * **Data QualityGovernance:** Implement source\-to\-target reconciliation, data validation, schema evolution, lineage, access controls, documentation, and reusable engineering standards for production data pipelines. **Minimum Requirements** * **Education:** Bachelor's degree in computer science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered. * **Experience:** Minimum of 7 years of professional data engineering experience, including significant hands\-on experience with Databricks/Spark and production data pipelines. * **Technical Proficiency:** Advanced Python, PySpark, and SQL skills; strong experience with Databricks, Delta Lake, AWS/S3, batch/file ingestion (CSV/JSON), REST APIs, Git/CI/CD, and data pipeline orchestration. * **Compliance:** Must meet applicable DOT contract security and suitability requirements and demonstrate secure handling of PII and other sensitive data, including access controls and secrets management. * **Certifications:** Relevant Databricks and/or AWS data engineering certification preferred; equivalent demonstrated hands\-on experience will be considered. **Preferred Expertise** * Demonstrated success modernizing legacy data platforms (Sybase/SAP IQ or similar) into Databricks, including source\-to\-target reconciliation, cutover, and production stabilization. * Experience with Unity Catalog, metadata/configuration\-driven ingestion, Auto Loader/Lakeflow, Databricks Jobs/Workflows, lineage/cataloging tools, and scalable multi\-source ingestion frameworks. * Federal/DOT delivery experience; familiarity with Agile/Kanban, production O\&M, cloud cost optimization, and data governance. Streaming and AI/ML data pipeline exposure is a plus. **Halvik offers a competitive full benefits package including:**Company\-supported medical, dental, vision, life, STD, and LTD insuranceBenefits include 11 federal holidays and PTOEligible employees may receive performance\-based incentives in recognition of individual and/or team achievements.401(k) with company matchingFlexible Spending Accounts for commuter, medical, and dependent care expensesTuition AssistanceCharitable Contribution matching *Halvik Corp is an* *equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.*

jobs.title: Chief Engineer
jobs.description: Job Title: Chief of Engineering Department: Engineering Supervisor: General Manager **Summary** This position supervises the maintenance operations and physical condition of the hotels within the assigned area to ensure the highest standards of guest satisfaction within the allotted budget. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** include the following. Other duties may be assigned. Supervises, develops and maintains an ongoing maintenance operation for hotel, including refrigeration, heating, plumbing, preventive maintenance, hotel rooms, air/heating units, ice machines, swimming pools, lighting, kitchen equipment, switch rooms, roof exhausts, electrical substations, etc. On an ongoing and regular basis, inspects and evaluates physical condition of entire hotel asset, including all guestrooms, public areas, pool area; completes and retains inspection reports on a regular and timely basis, using then\-current Company inspection forms. Works closely with other departments (i.e., Front Office and Housekeeping Departments on maintenance and repairs issues) to ensure high level of customer satisfaction. Orders material and completes work assignments on time and by a specified date. Performs work within departmental expense plans. Assists General Manager in capital projects when required. Maintains hotel by performing painting, plumbing, electrical wiring, and other related maintenance and preventative maintenance activities. Notifies management concerning need for major repairs or life safety issues and additions and repairs to all equipment property wide. May tend air conditioner and boiler to provide heat, cool air and hot water for guests. Communicates and interprets specifications, job orders and company policies. Oversees compliance with OSHA standards regarding proper usage, dilution of products, equipment safety and usage as well as blood\-borne pathogen precautions and procedures. Establishes or adjusts work procedures to meet production schedules, recommends measures to improve production. Analyzes and resolves work problems or assists employees in resolving work problems. Supervises and motivates maintenance staff including hiring, firing, coaching, counseling, evaluating and training activities. Communicates verbally and in writing with all levels of employees. Attends periodic meetings with General Manager and/or department heads, conducts and/or participates in safety meetings at designated intervals with hotel staff. Submits to management recommendations for painting, repairs, furnishings, relocation of equipment, and reallocation of space. Understands government regulations affecting hotel’s operations, ensuring hotel is operated in compliance with all applicable laws, ordinances, regulations, and requirements of any federal, state or municipal authority. Understands hotel’s MANAGER ON DUTY PROGRAM, following MOD guidelines and Risk Management/Workman’s Compensation procedures when responding to incidents. As required of all hotel associates, assists any customer or potential customer in a prompt, courteous, friendly, and helpful manner at all times. Other duties and responsibilities as assigned. **Supervisory Responsibilities** May supervise one or more of the following positions: Maintenance Worker. Supervise, monitor, and develop maintenance staff by providing supervision and professional development. **Competencies** To perform the job successfully, an individual should demonstrate the following competencies: Planning/Organizing \- Prioritizes and plans work activities; uses time efficiently; plans for additional resources; sets goals and objectives; organizes or schedules other people and their tasks; develops realistic action plans. Analytical \- Synthesizes complex or diverse information; collects and researches data; uses intuition and experience to complement data; designs work flows and procedures. Job Knowledge \- Competent in required job skills and knowledge; exhibits ability to learn and apply new skills; keeps abreast of current developments; requires minimal supervision; displays understanding of how job relates to others; uses resources effectively. Use of Technology \- Demonstrates required skills; adapts to new technologies; troubleshoots technological problems; uses technology to increase productivity; keeps technical skills up to date. Problem Solving \- Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner; gathers and analyzes information skillfully; develops alternative solutions; works well in group problem solving situations; uses reason even when dealing with emotional topics. Project Management \- Develops project plans; coordinates projects; communicates changes and progress; completes projects on time and budget; manages project team activities. Customer Service \- Manages difficult or emotional customer situations; responds promptly to customer needs; solicits customer feedback to improve service; responds to requests for service and assistance; meets commitments. Co p \- Exhibits confidence in self and others; inspires and motivates others to perform well; effectively influences actions and opinions of others; accepts feedback from others; gives appropriate recognition to others. Managing People \- Includes staff in planning, decision\-making, facilitating and process improvement; takes responsibility for subordinates' activities; makes self\-available to staff; provides regular performance feedback; develops subordinates' skills and encourages growth; solicits and applies customer feedback (internal and external); fosters quality focus in others; improves processes, products and services.; continually works to improve supervisory skills. Quality Management \- Looks for ways to improve and promote quality; demonstrates accuracy and thoroughness. Visionary Leadership \- Displays passion and optimism; inspires respect and trust; mobilizes others to fulfill the vision; provides vision and inspiration to peers and subordinates. Conflict Resolution \- Encourages open communications; confronts difficult situations; maintains objectivity; keeps emotions under control; uses negotiation skills to resolve conflicts. Cost Consciousness \- Works within approved budget; develops and implements cost saving measures; contributes to profits and revenue; conserves organizational resources. Ethics \- Treats people with respect; keeps commitments; inspires the trust of others; works with integrity and principles; upholds organizational values. Organizational Support \- Follows policies and procedures; completes administrative tasks correctly and on time; supports organization's goals and values; benefits organization through outside activities; supports affirmative action and respects diversity. Strategic Thinking \- Develops strategies to achieve organizational goals; understands organization's strengths \& weaknesses; analyzes market and competition; identifies external threats and opportunities; adapts strategy to changing conditions. **Qualifications** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Education and/or Experience** High School diploma or general education degree (GED) preferred. Prior hotel maintenance experience of at least 4 years or more is a plus, with previous experience in management of maintenance/engineering specific to electrical, plumbing, HVAC system, ventilation system and carpentry. **Language Skills** Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public. **Reasoning Ability** Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. Ability to deal with problems involving several concrete variables in standardized situations. **Computer Skills** To perform this job successfully, an individual should have knowledge of Database software. Computer literacy, Microsoft Office. **Physical Demands** The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk and sit. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. **Work Environment** The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate.

jobs.title: Principal Information Systems Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Current Employees of Happen Bank: Please apply via your internal Workday Account** Happen Bank (formerly LendingClub) is built around a simple purpose: to clear the way to help people turn intention into action, and action into financial progress. That means offering focused products, a frictionless mobile\-first experience, and clear terms with no gotchas. Respect and fairness is part of our DNA, and that ideal shapes how we work, how we treat each other, and how we invest in our employees and our community. Join us in using data, bold thinking, and a commitment to innovation to help clear the way for millions of Americans to achieve more. **About the Role** ------------------ Happen Bank is looking for a Principal Information Systems Engineer to own the strategy, architecture, and technical direction for our Windows and Mac end user computing environment. You’ll serve as the senior technical authority for device management, security, automation, and endpoint modernization, while acting as the escalation point for the most complex and high\-impact issues. In this role, you’ll shape how Happen manages and secures devices at scale, modernize tooling and processes, and design automation that improves reliability and reduces repetitive work. You’ll also mentor teammates and partner with vendors and onshore/offshore resources to ensure solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with business needs.**What You'll Do** ------------------ * Serve as the top escalation point for Windows and Mac issues Helpdesk can’t resolve, diagnosing and closing out the most complex, high\-visibility problems, while simultaneously solving the “why does this keep happening and how do I engineer this to not happen again” * Administer SCCM, Intune and JAMF, building and deploying application packages and OS images to laptops and desktops across the globe * Shape the systems and strategy behind secure, efficient, cost\-effective client management, including how we evaluate, test, and roll out new Windows and Mac OS versions * Build automation — scripting in Bash, Python, and PowerShell — to eliminate repetitive work, using AI tools to speed up scripting, testing, and troubleshooting where it genuinely helps * Lead technical resources across projects, coordinating with teammates in the US and with vendors and onshore/offshore partners to keep delivery on track * Review designs and solutions from junior team members for technical accuracy, and coach and mentor them as they grow * Evaluate and certify security updates, patches, and service packs before they roll out to Mac and PC clients, balancing speed with risk * Develop integrations with new technologies, including systems that carry real risk and visibility, and architect how new endpoints get configured and deployed **About You** ------------- * 10\+ years of experience in end user computing, endpoint engineering, systems engineering, or a related technical field * Bachelor's degree or higher, or equivalent combination of education and experience * Deep hands\-on expertise with endpoint management platforms such as JAMF, Active Directory, SCCM, and Intune * You take ownership of problems through to resolution, exercising sound technical judgment, and consistently look for ways to improve reliability, efficiency, and user experience * Works independently with minimal oversight, prioritizing and multitasking across competing priorities without losing quality * Brings deep, hands\-on expertise with CIS/NIST standards and applies them confidently in complex, highly sensitive environments * Spots new or unprecedented problems quickly and works through them methodically, asking the right questions before acting * Proven ability to establish technical direction and align engineering decisions align with company objectives * Applies sound judgment when using AI and other new tools to move faster on scripting, troubleshooting, and automation — staying alert to accuracy, data sensitivity, and compliance in a regulated environment * Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical solutions for teammates, vendors, and end users and cross\-trains others effectively * Experience with Intune for client software deployment, inventory, antivirus, and endpoint security * JAMF, SCCM, or Intune certification * Experience with Okta, Entra ID, and identity access management * Experience with Terraform, AWS EC2, or Kubernetes/EKS **Nice to Have** * Network engineering experience, including 802\.1x configuration for wired and wireless connections * Familiarity with configuration profiles and preference files (.plist) * Experience with Citrix or Amazon Workspaces * Experience with Bitwarden or a similar corporate credential manager **Work Location** San Francisco, Lehi The above locations are eligible offices for this role. The locations have been determined to foster in\-person collaboration with this role’s team or the related business lines. We utilize a hybrid work model, and our teams are in\-office Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. In\-person attendance is essential for this role’s success, and remote placement will not be considered. Happen Bank offers relocation, based on actual job level. **Time Zone Requirements** Local hours (PT, MT) While the position will primarily work local hours, Happen Bank is headquartered in Pacific Time and our ideal candidate will be flexible working across time zones when necessary. **Travel Requirements** As needed travel to Happen Bank offices and/or other locations, as needed. **Compensation** The target base salary range for this position is 158,000\-205,000\. The base salary of the role will be determined by job\-related knowledge, experience, education, skills, and location. Base salary is just one part of Happen Bank's Total Rewards package. You may also be eligible for long\-term awards (equity) and an annual bonus (which is based on company performance, employee performance and eligible earnings). We’re creating new financial services solutions for our members based on fairness, simplicity, and heart, and we treat our employees the same way. We offer a competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental and vision plans for employees and their families, 401(k) match, health and wellness programs, flexible time off policies for salaried employees, up to 16 weeks paid parental leave and more. \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-BC1 Happen Bank is an equal opportunity employer and dedicated to diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We believe that a variety of perspectives will make our teams and business stronger as we work together to transform the traditional banking system. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application process. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please contact us at interviewaccommodations@happen.com. **Notice on AI Tool Use** For select roles and locations, candidate interviews may be recorded, transcribed and summarized by tools such as artificial intelligence (AI) to assist our hiring managers with the application process. You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription, and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. We will not discriminate against you if you choose to opt out. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information from or about you: contact information, identifiers, professional and employment\-related information, sensory information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment. We will only share your interview, transcription, or summary with persons whose expertise or technology is necessary to process your application, evaluate your fitness for a position, and administer or support the tool. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, please refer to our Privacy Disclosure. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly but in no event later than 30 days after making a hiring decision.

jobs.title: Director of Translational Science
jobs.description: **Job Description:** Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (BIDMC), a major teaching hospital of Harvard Medical School, seeks an internationally recognized physician\-scientist or biomedical scientist to serve as Director of Translational Science and MedTech Innovation within the Center for Innovation in Invasive Cardiology. The Center is one of the key pillars of the Richard A. and Susan F. Smith Institute for Evidence, Innovation, and Policy. This faculty position will be appointed at Harvard Medical School, commensurate with experience and academic accomplishments. The Director will provide strategic leadership for a multidisciplinary research program focused on the discovery, evaluation, and clinical translation of innovative cardiovascular technologies, with strengths in structural heart disease and heart valve science. The successful candidate will foster collaborations across cardiology, interventional cardiology, cardiac surgery, cardiovascular imaging, pathology, engineering, and basic science to accelerate the development of next\-generation cardiovascular devices and therapies. Working closely with faculty throughout the clinical and academic ecosystem, the Director will establish and expand programs that bridge fundamental discovery with clinical implementation to improve outcomes for patients with cardiovascular disease. **Position Responsibilities** The Director of Translational Science and MedTech Innovation will be a full\-time academic FTE with no clinical role. The Director will provide scientific, operational, and strategic leadership for the Center for Innovation in Invasive Cardiology by: * Developing and leading an internationally recognized translational cardiovascular research program spanning fundamental discovery, engineering, preclinical evaluation, and clinical investigation. * Establishing multidisciplinary collaborations among clinicians, biomedical engineers, cardiovascular pathologists, imaging specialists, and basic scientists to advance innovative cardiovascular therapies. * Directing research programs focused on structural heart disease, transcatheter valve therapies, coronary interventions, and emerging catheter\-based cardiovascular technologies. * Leading integrated research programs in cardiovascular device evaluation utilizing benchtop simulation, hydrodynamic performance testing, computational modeling, advanced cardiovascular imaging, pathology, and explant analysis * Developing translational research platforms that integrate engineering, pathology, imaging, biomechanics, and clinical investigation to improve cardiovascular device design, procedural planning, long\-term durability, and patient outcomes. * Expanding institutional infrastructure supporting cardiovascular innovation, including cardiovascular simulation laboratories, device testing facilities, and translational research cores. * Establishing internationally recognized programs in translational heart valve science, integrating human explant pathology, advanced imaging, biomechanics, and engineering approaches to better understand mechanisms of cardiovascular device failure and develop more durable therapeutic technologies. * Building collaborative partnerships across Harvard\-affiliated institutions and with academic and industry collaborators to accelerate translation of innovative cardiovascular technologies from laboratory investigation to clinical implementation. * Leading multidisciplinary grant initiatives supported by the NIH, foundations, federal agencies, and collaborative research partnerships. * Recruiting and mentoring faculty, engineers, postdoctoral fellows, graduate students, residents, fellows, and research staff engaged in cardiovascular innovation. * Providing scientific leadership for educational programs in invasive cardiology, structural heart disease, cardiovascular device development, translational science, and medical technology innovation. * Representing Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center nationally and internationally as a leader in translational cardiovascular science and medical technology innovation. **Teaching and Academic Responsibilities** Faculty at Harvard Medical School are expected to contribute to excellence in teaching, scholarship, and service. Teaching responsibilities may include: * Mentorship of graduate students, residents, fellows, postdoctoral scholars, and junior faculty. * Didactic instruction in cardiovascular medicine, biomedical engineering, translational science, and cardiovascular pathology. * Hands\-on education in cardiovascular device development, benchtop simulation, and translational research methodologies. * Leadership of multidisciplinary conferences, innovation seminars, translational science workshops, and structural heart educational programs. * Development of educational initiatives that integrate engineering, pathology, and clinical cardiovascular medicine. **Qualifications** Candidates should possess: * MD, PhD, or equivalent doctoral deg pathology, biomedical engineering, or related disciplines. * Demonstrated success leading multidisciplinary research programs that integrate engineering, pathology, imaging, and clinical investigation. * An established record of sustained extramural funding. * A distinguished record of peer\-reviewed scholarship. * Experience developing collaborative research partnerships across academic disciplines and industry partnerships. * Demonstrated excellence in mentorship, leadership, and program development. Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable: * Structural heart interventions * Translational heart valve science * Bioprosthetic valve durability * Cardiovascular pathology * Cardiovascular biomechanics * Cardiovascular device engineering * Computational modeling * Cardiovascular imaging * Bench and preclinical device evaluation * Translational clinical investigation **Vision** The Director will define and execute a strategic vision establishing the Center for Innovation in Invasive Cardiology as an internationally recognized leader in translational cardiovascular science and medical technology innovation. Through multidisciplinary collaboration, engineering excellence, pathology, and clinical investigation, the Center will advance discoveries from laboratory and benchtop investigation to clinical practice, accelerating the development of safer, more durable, and more effective cardiovascular therapies. The Center will serve as a destination for investigators committed to understanding cardiovascular disease and device performance across the full continuum of translational science from mechanistic discovery and human tissue investigation to engineering innovation, clinical evaluation, and implementation—improving the lives of patients worldwide. **Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center**, a 743\-bed hospital and Level 1 Trauma Center, is a founding member of Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH). BILH, a health care system with 14 hospitals, brings together academic medical centers and teaching hospitals, community and specialty hospitals, and more than 4,000 physicians and 39,000 employees in a shared mission to expand access and advance the science and practice of medicine through groundbreaking research and education. **Harvard Medical Faculty Physicians** at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (HMFP) is one of the largest physician organizations in New England, dedicated to excellence and innovation in patient care, education, and research. As a physician\-led organization, HMFP partners with more than 2,400 providers to support the delivery of exceptional care, promote professional development and foster balance at work and home. HMFP physicians have faculty affiliations with Harvard Medical School (HMS) and provide care throughout BILH system and additional hospitals across Massachusetts. If submitting a cover letter, please upload it as one document with your current curriculum vitae. Cover letters may be addressed to James McCabe, M.D., Section Head, Structural Heart Therapies \& Director of the Center for Innovation in Invasive Cardiology. **Pay Range:** $80,000 \- $350,000 The base pay range reflects what Harvard Medical Faculty Physicians at Beth Israel Deaconess Medical Center (HMFP) reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this role at the time of posting and may be modified from time to time. Actual compensation within this range may be determined based on several factors, including academic appointment, work experience, specialty training, geography of work location, anticipated productivity, FTE basis, and role expectations. In addition to base compensation, this role may be eligible for performance\-based incentives, which may include bonuses for productivity and quality HMFP also offers a comprehensive and generous employee benefits program to eligible employees, including health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, as well as retirement plan(s) with employer contributions.

jobs.title: Application Engineer III
jobs.description: COMPANY DESCRIPTION: Hengli America Corporation (www.henglihydraulics.com) is a subsidiary of Jiangsu Hengli Hydraulic Co. Ltd., a world class manufacturer of hydraulic components and hydraulic system integrator located in Changzhou China approximately 3 hours from Shanghai. Hengli’s brand is recognized globally as a superior supplier in earthmoving and construction, mining, lift, aerial work platform, marine and offshore, and the oil and gas markets. Hengli America is in the greater Chicago area and is rapidly growing in the areas of product research and development, application development, manufacturing, and customer service. SUMMARY OF POSITION: The Hydraulic Application Engineer III is a senior customer\-facing technical authority within Hengli America’s Sales organization responsible for complex, high\-value, and strategically important hydraulic applications. This position leads technical architecture, application strategy, advanced troubleshooting, corrective\-action planning, and executive/OEM technical engagement while influencing product strategy and application standards. The role develops engineering capability through mentoring, technical leadership, and continuous improvement while delivering measurable customer and business impact. PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES: * Technical Application Support: Serve as a senior technical authority for complex hydraulic and electrohydraulic systems; define application architecture, analyze system interactions and risk, and lead resolution of high\-complexity technical challenges. * Product Selection \& Configuration: Lead complex product/system sizing, selection, configuration, integration, competitive conversion, and design validation across Hengli product families; establish sound technical approaches for strategic and high\-value applications. * Customer \& Distributor Support: Own strategic OEM, distributor, and key\-customer technical relationships; lead high\-level application reviews, technical negotiations, presentations, and solution development with urgency and credibility. * Application Discovery: Define and enforce disciplined discovery for complex applications, ensuring complete performance, duty\-cycle, controls, environmental, installation, safety, validation, commercial, and lifecycle requirements are understood before solution commitment. * Sales Support: Partner with Sales on strategic opportunities by shaping technical strategy, proposals, specifications, demonstrations, customer training, competitive conversions, and executive\-level technical presentations. * Troubleshooting \& Post\-Sale Support: Lead complex troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, corrective\-action strategy, validation, and risk reduction; guide RCA/FMEA and cross\-functional response for significant field, quality, or application issues. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Lead technical coordination across Sales, Customer Service, Quality, Manufacturing, R\&D, Product Management, and China\-based resources; remove technical barriers, establish accountability, and drive strategic actions to closure. * Execution \& Responsiveness: Set the standard for urgency, prioritization, technical ownership, documentation, and follow\-through; guide escalation decisions and improve processes that reduce response time and application cycle time. * Market \& Product Insight: Translate Voice of Customer, competitive intelligence, field experience, and market trends into application standards, product strategy, new\-product development priorities, technical documentation, and continuous\-improvement actions. * Customer Engagement \& Travel: Lead strategic customer/OEM visits, executive technical reviews, training, field resolution, manufacturing visits, and trade\-show engagement; mentor Levels I–II and serve as a train\-the\-trainer resource. Approximately 25% annual travel requirement. POSITION REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS: * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, agricultural, fluid power, mechatronics, or a related engineering/technical field; equivalent relevant education and 3\-5\+ years of demonstrated hydraulic application experience may be considered. * Expert demonstrated competence in hydraulic and electrohydraulic systems, components, schematics, system interactions, controls, application architecture, and complex/high\-value application ownership. * Advanced proficiency in product/system sizing, selection, configuration, integration, design review, structured troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, FMEA, corrective action, and technical risk assessment. * Exceptional written, verbal, presentation, and customer\-facing communication skills with the ability to influence OEM engineers, customer leadership, sales professionals, manufacturing teams, and global technical resources. * Demonstrated technical judgment, leadership, problem\-solving, ownership, active listening, mentoring, decision\-making, urgency, and ability to lead through complex or ambiguous technical situations. * Advanced proficiency with CAD/engineering tools, ERP, CRM, product configurators, Microsoft Office, and analytical/modeling tools appropriate to assigned applications. * Strong working knowledge of quality, safety, documentation, change\-control, RCA, FMEA, continuous\-improvement, and project\-management practices; functional safety, advanced controls/modeling, or equivalent development is preferred. * Ability and willingness to travel to customers, distributors, manufacturing locations, training events, and trade shows as business needs require. * Ability to speak Chinese (Mandarin) is a plus. * Local to the greater Chicago/Bolingbrook, Illinois area or willing to relocate is ideal. Hybrid roles will be considered for well qualified candidates. Development may include advanced project management, functional safety, advanced controls/modeling, engineering leadership, and train\-the\-trainer capability. Advancement and continued standing are based on demonstrated competence, documented experience, performance, and manager/technical\-reviewer approval—not tenure. Our commitment to internal AI adoption has allowed us to stay at the forefront of technological advancements, ensuring our colleagues can unlock their creativity and productivity, and our solutions are always cutting\-edge. At IFS, we’re flexible, we’re innovative, and we’re focused not only on how we can engage with our customers but also on how we can make a real change and have a worldwide impact. We help solve some of society’s greatest challenges, fostering a better future through our agility, collaboration, and trust. We celebrate diversity and understand our responsibility to reflect the diverse world we work in. We are committed to promoting an inclusive workforce that fully represents the many different cultures, backgrounds, and viewpoints of our customers, our partners, and our communities. As a truly international company serving people from around the globe, we realize that our success is tantamount to the respect we have for those different points of view. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to be part of a **global, diverse environment;** you will be joining a **winning team** with a **commitment to sustainability;** and a company where we get things done so that you can **make a positive impact** on the world. We’re looking for innovative and original thinkers to work in an environment where you can **\#MakeYourMoment** so that we can help others make theirs. With the power of our AI\-driven solutions, we empower our team to change the status quo and make a real difference. If you want to change the status quo, we’ll help you make your moment. Join Team Purple. Join IFS. **Job Description** **About our Aerospace \& Defense business** Our Aerospace \& Defense business helps the world's leading airlines, MROs, OEMs and defense operators keep complex fleets and platforms mission\-ready — managing the full maintenance, asset and service lifecycle at scale. We are changing how that software gets built: closer to the operations it serves, in shorter cycles, and increasingly with AI. That means investing in engineers who work at the point of contact between our products and our customers. **Qualifications** As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer in our Aerospace \& Defense business, you build aviation products directly with our customers. You embed with the airlines, MROs, OEMs and defense operators who keep complex fleets flying, work alongside their people in their own environments, and turn what you see there into working software — shipped quickly, hardened in real operations, and fed back into the product so every customer benefits. This is engineering at the point of contact: the shortest path between a customer's problem and a product that solves it. The role is deliberately broad. You build across the stack — backend services and APIs, data models and integrations, web interfaces — and you own what you ship end to end, from design and testing through deployment and operational reliability in customer environments. You connect IFS to the systems that run our customers' operations, and you do it under real constraints: live fleets, regulated processes, restricted networks and firm deadlines. AI is becoming both part of how we build and part of what we ship, so experience building AI\-powered solutions is a strong advantage. **What you'll do** * **Build with the customer.** Embed with Aerospace \& Defense customers — on their sites and inside their systems — to learn how their operation actually works, then design and ship software with them rather than for them. You shorten the loop between a real problem and a working answer. * **Ship across the stack.** Design, build and test full\-stack features in modern general\-purpose languages — services and APIs, data and persistence, integrations and web interfaces. Breadth matters more than depth in any one framework here. * **Integrate into real operations.** Connect IFS to the systems that run our customers' businesses — ERP, CRM, IoT and telemetry, and long\-lived legacy and mission systems — and own the solution architecture in real customer context. * **Own delivery end to end.** You build it, you run it: automated testing, CI/CD, deployment, observability and operational reliability across cloud and customer environments. When it breaks in production, you are the one who makes it right. * **Bring AI into the work.** Use AI\-assisted and agentic development tooling as a normal part of how you build, and help take AI\-powered product capabilities into customer environments where they have to hold up under real conditions. * **Turn field work into product.** Feed what you learn on site back into the core product and the roadmap, so a fix for one customer becomes a capability for all of them. You work closely with product management and the wider engineering teams to make that happen. * **Represent IFS credibly.** Be the technical voice customers trust — able to work through a design with their engineers, explain a trade\-off to an operations leader, and hold your own in front of partners. **What you'll bring** Essential * **Full\-stack breadth:** hands\-on experience designing, building and shipping production software across the stack — backend services and APIs, data and integrations, and web front ends — with proficiency in modern general\-purpose programming languages rather than a single domain framework. * **Customer\-facing delivery:** substantial experience working directly with customers, on site or embedded in their teams, to deploy, integrate, harden and support enterprise software in their own environment — including integration with systems such as ERP, CRM, IoT and legacy platforms. * **End\-to\-end ownership:** a you\-build\-it, you\-run\-it mindset with real accountability for what you ship — quality and automated testing, CI/CD, cloud and DevOps, and security. * **Senior\-level autonomy:** a track record of owning significant pieces of delivery with little supervision, making sound architecture and shipping\-quality calls under time pressure, and raising the standard of the engineers around you. * **Communication and judgement:** excellent communication with technical and non\-technical audiences, comfort with ambiguity and shifting priorities, and the instinct to ground technical decisions in direct customer evidence and business value. * **Willingness to travel** to customer sites as the work requires. Nice to have * **Experience building AI solutions (strongly preferred):** shipping AI\-powered capabilities in products — model integration, prompt engineering, RAG, agentic architectures, evaluation and testing — and/or using AI\-assisted and agentic development tooling as a core part of your workflow. * Experience working in or with Aerospace \& Defense organisations, or on solutions for asset, maintenance, MRO or fleet\-readiness management. * Experience with other enterprise asset management (EAM), field service or maintenance\-management solutions. * Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * Experience of agile delivery and of working with globally distributed teams. **Additional Information** **What We’re Offering** * Flexible paid time off, including sick and holiday * Medical, dental, \& vision insurance * 401K with Company contribution * Flexible spending accounts * Life insurance and disability benefits * Tuition assistance * Community involvement and volunteering events M/F/Disabled/Vet VEVRAA Federal Contractor. jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager - Retail
jobs.description: The Assistant Project Manager supports the successful delivery of retail construction projects from award through closeout. Quality Control \& Closeout * Support quality control efforts throughout project execution. * Assist with punch list development, tracking, and completion. * Coordinate collection of warranties, operation and maintenance manuals, and closeout documentation. * Support project turnover activities and final project completion requirements. * Assist with warranty administration as needed. Technology \& Systems * Maintain project information within company and client\-required software platforms. * Utilize Procore and other project management tools to support project documentation and communication. * Ensure project information is current, accurate, and properly documented within required systems. Other Duties * Perform all other duties as assigned. **What We're Looking For** Education \& Experience * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Construction Engineering, Architecture, Business, or related field preferred. * Equivalent construction experience may be considered in lieu of formal education. * OSHA 30 certification preferred or willingness to obtain within the first six months of employment. * 1\-5 years of experience in construction project coordination, project engineering, estimating, field supervision, or related construction roles preferred. * Ability to read and interpret construction drawings and specifications. * Understanding of basic construction processes and project delivery methods. * Familiarity with construction scheduling, procurement, and contract administration concepts. * Valid driver's license and acceptable driving record. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams. * Experience with Procore preferred. Abilities * Strong attention to detail and accuracy. * Effective verbal and written communication skills. * Excellent organizational and time\-management abilities. * Ability to prioritize multiple tasks and meet deadlines. * Strong problem\-solving and critical\-thinking skills. * Collaborative team player with a customer\-focused mindset. * Self\-motivated with a willingness to learn and grow professionally. * Ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast\-paced environment. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Analytics Engineer
jobs.description: Improvado is an AI\-powered marketing data platform built for mid\-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. jobs.title: SOFTWARE ENGINEER I (205A91526)
jobs.description: TARGET SALARY: UP TO 70,000\.00 DOQ **Who we are** Infinite Campus is an educational software company that helps K12 school districts manage their day\-to\-day operations. We’ve been around for over 29 years and are the most trusted name in student information. Our customers include school districts across the United States and our products support more than eight million students. **What you’ll do** The Software Engineer I – Full Stack Product Development is responsible for design, development, and testing of select product area(s) of the Infinite Campus Software Products. Incumbent should have internship or entry level work experience/knowledge of Java, Angular and/or Javascript. SQL; relational database knowledge desired. Understanding of rest API. Able to demonstrate/write, test and debug code. Ability to work autonomously as well as in a team/collaborative environment. Understanding of SDLC and agile processes. Code software to adhere to designs supporting business requirements. Debug and test code. Create unit and other automated code validation tests. Estimate level of effort for individual work. Research, investigate, and fix a wide range of technical issues. Use agile planning, estimation, communication, and release processes. Write system documentation in support of the code being developed. **Who you are** You are responsible; able to achieve desired results within expected time frames with a high degree of quality and professionalism. You are able to establish and maintain positive and productive work relationships with all staff, customers and cross\-functional teams. You are professional with a positive attitude and are able to assimilate to the company’s culture and development philosophy. You are ethical; will have a strong work ethic and a passion for excellence. You are self\-motivated, collaborative and self\-directed with a strong preference to work in a team environment yet able to work independently as needed. You are well organized and goal oriented able to handle multiple assignments simultaneously – a multi\-tasker. You are curious; will seek to understand the unknown. You are an excellent communicator with the ability to effectively and proactively communicate with internal stakeholders. **Your skill\-set** You will have a bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related field and internship or one year software development experience; OR three years software development work experience. You will possess and leverage knowledge of standard concepts, practices, and procedures in technologies used at Infinite Campus (e.g., Java, Groovy, SQL, JavaScript, and/or Angular). **What we offer** A highly competitive compensation package that reflects our commitment to the people who work here. No matter where you’re at in life, we’ve got you covered. • Medical • Onsite Health Center for employee and family • Teledoc • Dental • Vision • Health Savings Account • Flexible Spending Accounts • Short \& Long Term Disability • Life and ADD insurance • Generous paid time off (PTO) • Holiday pay • Employee Assistance Program • 100% matching 401k • Employee Stock Option Plan • Education Assistance • Daily free lunch and beverages at our onsite restaurant A relaxed work environment that embraces onsite in person collaboration with flexibility to work offsite (remote). Infinite Campus is a place where smart, talented people work together with other smart and talented people every day. **What we live by** We solve problems at Infinite Campus. Driven by our mission and vision to Transform K12 Education®, we build solutions to serve K12 education and empower change for the better. We have shown that by adapting and applying technology and practices used by the private sector to K12, educators can be more productive in their daily tasks, and accomplish things previously thought to be impossible **Not sure if this is for you?** We want a diverse team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job has piqued your interest, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyways! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team or position that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or send you off with our gratitude and a thank you for your time. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Infinite Campus, Inc. provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Infinite Campus complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training . Infinite Campus, Inc. expressly prohibits any form of workplace harassment based on race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status. Improper interference with the ability of Infinite Campus’ employees to perform their job duties may result in discipline up to and including discharge. \#LI\-ONSITE
