jobs.title: CONSTRUCTION INSPECTOR (SEWER)
jobs.description: **Construction Inspector – Sewer / Infrastructure (NYCDDC)** **Location:** Rockaway, Queens, NY **Employer:** Liriano \& Associates Engineering Consulting Services, PLLC **Work Schedule:** Day and/or Night Shifts (Night work may be required) **About the Project**: The project involves the rehabilitation of approximately **1,300 linear feet of large\-diameter combined sewer interceptor** beneath Beach Channel Drive in Rockaway, Queens. The work includes sliplining existing sewers using **centrifugally\-cast fiberglass\-reinforced polymer mortar (CCFRPM) pipe**, annular grouting, confined space monitoring, and coordination with DEP, DOT, and other agencies We are seeking an experienced **Construction Inspector** with proven **sewer infrastructure experience under NYCDDC contracts**. The Inspector will support the Resident Engineer and project team in administering and inspecting construction operations, ensuring full compliance with contract documents, NYCDEP and NYCDDC standards, and safety regulations. **Key Responsibilities** * Perform daily inspection of sewer rehabilitation operations, including cleaning, CCTV verification, sliplining installation, grouting, and confined\-space activities. * Review and document contractor work for conformance with plans, specifications, and permits. * Verify materials, quantities, and work progress for payment purposes. * Maintain detailed daily inspection reports, including photographs and field measurements. * Review contractor payment requests and recommend reasonableness to the Resident Engineer. * Identify potential extra\-work issues, notify the Resident Engineer, and assist in preparing cost estimates and supporting documentation. * Monitor traffic control (MPT), environmental protection, and public safety measures. * Oversee confined\-space entry procedures and OSHA Subpart AA compliance. * Verify annular grouting operations, including mix design, density, and pressure logs. * Ensure proper vibration and settlement monitoring where required. * Communicate effectively with the Resident Engineer, Assistant RE, contractor staff, and agency representatives. * Prepare and maintain documentation in accordance with **NYCDDC “Standard Records”** and project filing protocols. * Support coordination with DEP, DOT, Parks, Con Edison, National Grid, and other involved agencies. **Required Qualifications** * **Minimum 5 years of experience inspecting NYC infrastructure projects, including sewer or water\-main work under NYCDDC contracts.** * **Bachelors in engineering.** * **Willingness to work night shifts as required by the project’s construction schedule.** * Understanding of sewer lining, grouting, or confined\-space rehabilitation methods. * Working knowledge of **contract administration**, including unit\-price and lump\-sum contracts. * Proficiency in **Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)** and familiarity with project software such as **PIMS/PDMS** preferred. * Ability to read and interpret **plans, specifications, and shop drawings**. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills. * OSHA 10\-Hour or 30\-Hour Construction Safety Training (required). * Confined\-Space Entry certification (preferred or must be willing to obtain). * Ability to travel daily to Rockaway, Queens. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $47\.00 \- $60\.00 per hour Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Employee assistance program * Employee discount * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Parental leave * Professional development assistance * Referral program * Retirement plan * Tuition reimbursement * Vision insurance Application Question(s): * Do you have experience working as an Inspector on NYCDDC projects, particularly in sewer? * Do you hold a Bachelors Degree in Engineering? * How many years of experience do you have working on infrastructure projects, preferably sewer? * Are you willing to commute to Rockaway, Queens, and understand that night work may be required? Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Mechanical Estimator (eg)
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Mechanical Estimator **Company:** Loenbro, LLC **Business Unit/Department:** Loenbro Southeast **Location:** Franklin, TN, Atlanta, GA, Charlotte, NC, Columbia, SC, Richmond, VA, Jackson, MS, Jacksonville, FL, Orlando, FL, Louisville, KY, Knoxville, TN, Birmingham, AL, Memphis, TN **Reports to:** Chief Estimator **Employment Type:** Full\-Time **FLSA Classification:** Exempt **About Loenbro** Loenbro is a trusted, long\-term construction lifecycle partner to thousands of customers across the U.S. Our market spans all industries, and our service offerings include Critical Electrical, Mechanical \& Structural, Soft Crafts, Inspection, Underground Maintenance and Installation, and Fabrication. Our expertise lies in simplifying the complex and establishing long\-standing relationships with our partners. We have a national presence but a local approach—every customer benefits from our capabilities and our care. **At Loenbro, we don't just offer jobs—we build careers grounded in integrity, teamwork, excellence, and purpose.** Join a team where your expertise is valued, your growth is supported, and your work helps maintain and enhance the critical infrastructure that powers communities across the nation. The Commercial Mechanical Estimator is responsible for preparing accurate and competitive cost estimates for commercial mechanical construction projects, including HVAC, plumbing, piping, sheet metal, and mechanical systems. This role analyzes project plans, specifications, labor requirements, materials, equipment, subcontractor pricing, and project schedules to develop comprehensive bid proposals. The estimator works closely with project managers, operations personnel, vendors, subcontractors, engineers, and clients throughout the preconstruction and bidding process. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities** * Review project plans, specifications, contracts, and bid documents. * Perform detailed quantity takeoffs for HVAC, plumbing, piping, and other mechanical systems. * Develop complete labor, material, equipment, and subcontractor cost estimates. * Solicit and evaluate vendor and subcontractor quotations. * Prepare bid proposals, budgets, conceptual estimates, and change order pricing. * Attend pre\-bid meetings, job walks, and project site visits. * Analyze project risks, constructability issues, and scope gaps. * Coordinate with project managers and operations teams during project handoff. * Develop and maintain estimating databases, labor units, and cost histories. * Collaborate with engineering, procurement, and field teams to ensure estimate accuracy. * Evaluate value engineering opportunities and alternative design solutions. * Support contract negotiations and proposal presentations. * Monitor bid results and maintain relationships with clients, vendors, and subcontractors. * Ensure compliance with project specifications, applicable codes, and industry standards. **Qualifications** **Required** * High school diploma or GED. * 3\+ years of commercial mechanical estimating experience. * Strong understanding of HVAC, plumbing, piping, and mechanical construction practices. * Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, specifications, and contract documents. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite. * Strong mathematical, analytical, and organizational skills. * Excellent written and verbal communication abilities. **Preferred** * Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, or related field. * Experience with estimating software such as Trimble, FastEST, QuoteSoft, AutoBid Mechanical, Bluebeam, or equivalent platforms. * Commercial field experience in mechanical construction. * Knowledge of BIM and mechanical coordination processes. * Experience estimating healthcare, industrial, educational, manufacturing, data center, or large commercial projects. **Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities** * Thorough knowledge of mechanical systems, equipment, and installation methods. * Understanding of labor productivity, material pricing, and construction scheduling. * Strong negotiation and vendor management skills. * Ability to manage multiple estimates simultaneously and meet strict deadlines. * Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy. * Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a team environment. * Knowledge of applicable mechanical codes, standards, and safety requirements. * Proficiency in cost analysis, budgeting, and bid strategy development. **Physical Requirements** * Prolonged periods of sitting and computer work. * Ability to travel to project sites, customer locations, and pre\-bid meetings. * Ability to walk active construction sites and perform field assessments. **Working Conditions** * Primarily office\-based with occasional field visits. * Frequent interaction with clients, vendors, subcontractors, engineers, and project teams. * May require overtime to meet project deadlines and bid submission schedules. *This role requires compliance with all applicable safety regulations, personal protective equipment (PPE) requirements, and Loenbro's Environmental Health and Safety (EH\&S) policies.* **Benefits** Loenbro offers a competitive salary, comprehensive benefits package, and rewards to those who join our team: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k) retirement plan with company match. * Paid time off (PTO). * Life and disability insurance. * Professional development and training opportunities. * Employee assistance program (EAP). *Benefits eligibility may vary based on employment classification and hours worked.* Guided by **Core Values (LEAD)**, grounded in **grit** and a **commitment to excellence**, Loenbro **betters** our families, customers, and **local** communities. If you are ready to be part of a company that **LEADS** by: * **L****iving with Integrity** * **E****xceeding Expectations** * **A****cting with Urgency** * **D****elivering Excellence** …we want to hear from you. **Loenbro is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

jobs.title: Sr. Software Quality Program Engineer
jobs.description: About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software\-defined vehicle architecture, our award\-winning vehicles bring our "Compromise Nothing™" approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in\-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility. **Sr. Nexus Software Quality Integration Engineer** **Engineering \| Bay Area, CA \| Full\-Time** **About Lucid** At Lucid, we are creating an electric future without compromise. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. We build world\-class vehicles by pushing performance, efficiency, and design beyond industry limits, setting new standards with vehicles like Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity. The people here, engineers, designers, operators, and builders, came from across industries and around the world because they wanted to work on a harder problem. They care deeply about mastering their craft and delivering work they're proud of. We trust you to take ownership, push beyond what is expected, and help write the playbook for what comes next. By refusing to settle, you help shape the future of electric mobility and prove what's possible when craft and ambition refuse to compromise each other. **The Role** The Nexus program requires close alignment between Lucid and Nuro throughout the complete vehicle lifecycle. As the Sr. Nexus Software Quality Integration Engineer, you will serve as the primary Software Quality interface between both organizations, driving software quality, customer satisfaction, and delivery execution from pre\-SOP development and launch readiness through SOP production support, OTA deployments, fleet operations, and post\-SOP field support. Based in the Bay Area, California, you will establish close working relationships with Nuro engineering, validation, operations, and program teams while coordinating with Lucid Digital Engineering and cross\-functional partners. You will investigate software issues, organize technical evidence, track customer\-requested features and delivery commitments, support validation, and provide clear quality and readiness updates to Lucid and Nuro leadership. Success in the first 12 months means becoming the trusted Software Quality point of contact for Nexus, improving collaboration and responsiveness between Lucid and Nuro, reducing turnaround time for software issue investigation and resolution, strengthening visibility into software quality risks and readiness, and improving customer confidence through proactive communication, transparency, and effective issue management. What you will find here that you will not find in a comparable role elsewhere is direct ownership of the Software Quality relationship for a strategic autonomous vehicle program, with influence across customer expectations, software engineering execution, launch readiness, production support, fleet operations, and post\-SOP field quality. **What** **You'll** **Own** **Nexus Software Quality Interface** Serve as the dedicated Software Quality representative for the Nexus program based in the Bay Area, California. Act as the primary Software Quality interface between Nuro and Lucid engineering organizations. Establish and maintain close working relationships with Nuro engineering, validation, operations, and program teams to support day\-to\-day collaboration and rapid issue resolution. Participate in Nexus technical reviews, software evaluations, issue triage meetings, release readiness reviews, launch activities, and customer\-facing discussions. **Software Issue Investigation \& Technical Evidence** Investigate Nexus software issues raised by Nuro through collection and analysis of logs, telemetry, diagnostics, DTCs, PCAPs, CAN data, cloud telemetry, and vehicle signal information. Coordinate with Lucid Digital Engineering teams to drive root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, software quality improvements, and issue resolution. Facilitate timely capture and delivery of technical evidence required to support software investigations and customer communications. Support validation activities to verify issue resolution effectiveness and customer\-requested functionality. **Customer Commitments \& Delivery Execution** Track customer\-requested features, softwa port Nexus program execution throughout the vehicle lifecycle. **Compensation and Benefits** Base salary range: \[Compensation Range TBD] Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid's equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the terms and conditions of those programs. Cash or equity incentive awards, if applicable, are determined by multiple factors, including individual performance and overall company results. **Equal Opportunity** At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. Lucid Motors is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing an inclusive workplace for all. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, national or ethnic origin, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable state or federal laws and regulations. **Accessibility** Lucid Motors is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our application and hiring process. If you need an accommodation to participate in the application process, please contact us at \[accessibility contact TBD]. **Candidate Data Privacy** By submitting your application, you understand and agree that your personal data will be processed in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. If you are a California resident, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice. **To All Recruitment Agencies** Lucid Motors does not accept agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our careers alias or other Lucid Motors employees. Lucid Motors is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. **Compensation** **\& Benefits:**Lucid offers a comprehensive and competitive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; paid holidays, paid sick leave; and a 401(k) retirement plan. Hourly/non\-exempt employees accrue up to 120 hours paid time off, and salaried/exempt employee accrue up to 160 hours paid time off. Eligible employees may also participate in Lucid's equity program and/or a discretionary annual cash incentive program. Incentive and equity awards, if applicable, are determined based on individual performance, role scope, market considerations, and overall company results, in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans. **Equal Opportunity:** At Lucid, we believe diversity strengthens everything we build. jobs.title: Senior NetSuite Business Systems Analyst
jobs.description: **About Luna** -------------- Luna Innovations Incorporated (Luna) is a global leader in fiber optic test and measurement and distributed sensing, trusted by aerospace manufacturers, defense contractors, research institutions, and commercial operators worldwide. We are a team of innovators who engineer, manufacture, and relentlessly pursue quality, driven by a shared commitment to exceeding our customers’ expectations. We are seeking a **Senior Netsuite Business Systems Analyst** to join our team, targeting candidates based at our Blacksburg, VA office. **Position Overview** This role is the primary NetSuite and Arena PLM systems resource, translating Manufacturing, Engineering, Product Management and Sales Operations needs into scalable system solutions. This hands\-on role will advance capabilities across MRP, BOM and item governance, work orders, advanced procurement, NPI workflows, integrations, and process automation. Partnering closely with Sales Operations, this role will establish the appropriate division of responsibility between NetSuite and Salesforce. This position will help move ERP\-native processes back into NetSuite, establish reliable integrations between the platforms, and ensure Salesforce users have access to accurate product, pricing, lead\-time, order, and fulfillment information without duplicating transactional processes across systems.**Key Responsibilities****Manufacturing \& Product Systems*** Drive the continued implementation and optimization of NetSuite MRP for the OCT Business Unit. * Establish item and BOM data governance in NetSuite, including tools and controls that identify gaps, stale records, and data\-quality issues that affect MRP and production. * Configure and support NetSuite work orders, operation\-task data, and production\-readiness processes. * Establish NetSuite as the authoritative system for ERP\-native data and processes, including items, pricing, lead times, orders, inventory, fulfillment, and costing. * Partner with Sales and Customer Operations to ensure NetSuite provides the accurate product, pricing, lead\-time, order, and fulfillment information needed to support customers. * Own the Arena PLM system architecture and configuration, including workflow design, automation, permissions, reporting, and NetSuite integration, in partnership with Engineering, Manufacturing, Product Operations, and Quality \& Product Control. * Configure Arena Projects to support the OCT NPI process, including stage\-gate templates, entry and exit criteria, task assignments, approvals, and controlled documentation. * Configure and improve Arena BOM, revision, and ECO workflows in partnership with Q\&PC, which retains process ownership, while reducing manual administration and ensuring approved changes are accurately transferred to NetSuite. **Development, Automation \& Integrations*** Develop and maintain NetSuite workflows, SuiteScript solutions, and process automations that improve efficiency, data quality, and controls. * Design, implement, and support the Arena–NetSuite integration that transfers approved items, BOMs, revisions, and supplier data from product development into production. * Design and maintain reliable NetSuite–Salesforce integrations for product, pricing, lead\-time, order, backlog, shipment, and fulfillment information. * Improve or replace manual CSV\-based processes to transfer information between NetSuite and Salesforce. * Partner with the Salesforce Systems Administrator to coordinate cross\-system changes and prevent unintended downstream impacts. * Own the NetSuite components of Celigo integrations, including technical monitoring, error resolution, and credential management in coordination with IT. * Develop reconciliation and exception controls that identify failed integrations, missing records, conflicting values, and cross\-system data\-quality issues. * Partner with the Analytics \& AI role to provide governed and documented NetSuite data for Bookings, Billings, Backlog, forecast, profitability, and operational reporting. **Governance, Support \& Adoption*** Serve as the primary NetSuite and Arena partner for Manufacturing, Engineering, Product Operations, Sales Operations and Customer Operations. * Evaluate business needs and determine whether the appropriate solution is system configuration, automation, integration, data correction, or process change. * Diagnose configuration, code, integration, data, and process issues and drive them through resolution. * Lead requirements, prioritization, testing, release management, user training, and adoption for NetSuite and Arena enhancements. * Maintain system and process documentation, build internal expertise, and reduce reliance on external consultants and individual knowledge holders. **Required Qualifications*** Five or more years of hands\-on NetSuite functional, configuration, and development experience, including proficiency with SuiteScript 2\.x, SuiteQL, saved searches, workflows, and custom records. * Experience configuring or developing ERP solutions within a manufacturing, inventory, distribution, or supply\-chain environment, with working knowledge of MRP, BOM structures, work orders, inventory, procurement, and lead\-time management. * Experience building or maintaining NetSuite integrations using SuiteTalk, REST APIs, OAuth, and related data\-extraction methods. * Demonstrated ability to work directly with Manufacturing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Sales Operations, or Finance stakeholders and translate business requirements into scalable NetSuite solutions. * Ability to determine whether issues originate in system configuration, custom code, integration logic, source data, or business\-process execution and drive them through resolution. * Experience with Celigo, Boomi, MuleSoft, or a comparable integration platform supporting ERP, CRM, or PLM integrations. * Reporting and controls: Experience creating NetSuite saved searches, exception reporting, or SuiteAnalytics workbooks that support operational visibility, data quality, controls, or financial processes. * Experience leading requirements, testing, documentation, training, and adoption for significant system or process changes. * Strong ability to communicate technical issues and solutions clearly to business and technical stakeholders. * Ability to travel occasionally to other Luna locations as needed. **Preferred Qualifications*** NetSuite certification, such as SuiteFoundation, Administrator, ERP Consultant, or a manufacturing\-related certification. * Experience configuring Arena PLM for BOM management, revision control, ECO workflows, product releases, and NPI stage\-gate processes. * Experience integrating Arena or another PLM platform with NetSuite or a comparable ERP. * Experience supporting bidirectional NetSuite–Salesforce data flows or the Celigo NetSuite–Salesforce connector. * Working knowledge of Python and the ability to understand scripts that consume or transform NetSuite API data. * Experience in a hardware, electronics, photonics, or precision\-manufacturing environment. * Experience bringing previously outsourced ERP configuration, development, and support capabilities in\-house. *Luna Innovations is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. Luna provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age, disability, gender identity, genetic information, or veteran status. Equal employment opportunity applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leave of absence, compensation, and training. Luna expressly prohibits any form of unlawful employee harassment or discrimination.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - iOS
jobs.description: At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive. Our Client Infrastructure team is dedicated to building software that addresses challenges at a large scale, ensuring that our mobile applications are stable, scalable, and efficient. As a Mobile Engineer on the Mobile Foundations team, you will create and maintain foundational systems that all Lyft mobile engineers rely on, enabling teams across Lyft to deliver rich experiences that connect people and places. You will build scalable infrastructure, helping developers move fast and innovate, while ensuring Lyft's mobile developer experience remains at the forefront. Your work will have a multiplicative effect across Engineering and contribute directly to Lyft's overall stability. Our apps are used by millions of people, and we take great pride in our work, which means adhering to excellent development practices, careful code architecture, and an organization built around rapid releases. Our codebase is written entirely in Swift, utilizing modern design patterns and coding standards. We rely on third\-party libraries and actively contribute back to the community, including the Swift language itself. **Who are you:** ---------------- * You are an enthusiastic and experienced mobile developer looking to use your engineering skills to improve developers' ability to ship new features quickly. * You get excited about new Swift features and compile improvements. * You find delight in building the foundations and frameworks to accelerate the development of others, hiding away the complexities of the system. * You are a diplomat who looks at the landscape and aligns engineers from different teams around a common pattern. * You are excited about scaling millions of lines of Swift code to hundreds of mobile developers. * You take initiative to identify and improve processes and solve problems proactively. * You take pride in writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code with well\-designed APIs, prioritizing clear design principles for reliability. * You are passionate about collaborating with other teams and helping / supporting other iOS engineers. **Responsibilities:** --------------------- * Develop and maintain reliable mobile infrastructure, including networking, architecture, and UI frameworks (Lyft Product Language and DeclarativeUI library), to enable Lyft iOS engineers to deliver high\-quality mobile experiences. * Collaborate with cross\-functional partners (designers, Android engineers, Web engineers, and other Mobile Infrastructure teams) to strategically define the future of mobile UI and architecture, ensuring an innovative mobile developer experience at Lyft. * Support iOS engineers from across the organization as they use the tools we build and leverage these interactions to improve our roadmaps and offerings. * Bring new ideas to the table that aim to ease developer friction and keep our codebase joyful to develop in while continuously improving the codebase through refactoring. * Stay current with iOS development and contribute to open\-source projects like the Mobile Native Foundation and Hammer. **Experience:** --------------- * Code Quality: Experienced in delivering high\-quality code. * Experience working with designers and on internal developer productivity teams or projects. * Strong experience with Swift. * Experience with UIKit, declarative UI development and creating shared components. * Familiarity with current design and prototyping tools (Figma, etc). * Ability to work with a low\-ego, highly collaborative, cross\-functional team. * Excited about working in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment. * You take pride in writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code, prioritizing clear design principles for reliability, and ensuring good code quality. * Strong problem\-solving skills and a passion for tackling difficult challenges. * A strong sense of ownership for the things you build and a commitment to continuous improvement. * Excellent presentation and documentation skills. * Experience mentoring and supporting other Mobile Engineers. * Demonstrated ability to lead a project from initial concept through to successful completion. * Bonus Points: contributions to open source projects, experience with SwiftUI, experience with unidirectional and reactive programming. **Benefits:** ------------- * Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled * Mental health benefits * Family building benefits * Child care and pet benefits * 401(k) plan to help save for your future * In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off * 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible * Subsidized commuter benefits * Lyft Pink \- Lyft team members get an exclusive opportunity to test new benefits of our Ridership Program *Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.* *Lyft highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in\-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in\-office perks Lyft offers. jobs.title: Project Manager/Estimator
jobs.description: **Hale Contracting is a family\-owned site grading and utility contractor based in Williamstown, KY.** **POSITION SUMMARY** The Project Manager / Estimator is responsible for estimating, bidding, planning, coordinating, and managing site construction projects from the initial bid through project completion. This position works closely with customers, owners, engineers, subcontractors, suppliers, field personnel, and company management to ensure projects are accurately estimated, properly scheduled, completed safely, and remain within established budgets and timelines. The Project Manager / Estimator is responsible for maintaining effective communication throughout the project and monitoring project costs, quantities, labor, materials, equipment, and subcontracted work. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS** * Review project plans, specifications, drawings, bid documents, and other project information to determine project scope and requirements. * Prepare detailed estimates for site construction projects, including labor, materials, equipment, subcontractors, trucking, permits, overhead, and other applicable costs. * Obtain and evaluate subcontractor and supplier pricing and incorporate appropriate costs into project estimates. * Prepare and submit competitive bids and proposals in accordance with customer, owner, engineer, or general contractor requirements. * Perform quantity takeoffs from plans, specifications, drawings, and field information. * Visit project sites as necessary to evaluate existing conditions, verify quantities, identify potential challenges, and gather information needed for accurate estimating. * Review bid requirements and identify potential project risks, exclusions, clarifications, and items that may affect project cost or schedule. * Develop project budgets and establish cost expectations following award of a project. * Coordinate project start\-up activities, including reviewing contracts, plans, specifications, schedules, permits, insurance requirements, and other required documentation. * Develop and maintain project schedules and coordinate work activities with field personnel, subcontractors, suppliers, and customers. * Coordinate the procurement and delivery of materials, equipment, trucking, and subcontracted services necessary to complete projects. * Communicate regularly with superintendents, foreperson, field crews, subcontractors, suppliers, customers, and management regarding project progress and requirements. * Monitor project costs, labor, material usage, equipment, quantities, and production to ensure projects remain within budget. * Review daily reports, tickets, time records, material quantities, trucking records, and other project documentation for accuracy. * Track project quantities and compare actual production and costs against the original estimate and budget. * Identify cost overruns, changes in scope, scheduling issues, and other potential problems and communicate them to management promptly. * Prepare, document, and submit change orders and additional work requests as needed. * Review customer and subcontractor invoices, pay applications, and supporting documentation for accuracy and compliance with contract requirements. * Maintain organized project files, including contracts, plans, specifications, estimates, change orders, purchase orders, correspondence, invoices, daily reports, and other project documentation. * Coordinate with accounting and administrative personnel to ensure timely and accurate project billing and documentation. * Assist with project closeout, including final quantities, change orders, punch\-list items, final billing, and required closeout documentation. * Maintain professional relationships with customers, general contractors, engineers, subcontractors, suppliers, and other project stakeholders. * Monitor project schedules and assist in resolving delays, conflicts, or other issues that may affect successful project completion. * Ensure project activities are performed in accordance with company policies, contract requirements, applicable regulations, and established safety practices. * Participate in project meetings, pre\-construction meetings, progress meetings, and other meetings as required. * Assist management with business development by maintaining relationships with customers and identifying potential bidding and project opportunities. * Maintain knowledge of current construction practices, materials, equipment, labor conditions, and market pricing to support accurate estimates and competitive bids. * Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned by management. **REQUIRED SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES** The successful candidate should possess strong knowledge of site construction estimating and project management principles, including the ability to read and interpret construction plans, specifications, and project documents. Strong mathematical and analytical skills are required, along with the ability to perform accurate quantity takeoffs and develop detailed project estimates. The position requires excellent organizational and time\-management skills, attention to detail, problem\-solving ability, and the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously. Strong written and verbal communication skills are necessary to effectively communicate with customers, subcontractors, suppliers, field personnel, and management. The individual must be proficient with computers and Microsoft Office applications and be capable of learning and utilizing company estimating, project management, and accounting software. **QUALIFICATIONS** An associate or bachelor's degree in construction management, civil engineering, business, or a related field is preferred. Previous experience in site construction estimating, project management, or a related construction position is required. Experience with excavation, grading, utilities, concrete, paving, drainage, or other site development work is preferred. The ability to read construction plans and specifications and perform accurate quantity takeoffs is required. A valid driver's license and the ability to travel to project locations are required. **PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS** The position requires a combination of office and field work. The employee must be able to travel to construction sites and work in varying outdoor conditions, including exposure to heat, cold, dust, noise, uneven terrain, and other typical construction\-site conditions. The position requires the ability to walk construction sites, climb stairs or uneven surfaces when necessary, and occasionally lift or carry materials or equipment weighing up to 50 pounds. Regular use of a computer, telephone, and other office equipment is required. Appropriate personal protective equipment must be worn when visiting active construction sites. **WORKING CONDITIONS** Work is performed in both an office and active construction\-site environment. The position may require occasional early mornings, evenings, extended hours, or schedule adjustments based on project requirements, bid deadlines, weather, customer needs, and construction schedules. Travel between the office, project sites, customer locations, and supplier locations may be required. Hale Contracting provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, ancestry, national origin, citizenship, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, and pregnancy\-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age, disability, genetic information, service in the military, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws and ordinances. Equal employment opportunity applies to all terms and conditions of employment. Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **Job Overview** Build and maintain a **C\#/WPF desktop application** for real\-time monitoring and control of unmanned surface vehicles (USVs). The system delivers live telemetry, mission planning, mapping, video streaming, and multi\-vehicle fleet management. You own features end\-to\-end: UI, ViewModels, business logic, and network messaging. Because operators run this software in live field conditions, **user experience is a first\-class requirement**, not an afterthought. You will design intuitive, touch\-friendly, high\-density interfaces and prototype them in **Figma** before implementation. **Responsibilities** * Design and build WPF UI following the MVVM pattern. * Prototype and iterate UI/UX flows in **Figma** before coding; translate designs into pixel\-accurate XAML. * Implement real\-time telemetry displays: gauges, radar, maps, video panels. * Develop network messaging over ZeroMQ — telemetry, heartbeat, mission/waypoint updates. * Integrate mapping/GIS (online \+ offline map packages, encrypted charts). * Support multi\-input control: game controller, keyboard, touch. * Optimize for x64 performance — background threading, batched UI updates, low\-latency rendering. * Maintain clean, dense, readable code. **Required Qualifications** * Strong **C\#** and **.NET** (modern versions, Windows). * Production **WPF** experience — XAML, data binding, custom controls, styles/themes. * Solid grasp of **MVVM** (INotifyPropertyChanged, commands, converters). * **User Experience (UX) design skill with Figma** — wireframing, prototyping, component libraries, design\-to\-code handoff. * **Unix experience, specifically Debian** — command line, package management, system administration. * Multithreading / async and UI\-thread discipline (dispatcher, background workers). * Git\-based workflow (branching, PRs, merge resolution). **Desired Qualifications** * **Windows 11** administration and deployment. * **BASH** scripting. * **SSH** and **RDP** for remote access and administration. * **General networking** — TCP/IP, routing, firewalls, troubleshooting. **Preferred / Bonus Qualifications** * Exposure to **C\+\+**, **C\*,** Python**,** HTML**, and** CSS\*. * Working with **YAML** and **Properties** configuration files. * **GIS charts** experience. * Real\-time / telemetry or control\-system experience. * GIS / mapping runtime experience. * Networking with ZeroMQ or comparable messaging. * Video streaming (LibVLC or similar), embedded web (WebView2\). * Game controller / HID input. * Structured logging. * Localization / multi\-culture UI. * Maritime, defense, or unmanned\-systems domain knowledge. **Core Tech Stack** Language/Runtime * C\#, .NET (Windows, x64\) UI * WPF, XAML, MVVM UX Design * Figma OS * Debian / Unix, Windows 11 Remote / Networking * SSH, RDP, BASH, general networking Mapping / GIS * GIS runtime, GIS charts (offline \+ encrypted) Messaging * ZeroMQ, Sockets Video * LibVLC, WebView2 Input * Game controller (HID) Config * YAML, Properties files Logging * Structured logging framework Bonus Languages * C\+\+, C, Python, HTML, CSS **What Success Looks Like** * Operators find the UI fast, clear, and reliable under field pressure. * Figma prototypes validated with stakeholders before implementation. * Features ship performant on x64 with clean, maintainable code. jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Our Purpose** *Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200\+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.* **Title and Summary** Senior Data Engineer Overview: Mastercard Foundry is seeking a Senior Data Engineer. In this role, you will take ownership of building and optimizing data platforms, pipelines, and systems that enable advanced analytics, machine learning, and business insights. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering, product, and analytics teams to deliver reliable, production\-ready data solutions. Mastercard Foundry is the innovation engine of Mastercard and a hub for new product development. We do this by driving product innovation in emerging technologies and interfaces while focusing on developing a point of view to enhance existing solutions and new use\-cases. We also focus on building revenue generating ecosystems and flywheels that can be standalone in adjacent segments and markets. Examples of focus areas include Digital Assets/Stablecoins, Consumer value propositions, Digital payments, Payment Acceptance and Processing, and applications of Artificial Intelligence. This is a hybrid role based in O’Fallon, MO, with an expectation of three days per week onsite. Role: * Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data platforms, pipelines, and data products that support analytics, machine learning, and business insights. * Develop and optimize large\-scale batch and streaming data pipelines using modern distributed data processing frameworks. * Implement workflow orchestration and automation solutions to ensure reliable and efficient data movement and processing. * Design and integrate data from multiple sources to create accessible, high\-quality datasets for business and technical stakeholders. * Build and maintain modern data lake and data warehousing solutions that support diverse analytical use cases. * Define and implement scalable data models and database solutions that ensure performance, integrity, and usability. * Apply data engineering best practices to improve system performance, scalability, resiliency, and maintainability. * Ensure compliance with data security, governance, privacy, and regulatory requirements. * Lead technical design discussions and contribute to architecture decisions across data platforms and services. * Own end\-to\-end delivery across the SDLC, including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and support. * Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive corrective and preventive actions. * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams while mentoring engineers and promoting engineering excellence and knowledge sharing. All About You: * Experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role, with strong knowledge of data engineering concepts, methodologies, and modern data architectures. * Strong hands\-on experience with SQL, including writing and optimizing queries for large\-scale data processing. * Strong experience with relational databases, particularly Microsoft SQL Server and related technologies. * Experience designing, implementing, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions. * Strong experience with distributed data processing and large\-scale data platforms; experience with Databricks and Spark is a plus. * Experience building and maintaining data lakes, data models, and scalable database solutions for analytics and reporting. * Knowledge of workflow orchestration and automated end\-to\-end data pipelines. * Understanding of data security, governance, compliance, and data quality practices, particularly in enterprise environments. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and modern data engineering tools. * Experience with event\-driven or streaming architectures and exposure to machine learning or advanced analytics environments is a plus. * Strong troubleshooting, root cause analysis, critical thinking, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to break down complex technical challenges. * Ability to manage multiple projects and competing priorities while maintaining high standards for quality, accuracy, and delivery. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Self\-motivated and collaborative team player with the ability to influence technical decisions, mentor engineers, and demonstrate curiosity about emerging technologies and developer productivity tools such as GitHub Copilot. * Bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline such as Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, Business, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. Mastercard is a merit\-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable\_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.**Corporate Security Responsibility** All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must: * Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices; * Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed; * Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and * Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines. In line with Mastercard’s total compensation philosophy and assuming that the job will be performed in the US, the successful candidate will be offered a competitive base salary and may be eligible for an annual bonus or commissions depending on the role. The base salary offered may vary depending on multiple factors, including but not limited to location, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Mastercard benefits for full time (and certain part time) employees generally include: insurance (including medical, prescription drug, dental, vision, disability, life insurance); flexible spending account and health savings account; paid leaves (including 16 weeks of new parent leave and up to 20 days of bereavement leave); 80 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time, 25 days of vacation time and 5 personal days, pro\-rated based on date of hire; 10 annual paid U.S. observed holidays; 401k with a best\-in\-class company match; deferred compensation for eligible roles; fitness reimbursement or on\-site fitness facilities; eligibility for tuition reimbursement; and many more. Mastercard benefits for interns generally include: 56 hours of Paid Sick and Safe Time; jury duty leave; and on\-site fitness facilities in some locations.**Pay Ranges** O'Fallon, Missouri: $115,000 \- $184,000 USD

jobs.title: Senior VLM & VFM Field Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Vision\-Language Model (VLM) \& Visual Foundation Model (VFM) Field Engineer** ======================================================================================= **About Matroid** ----------------- Matroid helps enterprises build and operate computer vision systems through an end\-to\-end platform for training, evaluating, and deploying automated visual inspection. The platform supports a wide range of imagery, including EO, IR, X\-Ray, CT, and OCT. Founded in 2016 by a Stanford professor, Matroid works with customers across **aerospace, automotive, manufacturing, logistics, data center infrastructure, and security**. We're hiring a **Senior Vision\-Language Model (VLM) \& Visual Foundation Model (VFM) Field Engineer** to **build and deploy production\-grade deep learning systems using Matroid's platform** for a broad range of enterprise customers, such as **Mercedes\-Benz, Toyota, Boeing, Google, Amazon, Bosch, and many others**. You'll work directly with customers to understand their operations and turn challenging requirements into reliable computer vision and multimodal AI solutions. As the technical owner of complex engagements, you'll guide architecture, model adaptation, evaluation, integration, and deployment, combining Matroid's platform with custom engineering. Projects will cover defect inspection, anomaly detection, assembly verification, process and safety monitoring, and multimodal understanding, retrieval, and reasoning across images, videos, and operational data. Alongside delivery, you'll use lessons from customer deployments to improve our platform and engineering practices. This role is based at our downtown Palo Alto office, a five\-minute walk from Caltrain and a nine\-minute walk from Stanford University. ### **What you'll be doing** * Build and deploy deep learning systems on Matroid using visual foundation models, vision\-language models, and/or specialized vision\-centric models for object detection, segmentation, tracking, anomaly detection, spatiotemporal reasoning, and multimodal understanding and retrieval. * Own technical delivery from scoping and feasibility assessment through model selection, fine\-tuning, prompt engineering, system architecture, and production deployment. * Develop deep learning systems that can operate in cloud, edge, and hybrid environments, optimizing inference latency, GPU utilization, memory consumption, and throughput while balancing accuracy, cost, and maintainability. * Establish representative evaluation datasets and task\-specific benchmarks. Analyze failure modes and improve model accuracy and robustness through data curation, targeted augmentation, and DL system adaptation. * Develop imaging and data collection systems, selecting cameras, optics, illumination, and capture configurations that support reliable visual recognition in demanding environments. * Connect Matroid to customer equipment and software, including PLCs, manufacturing execution systems, SCADA, quality management platforms, safety alerting, and video management systems. * Guide customers through technical decisions and troubleshoot complex issues across model behavior, inference pipelines, infrastructure, and integrations. * Review architecture and code, and build reusable tools for model evaluation, inference, and deployment. * Work with product and engineering colleagues to translate deployment insights into improvements in model capabilities, performance, and platform workflows. * Deliver technical workshops, training, and documentation that help customers evaluate, adopt, and operate their AI systems successfully. ### **How you'll be doing it** * **Take ownership.** Bring structure to ambiguous requirements, identify risks early, and drive projects through production readiness. * **Stay hands\-on.** Write code, adapt models, investigate data, and debug systems while providing technical direction. * **Choose models thoughtfully.** Assess capabilities and limitations, and select the right combination of fine\-tuning, prompting, specialized models, and orchestration for each application. * **Build deep platform expertise.** Understand Matroid's capabilities and apply its features, workflows, and integrations effectively. * **Understand customer operations.** Account for production constraints and communicate clearly with engineers, operators, and business stakeholders. * **Raise the team's technical standard.** Share deployment lessons, offer practical feedback, and help other engineers develop their judgment. * **Work independently and collaboratively.** Make progress with autonomy and bring in teammates when their expertise will improve the outcome. * **Keep learning.** Evaluate advances in computer vision and multimodal AI and turn promising approaches into practical customer capabilities. ### **What you bring to the table** * **A master's degree or higher** in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, machine learning, artificial intelligence, robotics, or a closely related technical discipline. * Strong experience with visual recognition tasks such as detection, segmentation, tracking, action recognition, and anomaly detection, plus hands\-on work adapting and evaluating visual foundation models or vision\-language models. * Excellent Python skills and sound software engineering practices for building systems that connect models, APIs, databases, and customer infrastructure. * Proficiency with relevant tools and frameworks, such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Hugging Face, NumPy, and OpenCV. * Experience developing rigorous evaluations and improving AI performance through better data, model adaptation, prompts, architecture, or workflow design. * Demonstrated ability to make architecture decisions and resolve reliability, performance, and integration problems in deployed systems. * Experience leading complex technical projects and collaborating across teams. * Clear written, verbal, and presentation skills in English, including the ability to explain technical decisions and tradeoffs to both technical and business audiences. ### **Bonus points if...** * **You have 3\+ years of industry experience** focused on computer vision, AI, robotics, machine learning, natural language processing, or a related discipline. * You have experience in spatiotemporal reasoning, open\-world recognition, 3D understanding or reconstruction, or agentic workflows. * You have worked in forward\-deployed engineering, field engineering, solutions engineering, or another customer\-facing technical position. * You have deployed AI in aerospace, automotive, manufacturing, logistics, security, or similarly demanding operational settings. * You have experience at a growing technology startup. ### **What we offer in return** * Competitive compensation and equity. * Challenging technical work with direct customer impact. * Reimbursement for gym memberships. * Daily lunch, drinks, and snacks. * Fully paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision coverage. * Scheduling flexibility to accommodate interests outside work. * A budget for the hardware and software you need to succeed. * Learning resources covering software engineering, computer vision, VLMs, LLMs, and multimodal AI. * A downtown Palo Alto office close to Caltrain. *Matroid is an equal\-opportunity employer committed to a diverse workplace. We consider qualified applicants without discrimination based on race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non\-disqualifying disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other legally protected status.*

jobs.description: **Why Mayo Clinic** Mayo Clinic is top\-ranked in more specialties than any other care provider according to U.S. News \& World Report. This position offers the opportunity to contribute across the full breadth of CT physics \- from clinical service and protocol optimization to technology development, innovation, and translational research. The practice includes scanners from multiple vendors and supports routine diagnostic imaging, advanced imaging applications, image\-guided procedures, and specialized clinical services. The successful candidate will help advance safe, high\-quality, and efficient CT imaging while contributing to the clinical implementation and evaluation of emerging technology, including photon\-counting detector CT and advanced reconstruction, quantitative imaging, and AI\-enabled tools. The position is in Rochester, with occasional travel to Mayo Clinic Health Systems. * Collaborate with radiologists, technologists, information technology teams, engineers, and vendors to resolve technical issues and implement practical improvements. * Support CT applications used in routine diagnostic imaging, image\-guided procedures, and related ancillary equipment. * Participate as a collaborative member of the Division of Medical Physics. Long\-term opportunities include:* Lead and support the clinical deployment of new CT technology, including photon\-counting CT, hardware and software upgrades, and novel clinical applications. * Develop and translate innovative CT methods into clinical practice across the Mayo Clinic enterprise. * Conduct independent or collaborative research aligned with the candidate's interests and the group's strategic priorities. The CT physics group has active opportunities for research and innovation. The successful candidate will be encouraged to develop new ideas, collaborate with clinical and technical partners, and translate promising methods into patient care. * Support Mayo Clinic's mission in patient care, education, and research through technical innovation and mentorship. **Qualifications*** A doctoral degree in medical physics, physics, biomedical engineering, or a closely related discipline, with training or demonstrated expertise in diagnostic imaging physics. * Board certification or board eligibility in diagnostic medical physics. * A strong interest in CT imaging, clinical translation, technology development, and collaborative practice. * Excellent communication, project\-planning, scientific\-writing, teaching, and team\-development skills. **Exemption Status** Exempt **Compensation Detail** The minimum starting salary for Medical specialties may range from $136,643 \- $280,250\. This range reflects full\-time total base compensation prior to consideration of additional experience or duties. Pay for the selected candidate will vary based on specialty, experience, FTE, internal equity, or external market data. **Benefits Eligible** Yes **Schedule** Full Time **Hours/Pay Period** 80 **Schedule Details** Full Time **International Assignment** No **Site Description** Just as our reputation has spread beyond our Minnesota roots, so have our locations. Today, our employees are located at our three major campuses in Phoenix/Scottsdale, Arizona, Jacksonville, Florida, Rochester, Minnesota, and at Mayo Clinic Health System campuses throughout Midwestern communities, and at our international locations. Each Mayo Clinic location is a special place where our employees thrive in both their work and personal lives. Learn more about what each unique Mayo Clinic campus has to offer, and where your best fit is. **Equal Opportunity** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, protected veteran status or disability status. Learn more about the "EOE is the Law". Mayo Clinic participates in E\-Verify and may provide the Social Security Administration and, if necessary, the Department of Homeland Security with information from each new employee's Form I\-9 to confirm work authorization. **Recruiter** Jeff Eigenheer

jobs.description: Job ID: 112227 * Atlanta * Austin * Boston * Charlotte * Chicago * Cleveland * Columbus * Connecticut \- Darien * Dallas * Denver * Detroit \+ 14 More Do you want to do work that matters, alongside supportive leaders who will help you grow faster than you ever thought possible? Working alongside multidisciplinary teams, you'll gain a holistic understanding of how software engineering enables advanced AI while collaborating with some of the leading technologists and AI practitioners in the industry. **YOUR GROWTH** --------------- Driving lasting impact and building long\-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. We not only encourage diverse perspectives, but they are critical in driving us toward the best possible outcomes. * **Global community:** With colleagues across 65\+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm’s diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients. Plus, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from exceptional colleagues with diverse backgrounds and experiences. * **World\-class benefits:** On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well\-being for you and your family. **YOUR QUALIFICATIONS AND SKILLS** ---------------------------------- * Advanced degree in a relevant field; or equivalent experience * 15\+ years of experience designing and delivering large\-scale, business\-critical software solutions, with recognized mastery in frontend and backend technologies, distributed systems, and cloud\-native architectures * Demonstrated ability to set the overarching technical vision and strategy for an organization, with a track record of introducing new paradigms, reusable components, and frameworks that drive engineering efficiency and scalability at an enterprise level * Experience defining and leading the enterprise\-wide adoption of agentic engineering, establishing the operating model for autonomous agent\-driven delivery including governance, guardrails, and accountability * Experience architecting and leading enterprise AI strategy \- spanning model portfolios, build\-vs\-buy decisions, engineering discipline, and AI security standards \- and partnering with senior business leaders to maximize AI impact and identify emerging sources of leverage * Proven track record as a trusted advisor to senior executives on technology and data strategy, cloud architecture, and long\-term transformation roadmaps, with the ability to articulate trade\-offs and align technology decisions with long\-term business goals * A security\-first mindset, with experience championing secure development practices across an organization, acting as a trusted advisor on security and compliance, and ensuring alignment on secure development strategies at an enterprise level * Experience leading and developing multiple engineering teams and technical leaders across large, complex programs, fostering a strong engineering culture, and a proven ability to hire, mentor, and retain top engineering talent * Exceptional time management to meet your responsibilities in a complex and largely autonomous work environment * Strong communication skills, both verbal and written, with the ability to adjust your style to suit different perspectives and seniority levels, from engineers to C\-level executives Please review the additional requirements regarding essential job functions of McKinsey colleagues. jobs.title: Data Engineer II
jobs.description: **Take your career further with McLane!** McLane teammates, the driving force behind our success, are diverse professionals who work together seamlessly to keep our operations running smoothly. As a teammate, you will pair your dedication, expertise, and collaborative spirit with your fellow teammates to serve America's most beloved brands. McLane leaders think long\-term, act with purpose, and inspire high performance. They lead with accountability, communicate clearly, and drive results through collaboration, innovation, and continuous growth. They empower each teammate to learn from industry leaders, develop their skills, and build lasting connections nationwide. We're looking for a skilled Data Engineer II to design, build, and optimize scalable data solutions that support analytics, reporting, and advanced business intelligence initiatives. This role combines strong technical expertise in data engineering with a passion for delivering reliable, efficient, and high\-quality data platforms that enable data\-driven decision\-making across the organization. This is a hybrid position which will require the candidate to report and work from the office at least three days a week. Therefore, interested candidates should be within a 50\-minute radius of Temple, TX. **Benefits you can count on:** * Day 1 Benefits: medical, dental, and vision insurance, FSA/HSA, and company\-paid life insurance. * Paid time off begins day one. * 401(k) Profit Sharing Plan after 90 days. * Additional benefits: pet insurance, maternity/paternity leave, employee assistance programs, discount programs, tuition reimbursement program, and more! **What You'll Do** * Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes to support enterprise data initiatives. * Build and optimize data integrations from multiple internal and external sources, ensuring data quality, integrity, and reliability. * Develop and manage data models, data warehouses, and data lakes that support reporting, analytics, and operational workloads. * Implement data engineering best practices, including automation, monitoring, testing, and performance optimization. * Work with cloud\-based data platforms and services in Azure and/or GCP environments. * Support DataOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, orchestration, and infrastructure automation. * Partner with data analysts, data scientists, business stakeholders, and application teams to understand requirements and deliver scalable data solutions. * Troubleshoot and resolve data issues while ensuring compliance with data governance and security standards. * Document processes, architectures, and technical solutions to support maintainability and knowledge sharing. **What We're Looking For** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Engineering, or a related field. * 3\-5 years of progressive experience in data engineering, data integration, or related technical roles. * Strong experience with SQL, Python, and modern data engineering frameworks and tools. * Experience developing and maintaining large\-scale data pipelines and data integration solutions. * Knowledge of data warehousing, data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, and database design principles. * Experience with cloud data platforms and services in Azure and/or GCP. * Experience with DataOps practices, CI/CD pipelines, workflow orchestration, and automated testing. * Experience working with big data technologies, distributed processing frameworks, or cloud\-native data architectures is preferred. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions. * Excellent communication and collaboration skills with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * This position requires the ability to read, write, and understand English at a level sufficient to perform job\-related tasks effectively and safely. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **About Megaport** We’re not your typical tech company – and we don’t want to be. Megaport is the global leader in Network as a Service (NaaS), and has transformed the way businesses connect to the cloud, data centers, and each other. We’re publicly listed on the Australian Stock Exchange and partnered with the biggest names in tech like Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Oracle, IBM, and more. Headquartered in Brisbane with a crew of over 600 people spread across Asia\-Pacific, Europe, and the Americas, our employees enjoy an environment that is collaborative, supportive, and (actually) fun. **Our Team Culture** We’re a team of problem solvers, pixel pushers, code slingers, and cloud fanatics. Culture is more than a poster on the wall here – collaboration beats hierarchy, curiosity fuels our growth, and everyone’s voice matters. We take our work seriously, but not ourselves. We work across time zones to execute on our global vision, trust each other to get things done, and never compromise our values for commercial gain. Most importantly, we place our customers at the center of everything we do. We’re committed to increasing representation in the tech industry and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Don’t meet every requirement? That’s okay. If you’re excited about this role, we encourage you to apply.### **The Role** As a Senior Platform Engineer, you are a champion for DevOps and SRE culture and industry best practice within Megaport. You will work alongside talented team members in multiple timezones ensuring that systems are secure, maintainable and available. External to the team you will be engaging with stakeholders in requirements analysis and demonstrations. Technically you will be very hands on. Continually evolving your skills through a mix of peer reviews and research. Ultimately your obsession is customer success and ensuring company goals are met. ### **What You Will Be Doing** * Improving production reliability and system resilience within an SRE scoped team * Championing high standards of work and industry best practices * Communicating with teams and stakeholders at all stages * Bringing fresh ideas to the table and encouraging others * Diving into complex technical problems with a can\-do attitude * Working across numerous technologies in a fast\-changing industry * Participating in on\-call rotation, incident response, and blameless post\-incident reviews * Writing code, handling alerts, improving solutions, and supporting others * Playing a crucial role in the success of your company and team ### **What We Are Looking For** * 5\+ years administering Linux systems and related infrastructure in production environments * A collaborative SRE mindset, with familiarity around SLIs/SLOs/SLAs, error budgets, blast radius, and blameless postmortems * A focus on automation, reducing toil, and preventing problem recurrence * A track record of writing runbooks that work for the broader team, not just yourself * Strong Kubernetes and broader ecosystem fundamentals * Cloud infrastructure experience; AWS strongly preferred and bare\-metal is a bonus * Strong tool development \- Bash, plus either Python or Go preferred, or similar * Infrastructure\-as\-code tooling experience \- Terraform preferred * CI/CD and version control, GitHub preferred * Database experience \- one of Postgres, Cassandra, or ClickHouse preferred * Experience operating a production observability stack (metrics, logs, traces), with an eye for signal over noise * Comfortable working on live production infrastructure, with strong troubleshooting instincts and ownership of incident response * A history of continual professional development * A self\-directed style suited to an async, globally distributed team, and comfortable picking up adjacent work when the situation calls for it ### **What We Offer** * Flexible working environment – a remote\-first culture with coworking options available. * Generous leave plans – including 4 weeks of paid annual leave, parental leave, birthday leave, and a purchased annual leave program. * Health and wellness support – through a wellness allowance and employee wellbeing initiatives. * Comprehensive learning support – generous study and training allowance plus 5 days of paid study leave * Creative, modern workspaces – designed to inspire when you're not working remotely * Motivated, inclusive team – work alongside industry experts and fresh talent * Recognition programs – celebrate achievements with our *Legend* and *Kudos* awards ###### **\#LI\-DNI** If you have any questions, please reach out to Megaport's Talent Acquisition Team at Careers@megaport.com **NOTE:** ***All Megaport business correspondence is conducted via our business email accounts (@megaport.com). If you have any concerns, please reach out to Megaport's careers team careers@megaport.com directly and we will verify the legitimacy of any communication. Megaport will not ask you to create an account via Microsoft teams, and does not associate with any email accounts under "@megaportau.com".*** *All applications will be treated in confidence.* *Please see Part 2 of our Privacy Policy to see what information Megaport collects from job applicants, why, and how we store and use it. Note that you’re entitled to know what personal data of yours Megaport holds, to request updates, rectification, and in some circumstances restriction or deletion thereof if you object (you being entitled to withdraw your consent to our holding your information at any time). Please see Part 5 of our Privacy Policy for more details on this and how to contact Megaport's data protection officer if you have any further privacy\-related questions. Candidates who meet the selection criteria will be invited to attend an interview. Strictly no Recruitment Agencies.* We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
