Advance cloud, DevOps, and platform capabilities** -------------------------------------------------------- * Champion CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices * Drive adoption of Azure services and cloud\-native architectures to improve scalability and resilience * Implement observability standards including monitoring, logging, and diagnostics * Promote secure development practices and application\-level security controls **4\. Collaborate across the business** --------------------------------------- * Partner with product owners, QA, infrastructure, data, and security teams to align on delivery outcomes * Translate complex technical concepts into clear business insights for non\-technical stakeholders * Influence roadmaps by aligning engineering capabilities with operational and customer needs * Ensure solutions meet business, operational, and customer service expectations **5\. Elevate team capability and engineering standards** --------------------------------------------------------- * Mentor developers and raise the technical bar across the team * Promote consistent coding standards, testing practices, and documentation discipline * Leverage AI tools to improve developer productivity and solution quality * Contribute to a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous improvement **What you bring** ================== * 8\+ years of software development experience within the Microsoft technology stack * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience) * Deep expertise in modern .NET technologies (.NET 6/7/8, ASP.NET Core, Web API, Entity Framework Core) * Strong experience building and supporting both modern and legacy .NET applications * 5\+ years developing web applications using ASP.NET MVC/Core and modern front\-end frameworks (Angular or React) * Advanced proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS * 5\+ years of Microsoft SQL Server experience, including performance tuning and database design * Experience designing and implementing RESTful Actions, or similar) * Strong background in automated testing, code quality practices, and observability tools * Experience with secure coding practices and application security concepts * Proven ability to troubleshoot complex production issues and drive resolution **Preferred qualifications** * Experience in transportation, logistics, or operational systems environments * Exposure to microservices architecture, API gateways, and API lifecycle management * Experience leading Agile/Scrum/Kanban teams * Demonstrated success modernizing legacy platforms * Experience mentoring engineers and establishing development standards **How you operate** =================== * You think in systems, not isolated features * You own ou lity * You challenge assumptions constructively and push for better solutions * You communicate clearly across technical and business audiences * You operate with urgency while maintaining engineering discipline * You proactively identify risks and address them before they escalate **Compensation \& Setup** ========================= * **Pay:** $120,000–$130,000 base salary * **Location:** Hybrid – Downers Grove, IL * **Benefits:** Comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off **Physical Demands and Work Environment** ========================================= The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Physical Demands** -------------------- * Sedentary physical activity performing non\- strenuous daily activities of an administrative nature. * While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to sit, walk, stand, reach/handle items, work with the fingers, and talk and hear others in conversations via the phone or in person. **Work Environment** -------------------- * Sedentary physical activity performing non\- strenuous daily activities of an administrative nature. * While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to sit, walk, stand, reach/handle items, work with the fingers, and talk and hear others in conversations via the phone or in person. * Up to 5% travel; occasional after\-hours support based on business needs * The above statements reflect the general details necessary to describe the principal functions of the position and are not intended to be all inclusive. The position and any of the requirements listed above are subject to change at any time according to the changing needs of the company. * Roadrunner is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. * We will not accept unsolicited candidates from external recruiters or recruiting agencies. Thank you! \#LI\-HybridDowners Grove, IL **About Roadrunner** ==================== **Roadrunner is for ambitious, smart people who excel at execution over talking about it, and who would rather invent the next standard in freight than accept the status quo.** We are looking for the Best of the Best. Action driven leaders who want to be part of real change and help design the future of LTL in the U.S. This is a place where high performers can grow, influence outcomes, and make an impact while working directly with executives and smart people from across industries. We bring a winner mindset. We take ownership, raise the bar, and measure ourselves by results. We Run Safe. We Run Smart. We Run Together. These principles create an environment of high standards, clear ownership, and direct collaboration. We trust data over intuition, move with urgency, and hold each other accountable because winning requires it. Roadrunner exists to prove that LTL can be better than the industry has settled for. To be the best means we need to think bigger, look outside the box, and question every assumption: too many handoffs, limited visibility, and the quiet belief that “this is just how it works.” We rejected that story. We built a proprietary Smart Network™ for direct, long haul, metro to metro service that delivers fewer touches, faster transit, real time visibility, and genuine accountability. We are the most tech forward company in LTL, and we are not finished widening the gap. The foundation is already strong. Recognized as one of Built In Chicago’s Best Large Places to Work. Earning top marks for improvement, quality, and service. The real opportunity is still ahead: helping invent what comes next. If you want to be evaluated among the Best of the Best and help set the new standard in LTL, we should talk.

jobs.title: DIRECTOR OF TECHNOLOGY
jobs.description: **GENERAL DESCRIPTION OF POSITION:** The Director of Information Technology (IT) provides strategic leadership, planning, implementation, and oversight of the organization's technology infrastructure, applications, cybersecurity, telecommunications, and IT operations. This position is responsible for ensuring that technology systems support organizational goals, improve operational efficiency, safeguard information assets, and maintain regulatory compliance. The Director of IT leads technology initiatives, manages IT staff and vendors, develops budgets, and serves as a key advisor to executive leadership regarding technology strategy and innovation. key partner in organizational compliance, privacy, security, and risk management within a healthcare environment. **ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS:** (with or without accommodations) Develop and execute the organization's IT strategic plan aligned with Clinic objectives. Recommend technology solutions that improve efficiency, security, productivity, and service delivery. Advise executive leadership on emerging technologies, trends, risks, and opportunities. Lead technology transformation and digital innovation initiatives. Direct the day\-to\-day operation of the IT department. Ensure reliable performance of networks, servers, cloud services, telecommunications systems, and enterprise applications. Establish and monitor service levels to ensure timely support and issue resolution. Implement and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity plans. Collaborate with Compliance, Clinical, and Executive Leadership to ensure all information systems support compliance with applicable federal and state healthcare regulations. Ensure adherence to HIPAA, HITECH, CMS, OIG, and other healthcare privacy and security requirements. Serve as the IT lead for healthcare compliance audits, risk assessments, and regulatory reviews. Develop, implement, and maintain policies and procedures governing data privacy, security, access controls, retention, and electronic records management. Oversee the security and integrity of Electronic Health Record (EHR/EMR) systems and other clinical applications. Ensure appropriate user access management, role\-based permissions, and audit controls for clinical and administrative systems. Partner with Compliance and Human Resources to provide workforce training on cybersecurity, HIPAA privacy, data protection, and acceptable technology use. Monitor and investigate potential security incidents, breaches, and unauthorized access to protected health information (PHI), coordinating corrective actions and reporting requirements as necessary. Lead annual security risk analyses and remediation efforts to address vulnerabilities and maintain regulatory compliance. Ensure business continuity, disaster recovery, and emergency preparedness plans address the protection and recovery of critical clinical and business information systems. Oversee network architecture, hardware, software, cloud platforms, and data management systems. Ensure scalability, reliability, and security of IT infrastructure. Manage software implementation, upgrades, integrations, and system optimization projects. Evaluate and recommend technology investments. Maintain documentation and evidence required for accreditation, payer audits, and regulatory inspections. Collaborate with third\-party vendors and business associates to ensure compliance with contractual, security, and privacy requirements, including Business Associate Agreements (BAAs). Support organizational quality improvement initiatives through secure and compliant use of healthcare technology and data analytics. Monitor changes in healthcare laws, regulations, and industry best practices, recommending and implementing necessary technology and security updates. Develop and manage the annual IT operating and capital budgets. Negotiate contracts and manage relationships with technology vendors and service providers. Monitor expenditures and ensure cost\-effective utilization of resources. Evaluate vendor performance and service agreements. Recruit, train, mentor, and evaluate IT staff. Foster a culture of customer service, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. Establish departmental goals, performance metrics, and professional development plans. Manage staffing and resource allocation to support organizational priorities. Lead enterprise\-wide technology projects from planning through implementation. Coordinate cross\-functional teams and stakeholders. Ensure projects are completed on schedule, within scope, and within budget. Monitor project outcomes and measure return on investment. Maintains a friendly and safe environment for self and others. Fully participates in performance improvement and follows all clinic policies and procedures. Responsible for own safety and the safety of others. Attends work on a regular predictable schedule in accordance with clinic leave policy notifying Project Manager of all absences. Submits required documentation in a timely manner (credentialing requirements, license renewals, certifications, continuing education attendance, etc.) Will fully always comply with the enhanced infection control requirements of the clinic. **POSITION DIRECTLY SUPERVISED:** 2 field service technicians, 3 systems analyst, 1 system’s engineer, **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:** (use of equipment, job\-related knowledge, language, etc.) Knowledge of IT governance frameworks and best practices in a healthcare setting Knowledge of enterprise architecture and systems integration Knowledge of technology infrastructure, networks, and cloud computing Knowledge of software development capabilities and life cycle Knowledge of cybersecurity principles, controls and frameworks Knowledge of threat detection, incident response, and disaster recovery knowledge of business continuity planning and execution knowledge of risk assessments and mitigation strategies, strategic planning and organizational alignment knowledge of vendor and contract management, procurement, and project management knowledge of internal and external controls and audit processes knowledge of information security standards Skilled in planning, team leadership, staff and change management Skilled in network and infrastructure management Skilled in cloud platform administration (Azure, AWS, Google, Cloud Skilled in report writing, stakeholder engagement in the medical field, policy development, budget preparation and management Skilled in executive level presentations, report writing, resource allocations, risk management Ability to align technology initiatives with the Clinic’s goals Ability to management multiple priorities simultaneously Ability to make sound decisions under pressure Ability to mentor and develop staff Ability to ensure reliability6, security and availability of systems Ability to maintain compliance with regulatory requirements **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS/CERTIFICATES/LICENSES/REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:** Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field required. Master's degree preferred. Minimum of 7\-10 years of progressive IT leadership experience with a minimum of 3\-5 years in management or director\-level role supervising personnel. Experience managing network infrastructure, cybersecurity, enterprise systems, cloud technologies, and IT operations. Experience with budgeting, strategic planning, and project management. **SPECIAL INSTRUCTIONS:** This position requires travel. Employees must provide transportation. If employee operates a personal motor vehicle the employee must possess a current valid Texas driver’s license for the appropriate type of vehicle and Texas Liability insurance. This position requires that an employee’s driving record be verified with law enforcement to ensure compliance with SC’s driving policy. Due to the nature of the position employee will work extended hours or other variations of the usual shift to ensure adequate care for patients and to maintain service to the community to include weekends.

We're hiring a Field Specialist, API Monetization to close this gap: a customer\-facing technical expert who becomes the key pillar of this new revenue stream. This person will partner with AEs throughout the sales cycle as the primary technical point of contact for customers on all things API\-related — using deep product knowledge and a usage forecasting model to size deals, explain pricing, and build trust with technical buyers. What You'll Do * Partner with AEs on deals involving API usage, rate limits, or platform consumption * Serve as the technical expert in customer conversations — confidently explaining API mechanics, usage patterns, and what a given spend level unlocks for the customer * Use the usage forecasting calculator to size deals (credits or flat\-rate) and walk both sellers and customers through the "why" behind a number * Help identify which accounts to prioritize for API\-related deals based on current usage patterns * Meet directly with customers' technical teams to scope requirements and validate usage assumptions * Keep the usage calculator accurate as the rate card and packaging evolve * Feed field learnings back to product and pricing — surfacing patterns and recommending evolutions to the rate card or calculator * Build reusable frameworks and playbooks so AEs can eventually self\-serve on simpler deals * Advise on and help ensure final deal terms related to APIs are structured correctly, in partnership with the AE and Deal Desk Note: This role does not own closing the deal or carry a quota — commercial structuring, contract terms, and the customer relationship stay with the AE. This role owns the customer\-facing technical and quantitative conversation. What We're Looking For * 10\+ years in a technical, customer\-facing, or pricing/consumption\-modeling role * Deep fluency in APIs, rate limiting, and usage\-based pricing models * Comfortable owning and defending a quantitative model in front of a skeptical customer or seller — not just building one * Track record partnering with sales teams on complex technical or commercial deals * Strong communication skills; equally credible with technical and business stakeholders * Experience translating field and customer feedback into product or pricing input Strongest Fit Profile A senior Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager from a company with real usage\-based or metered pricing, who has personally had to explain a bill or cost estimate to a skeptical enterprise customer — not just demo a product. That "defending a number under questioning" experience is the closest proxy for this job. Deep API fluency is a must. Where to source: * Usage/consumption\-pricing companies: Twilio, Stripe, Snowflake, Datadog, MongoDB Atlas, Confluent, Fastly — places where explaining a rate card to a customer is a named, practiced skill * Token\-based API companies: OpenAI, Anthropic, and other LLM API providers — likely the single best\-fit talent pool; token economics conversations map almost directly onto this role * AWS/GCP enterprise TAMs specializing in cost optimization (Cost Explorer\-style work) — different product, same core skill Weaker fits to watch for: * Pure Deal Desk/pricing analysts who've built calculators but never defended one live with a customer or AE — quantitative skill without field credibility or API depth * Generalist SEs from subscription (non\-usage) pricing companies — demo skills transfer, but no experience reasoning about variable consumption Level \& Headcount Senior Individual Contributor (targeting Sr. Manager level). No deal or quota authority required — the bar is technical/quantitative depth plus field credibility, not commercial decision rights. One head to start, with room to build out a small team as demand grows. Reporting This role reports directly to Zach Ciliotta\-Young, with a close working partnership across the sales team and Product Strategy \& Operations to stay aligned on pricing and product strategy as they evolve. jobs.description: **Role:** Senior Backend Software Engineer **Location:** San Diego, CA (in\-office) **Salary Range:** $165,000 \- $220,000 / yr \+ stock options, 401k matching, and other benefits **Role Overview:** Seasats' vehicles operate for months at a time, often thousands of miles from land, and every one of them is streaming telemetry, health data, and mission state back to shore. We're looking for a Senior Backend Software Engineer to help design and scale our systems to include real\-time telemetry ingestion pipelines, APIs and services that power our fleet management platform and customer integrations. APIs that expose vehicle and mission data to internal tools, customer dashboards, and integrations, with an eye toward reliability and low latency * Design data models and storage strategies for high\-volume, time\-series, and geospatial data * Build systems that are resilient to the realities of maritime operations: intermittent connectivity, delayed or out\-of\-order data, and edge cases at sea * Improve the scalability, observability, and reliability of existing backend services as fleet size and data volume grow * Collaborate with the vehicle software and UI teams to integrate new data sources and capabilities * Help inform technical direction and best practices for backend architecture, and mentor other engineers **About You:** * 8\+ years of professional backend software Experience with cloud infrastructure, including designing for reliability and cost at scale * Experience with distributed systems concepts: queuing, caching, eventual consistency, and handling unreliable networks * Demonstrated ability to independently scope and lead backend projects * Strong technical communication skills Bonus points if you have: * Experience building telemetry or IoT data pipelines for robotics, autonomous vehicles, or remote sensor fleets * Familiarity with message queues/streaming platforms * Experience with time\-series databases (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB) or geospatial extensions (PostGIS) * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code and container orchestration (Terraform, Docker, Kubernetes) * Exposure to maritime, defense, or other real\-time jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Boston, USA
jobs.description: SingleStore is looking for an accomplished sales professional to join our Sales Team. AI is moving from experimentation into production, and this role is an opportunity to break into AI while doing meaningful enterprise selling. As an Account Executive, AI Hunter, your job is simple: create new SingleStore customers. You will find companies building AI applications where data access, real\-time context, memory, retrieval, or operational scale is becoming a constraint—and turn those challenges into new SingleStore customers. You will own a broad territory, build a majority self\-sourced pipeline, create demand in an emerging category, and close greenfield enterprise opportunities. This is a true hunting role. You will engage customers before they have a defined project, develop customer\-specific points of view, create urgency around business and technical problems, work with technical experts to land first production workloads, and build a measurable new\-logo business with broad ownership. The ideal candidate is a measurable enterprise hunter who is competitive, curious, technically credible, resilient, and able to sell business outcomes. Direct AI sales experience is valuable, but proven selling ability and technical curiosity matter more than a narrow "AI seller" title. **Role and Responsibilities** ----------------------------- * Build and execute a territory strategy for net\-new customer acquisition. * Prospect fearlessly across a broad account universe using proactive, persistent outbound, account\-based, partner, and market\-education motions; stay resilient and effective through rejection and ambiguity. * Form account hypotheses, map the buying center, and earn first meetings with relevant points of view tailored to the customer. * Engage executive, business, technical, security, and procurement stakeholders. * Lead great business\-first discovery, connect AI and data challenges to fundable goals, and build quantified ROI, TCO, or operational\-impact cases. * Build and develop champions, multi\-thread the buying group, earn executive and economic\-buyer access, and maintain stakeholder alignment; own the stakeholder plan, mutual action plan, close plan, value case, stage gates, forecast, and commercial outcome. * Lead complex sales cycles through technical validation, security, legal, procurement, negotiation, and close. * Partner with Solutions and Forward Deployment Engineers and cross\-functional teams to validate technical fit and establish the first production workload. * Navigate competitive displacement and maintain disciplined activity management, CRM hygiene, reporting, qualification, forecasting, and opportunity management; showcase clear metrics such as pipeline created, meetings, conversion, quota attainment, and new\-logo performance. * Be AI fluent: use AI and research tools productively and responsibly while applying judgment, validating outputs, and separating facts from hypotheses. * Travel within the assigned territory as required. **Required Skills and Experience** ---------------------------------- * 5\+ years of quota\-carrying B2B enterprise software sales experience, ideally selling to large or technically sophisticated organizations; experience in data, cloud, analytics, AI, or adjacent technical domains is a plus. * Repeated, quantified quota success with clear ownership of new\-logo wins and self\-sourced pipeline. * Experience closing complex, multi\-stakeholder deals involving executives, technical evaluators, security, legal, finance, procurement, and partners. * Ability to sell measurable business outcomes and build ROI, TCO, or operational\-impact cases. * Technical fluency in an adjacent domain such as databases, data infrastructure, analytics, AI/ML, cloud, Kubernetes, developer tools, cybersecurity, observability, or open\-source software. * Strong qualification, account planning, forecasting, CRM, negotiation, and deal\-management skills. * Learning velocity and coachability, demonstrated through specific behavior change after feedback; ability to explain technical concepts clearly to technical and executive audiences. * Executive presence, customer trust, resilience, intellectual honesty, and excellent communication skills. * B.A., B.S. degree or equivalent in a related field. * Experience with Fortune 500 or security\-sensitive organizations, cloud ecosystems, open\-source or consumption\-based products, or emerging categories is preferred.

jobs.title: Mid-Level Full-Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **GentleCloud™ Developer/Software Engineer** SkinCure Oncology (SCO) is a rapidly growing healthcare innovator transforming the treatment of non\-melanoma skin cancer with image\-guided superficial radiation therapy (IG\-SRT). As the leader in this space, we are passionate about making non\-invasive care accessible through our GentleCure solution delivered directly in dermatology practices across the country. At SCO, you will join a fast\-moving team where every role drives impact, supports patient\-centered care, and helps shape the future of skin cancer treatment. Come be a part of our mission to change lives! **The Role** The GentleCloud™ Developer will design, develop, test, and deploy full\-stack software supporting a cloud\-based clinical data platform. This role will work across a TypeScript/React front end, NestJS/Node.js back end, and MySQL databases, with responsibilities spanning requirements, implementation, verification, and deployment. Because the platform supports clinical workflows and patient data, this role requires a strong focus on accuracy, data integrity, traceability, security, and documentation. The GentleCloud™ Developer Developer will work closely with cross\-functional teammembers to ensure software changes are appropriately specified, tested, documented, and released in accordance with our IEC 62304\-aligned development practices. **What You Will Do** * Software Development: Design, develop, test, and deploy full\-stack features using TypeScript, React, NestJS/Node.js, and MySQL, following established coding, testing, and code review practices. * Database Integrity: Develop and maintain SQL queries and database functionality supporting clinical and approval workflows, with a strong focus on data integrity, auditability, security, and appropriate handling of patient data. * Cloud Infrastructure Development \& Deployment: Develop and support applications within the AWS environment, including EC2, S3, RDS (MySQL), CloudFront, SES, and IAM; assist with deployments and troubleshoot issues across development and production environments. * Quality \& Documentation: Create and maintain engineering documentation associated with software changes, including requirements, design documentation, verification records, and risk documentation, in accordance with IEC 62304\-aligned development practices. * Release Management: Follow established software development and release processes, including feature branching, code review, semantic versioning, tagged releases, and controlled promotion from development through production. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Partner with clinical, technical, and other stakeholders to understand workflow needs, define requirements, evaluate trade\-offs, and translate business and clinical needs into safe, well\-defined software solutions. **What You Will Bring** * 3–6 years of professional software development experience. * Strong professional experience with TypeScript across both front\-end and back\-end development. * Hands\-on experience with React, including hooks, component design, and client\-side routing; familiarity with modern build tools such as Vite and testing frameworks such as Vitest or Jest. * Experience developing back\-end applications with Node.js; experience with NestJS preferred, or comparable experience with frameworks such as Express or Fastify with the ability to ramp up quickly on NestJS. * Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, preferably MySQL, including basic schema design, query development, and performance considerations. * Experience with an ORM such as TypeORM is preferred. * Working experience with core AWS services, including EC2, S3, RDS, and IAM. * Understanding of authentication and authorization concepts, including JWT, session\-based authentication, and role\-based access controls. * Strong understanding of secure software development and appropriate handling of sensitive patient data. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability and willingness to clearly document technical work and decisions. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working in a healthcare, clinical, medical device, regulated, or other quality\-sensitive software environment, including familiarity with standards or frameworks such as IEC 62304, ISO 14971, or HIPAA. * Experience with C\#/.NET and WPF desktop application development. * Experience with Linux, nginx, scripted deployments, application log analysis, PDF generation, reporting pipelines, or transactional email services such as Amazon SES. **Additional Details** * Employment Type: Regular, full\-time * Salary Type: Salary, exempt * Pay Range: $120,000 \- $150,000 * Schedule: Day shift * Work Location: Remote with occasional US\-based travel **Why Join Our Team?** At SkinCure Oncology, your work has purpose. We offer competitive pay and a supportive work environment where you can grow and thrive. Join us in making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives. * Competitive compensation * Comprehensive benefit package including medical, dental and vision * Company paid disability and life insurance * 401(k) with company match * Generous PTO * Paid holidays **Equal Opportunity Employer** SkinCure Oncology is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, gender, disability, veteran, military status, religion, age, creed, national origin, sexual identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by local, state, or federal law. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please send a request to recruitment@skincureoncology.com. **Pay Transparency** Actual rate offered depends on a variety of factors including location and relevant skills, education, and experience. If an applicant’s experience is above or below the qualifications outlined in the posting, we reserve the right to make an offer at a different rate than listed in this job posting. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in alignment with our internal pay structure in all applicable regions. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) 4% Match * Dental insurance * Flexible spending account * Health insurance * Health savings account * Life insurance * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Vision insurance Experience: * Software development: 3 years (Required) * TypeScript: 1 year (Required) * React: 1 year (Required) * MySQL: 1 year (Preferred) * ORM: 1 year (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Austin, TX 73344

jobs.title: VP – Distinguished Engineer of Generative AI Engineering
jobs.description: **ABOUT SLATE** At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them. **WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR** As Distinguished Engineer of Generative AI, you are the founding technical authority for AI at Slate . You will help envision, design and ship the GenAI platform for Slate.Auto , write code, and make architectural decisions that carry long\-term consequence. The scope covers GenAI platforms, agentic systems, robot\-to\-model feedback loops, and embedded AI across the factory floor. You will partner with Vehicle Engineering, Manufacturing, and Quality to deploy AI where it produces measurable output. The role reports directly to the Chief Digital and Operations Officer and carries a seat on the senior technology leadership team. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Design and own the end\-to\-end GenAI platform: context layer, data layer, model serving, agent frameworks, and evaluation pipelines. Architecture decisions here must hold at enterprise scale, across multiple product lines, manufacturing sites, and a growing engineering organization. This means designing for reliability, cost efficiency, and extensibility from day one, not retrofitting those properties after the fact. * **Build Industry\-Leading AI Systems.** Design systems that practitioners at frontier AI labs would recognize as technically sound, applied to physical manufacturing: novel approaches to context management, agentic coordination across physical and digital systems, and model personalization on proprietary manufacturing data. * **Drive Physical AI Across the Vehicle Program.** Take AI beyond the laptop. Slate's vehicles are built in the real world, by real robots, on a factory floor that generates sensor data, failure modes, and edge cases that no benchmark captures. You will embed AI directly into manufacturing: robotic process control, computer vision for quality assurance, predictive maintenance systems, and closed\-loop feedback between physical production and model behavior. The goal is to dramatically improve to design and build a new vehicle. * **Build Slate's Proprietary Data and Context Layer.** Construct a knowledge base of agentic, human, robotic, and enterprise decisions that compounds over time. Build the unified Data Layer that trains purpose\-built models on real Slate decisions across the vehicle lifecycle. You are responsible for the architecture of both. * **Ship Agentic Systems Across the Company.** Deploy production\-grade AI agents across vehicle engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, software development, and GTM. These are not prototypes or proof\-of\-concepts: they are systems that run workflows that previously required humans, at a quality level that earns trust. You will establish evaluation frameworks, guardrail standards, and observability practices that make these systems auditable. * **Lead by Building.** Recruit and grow a lean team of GenAI engineers, MLOps engineers, and applied scientists. Stay in the code: review PRs, make architecture calls, and ship alongside the team. Your technical judgment sets the quality bar. * **Set the Engineering Standard.** Establish the technical standards, practices, and hiring bar for the GenAI organization. Contribute externally where appropriate: open\-source, publications, or conference talks. * **Hands\-on.** You have built GenAI systems from scratch in production and you still write code. You can point to specific systems you personally designed that are running at scale today. You are not afraid to directly interact with stakeholders to understand and develop requirements. * **An architect at scale.** You have designed enterprise\-level platforms that serve thousands of internal users, integrate with dozens of upstream and downstream systems, and hold up under operational stress. You know what breaks at scale before it breaks, because you have seen it break before. * **A Physical AI practitioner (preferred).** You have applied AI to physical systems: robotics, manufacturing, IoT, autonomous vehicles, or another domain where data is messy, latency constraints are real, and failure modes have physical consequences. * **GenAI native.** Deep hands\-on experience with LLMs, agent frameworks, RAG, and fine\-tuning. Strong opinions about what works in production, grounded in having shipped it. * **Technically credible at the architecture level.** You can translate a product requirement into a concrete system design with defensible tradeoffs, and operate effectively at the frontier of what is currently buildable. * **Comfortable in a resource\-constrained environment.** You build systems that perform above their weight, make pragmatic calls under uncertainty, and move fast without accumulating architectura  to safe online learning in environments where errors have physical consequences. * Robot\-to\-model feedback architectures: designing systems where robotic process data improves model performance and model outputs improve robotic process control. * Familiarity with physical simulation environments (Isaac Sim, MuJoCo, or similar) for model development and validation before factory deployment. * Sensor fusion and multimodal data handling for environments with structured sensor data, unstructured imaging, and natural language interfaces operating simultaneously. * Designing real\-time inference pipelines with hard latency constraints and failure consequences, including edge deployment architectures that operate under intermittent connectivity. * Data architecture for AI at scale: modern data stacks (Snowflake, Databricks, dbt), vector stores, and streaming data pipelines that handle both batch and real\-time model consumption. Cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, or Azure at the architecture level, including cost modeling, capacity planning, and the tradeoffs between managed AI services and self\-hosted infrastructure. * Designing and owning AI platforms that serve enterprise\-scale internal usage: thousands of concurrent users, dozens of integrated systems, and SLA requirements that real operations depend on. Multi\-tenant model serving architectures with cost isolation, quota management, and workload prioritization across competing internal consumers. Cloud infrastructure across AWS, GCP, or Azure at the architecture level, including cost modeling, capacity planning, and the tradeoffs between managed AI services and self\-hosted infrastructure. Security and compliance architecture for AI systems handling proprietary manufacturing IP, including data residency, access controls, and audit trails. Platform engineering practices that make GenAI accessible and reliable for internal teams who are not AI practitioners: SDKs, abstraction layers, and self\-service tooling. **SALARY RANGE** The compensation for this position is the range Slate reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position taking into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions, including job\-related knowledge; skillset; experience, education and training; certifications; work location; and other relevant business and organizational factors. Total Base Pay Range\- $222,431\.00 \- $370,719\.00 Additional Compensation and Benefits: Slate offers a wide range of competitive benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability insurance, vacation, and 401k. The successful candidate may also be eligible to participate in the equity program and/or a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing such programs. **WHY JOIN TEAM SLATE?** At Slate, we’re fueled by grit, determination, and attention to detail. The start\-up spirit of ingenuity and resourcefulness move our business forward. Team Slate fosters a culture of excellence, innovation, and mutual respect, and is motivated by shared principles. * Safety First * Delight Customers * One Team * Relentless Improvement * Fast, Frugal, and Scrappy * Respectful Collaboration * Positive Legacy **WE WANT TO WORK WITH PEOPLE THAT REFLECT THE COMMUNITIES IN WHICH WE OPERATE.** Slate is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, parental status, cultural background, organizational level, work styles, tenure and life experiences. Or for any other reason. Slate is committed to providing reasonable accommodation for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at **slate\-talent\_acquisition@slate.auto.**

jobs.title: Principal Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Job title \- Principal Full Stack Engineer** Employment type \- Full\-time employee (FTE) Work location \- 100% remote Travel \- Minimal \- occasional team and conference travel Base salary band $125,000 \- $185,000 (Band B5\) Target start date Before the end of October 2026 **About Slater Certified®** Slater Certified® is an AI\-powered workforce development platform for the water and wastewater sector. It delivers self\-paced training that prepares professionals for licensure and continuing education, built around G.A.I.L. (Generative Artificial Intelligence Learning) \- an interactive tutor that gives real\-time feedback, personalized explanations and adaptive support, so someone studying on demand still gets guidance. The flagship course is a 40\-hour Wastewater Class 3 Operator Training recognized by the Georgia Secretary of State, alongside a 24\-hour continuing education course and an industrial wastewater program. Organizations can run a customized version, Powered by Slater Certified®, against their own workforce. Slater Certified, LLC is the workforce development arm of Slater Infrastructure Group, LLC \- an Alpharetta, Georgia infrastructure services firm founded in 1997, working across operations and maintenance, construction engineering and inspection, and environmental services for public and private clients. Slater Certified launched in July 2025 and is licensed in Alabama, California, Florida, Georgia and Mississippi. The team is small and moves fast. Technology choices are modern and made by the people who have to live with them, so the distance between an idea and a decision is short, and the distance between a decision and shipping it is shorter. Work is remote and the schedule is flexible. Ownership sits with the person doing the work, and there is real room to shape how things get built rather than inheriting someone else's process. **Position summary** Slater Certified® runs a React front end and an Express back end on Vercel, with Firestore behind it and G.A.I.L., our generative AI tutor, at the center of the learning experience. The platform is live, it carries real learners against state\-approved curricula, and it is about to be asked to do considerably more than it was originally built for. This is a 100% hands\-on coding position. The person in this seat writes production code every day and builds the hardest parts of the platform personally. Architectural direction is set by the Chief Technology \& Business Officer; you are the senior engineering voice feeding into those decisions and the person who turns them into working software. It is a small team, so what you build reaches learners quickly and there is nowhere to hide. **What this role owns in the first 12 months** * Is shipping production code across the front end, API and data layer inside the first month, and keeps doing it for the life of the role. * Is the CTBO's working partner on architecture \- bringing options, trade\-offs and a recommendation rather than waiting to be told. * Sets the engineering standards that stick: testing, code review, what “done” means, and the release path from TEST to production. * Removes the top three scaling or reliability risks in the platform \- identified inside the first 60 days, closed by month twelve. * Raises the technical level of the team around them, measurably, in code review and in what others are able to ship unaided. * Is the person the CTBO can hand a hard technical problem to and not follow up on. **Key responsibilities** Hands\-on engineering \- 100% of this role * Write production code every day. This is not a role that stops coding, and it is not a step toward management. * Build the hardest parts of the platform personally. * Design and build the APIs and services the rest of the platform depends on. * Work across React, Express, Firestore and the Vercel deployment path. **Architecture and technical input** * Architectural direction is set by the CTBO. You are the senior engineering voice in those decisions. * Bring options, trade\-offs and a recommendation \- not just an implementation once the decision has been made. * Document how the platform actually fits together, and keep that picture current. * Weigh what ships this quarter against what the platform will need in two years. AI and the product * Build and extend the platform on top of G.A.I.L., our generative AI tutor. * Advise on where generative AI genuinely improves the learning product and where it does not. Engineering excellence * Set and hold coding standards, review practice and the definition of done. * Mentor engineers directly, in code review and in design. * Improve the release path so that deploying is routine rather than an event. * Support hiring \- interview, calibrate, and help build the team. Security, compliance and reliability * Build authentication and authorization correctly. * Build to FERPA expectations for learner data and to the standards our state approvals depend on. * Instrument the platform so failures surface before a learner reports them. **Must have** * 10\+ years building production software, several of them at principal, staff or equivalent technical\-lead level. * Has been accountable for the architecture of a production system, and lived with the consequences of those decisions. * Deep JavaScript and TypeScript, with real depth in React on the front end and Node / Express on the back end. * Production experience with a cloud\-hosted document database \- Firestore, MongoDB, DynamoDB or similar. * Has raised the technical level of a team through review, mentoring and standards, without formal authority to do it. * Has shipped production features built on generative AI APIs, with hands\-on experience using Claude. * Has been the most senior engineer in the room, and been right often enough that people stopped checking. * Wants a hands\-on coding role. This is not a route into engineering management. **Nice to have** * Experience with other generative AI APIs alongside Claude \- Gemini, OpenAI or similar. * Vercel, serverless or edge deployment experience. * EdTech, LMS, credentialing or regulated\-training background. * Infrastructure as code, and ownership of a CI/CD pipeline. * Accessibility standards (WCAG) applied in practice rather than in theory. **Compensation and benefits** Base salary band $125,000 \- $185,000, based on experience Variable compensation \- Eligible for participation in annual company bonus pool Health, dental, vision \- Employer provided / supplemented Retirement \- 401(k) \- up to 5% matched Paid time off \- Earned over time: generous and flexible policy **Work environment** **100% remote** Slater Certified® is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

jobs.title: AI Developer
jobs.description: **About the role** We are hiring our first dedicated AI developer. The purpose of this role is not to run experiments or produce proposals, but to design, build, and maintain working systems that our teams rely on every day. The scope is intentionally broad. Wherever a manual process, bottleneck, or repetitive decision could be handled faster and more consistently through automation or applied AI, that falls within your remit. Some of these opportunities will be apparent immediately. Many of them you will identify yourself. This position is well suited to a developer earlier in their career who is capable of more than their résumé currently reflects. You will not be maintaining an existing codebase or working through a ticket queue. You will be given substantive problems, direct access to the people affected by them, and considerable latitude in determining how to solve them. **Responsibilities** Your core responsibility is to identify where AI and automation create meaningful leverage within the business, build those systems, deploy them to real users, and keep them running reliably. Initial priorities will center on our CRM and case management systems: automating intake and data entry, generating case summaries and first\-draft correspondence, enabling natural\-language search across our records, and improving the integrations between systems that were not designed to work together. These represent the clearest near\-term opportunities we have identified. They are not the limit of the role. Depending on business needs and your particular strengths, the work may extend to: * Document and data pipelines, including extraction, classification, and validation at volume * Internal tools that make AI capabilities directly accessible to non\-technical staff * Reporting and analysis functions that currently require significant manual effort * Client\-facing automation, where accuracy standards and failure modes carry greater consequence * Evaluation and monitoring infrastructure to detect degradation in model output * Build\-versus\-buy assessments and vendor evaluation We will not be providing a fixed multi\-year roadmap. We would prefer that you help build one. **Qualifications** We weigh demonstrated ability more heavily than credentials. A computer science degree is not required, and we welcome applications from bootcamp graduates, self\-taught developers, and career changers. **Required** * Strong proficiency in Python or a comparable language, with the ability to write, debug, and structure production code * Working knowledge of APIs and system integration * Competence with SQL and relational data * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs such as OpenAI or Anthropic, including prompt design and handling non\-deterministic output * Sound judgment regarding when AI is the appropriate solution and when a simpler approach would serve better **Preferred** * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation, vector databases, or embeddings * Familiarity with a major CRM platform (Salesforce, HubSpot, Zoho, Dynamics) or case management software * Front\-end development skills sufficient to build internal tools * Experience with cloud deployment, containerization, or CI/CD * Exposure to handling regulated or confidential data **Attributes that matter as much as technical skill** * The ability to take an imprecisely defined problem from a non\-technical colleague, ask the right clarifying questions, and deliver a working solution * A bias toward deploying and iterating rather than extended pre\-launch refinement * Rigor in testing your own work before it reaches users * The willingness to say when an approach is flawed, including when the approach is ours You should also be comfortable operating as the only person in the organization performing this function. You will encounter unfamiliar problems without a senior engineer to escalate to. Some developers find this environment energizing; others do not. We would encourage you to assess honestly which applies to you before applying. **What we offer** * **Genuine ownership.** You will lead this function. The systems built here will be yours. * **Direct access.** No intermediate layers between you and the people whose work you are improving, or the decision\-maker who approves your proposals. * **A demonstrable portfolio.** Production systems you designed end to end, with measurable results attached — a meaningful asset for the remainder of your career. We recognize that this compensation range sits below what an experienced AI engineer commands. The role is structured accordingly: we are offering scope, autonomy, and accelerated growth to a developer at the stage of their career where that exchange is worthwhile, with the expectation that compensation will follow demonstrated results. **This role may not be a good fit if** * You require detailed specifications before beginning work * You prefer extended research over delivering a functional first version * You wish to work exclusively on model development without involvement in integration, data quality, or user support These are not deficiencies, but they are poorly matched to this position, and identifying that early serves both parties. Pay: $19\.00 \- $24\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Applic/Solutions Architect II
jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY:** This position is responsible for defining future\-state architecture, technology standards, governance practices, and strategic roadmaps for Digital Workplace Technology service areas. This role provides technical leadership across endpoint management, digital employee experience, device lifecycle management, software delivery, automation, workplace security technologies, and enterprise workplace modernization. The role serves as a strategic technical leader, driving modernization efforts, architecture governance, technology innovation, and alignment while ensuring solutions remain secure, scalable, resilient, supportable, and aligned with Southern Company business objectives. Responsibilities include: * Defines and maintains the Digital Workplace Technologies architecture vision, technology standards, governance model, and multi\-year strategic roadmap. * Designs and guides secure, scalable workplace technology solutions across endpoint management, device lifecycle, software delivery, automation, digital employee experience platforms, vulnerability management, and workplace security technologies. * Partners with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Engineering, Support, vendors, and business stakeholders to design secure, scalable, resilient, and supportable workplace technology solutions. * Leads workplace modernization and transformation efforts involving cloud\-first endpoint management, AI\-enabled operations, workforce analytics, predictive remediation, automation, and self\-healing technologies. * Evaluates emerging technologies and develops strategic adoption plans that improve employee productivity, operational efficiency, security posture, and user experience. * Provides technical leadership, consultative guidance, architecture recommendations, risk input, and roadmap direction for complex workplace technology initiatives, escalations, and cross\-functional projects. The architect level will depend on the candidate’s skills, experience, and demonstrated ability to perform the responsibilities of the role. **JOB REQUIREMENTS:** *Technical Skills Required* * Expert\-level experience with Intune, MECM, Microsoft 365, Windows management, and related endpoint technologies in enterprise\-scale environments. * Knowledgeable in current and emerging relevant industry related products and trends. * Advanced experience developing strategic technology roadmaps, future\-state architecture plans, reference architectures, design standards, engineering patterns, governance frameworks, and technology blueprints. * Advanced experience with Digital Employee Experience platforms, automation technologies, endpoint analytics, predictive remediation, self\-healing capabilities, and AI\-enabled operations solutions. * Strong understanding of vulnerability management, security compliance, endpoint security, zero\-trust security principles, resiliency planning, and technology lifecycle management. * Demonstrated ability to influence strategic technical decisions, lead architecture governance activities, facilitate design reviews, and provide risk\-based recommendations for high\-visibility initiatives. * Programming and scripting skills, preferably with PowerShell, APIs, WMI, and orchestration platforms, to automate remediation, configuration management, reporting, and operational recovery. * Excellent diagnostic, troubleshooting, analytical, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to resolve complex enterprise technology issues. *Non\-Technical Skills Required* * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including technical writing and the ability to communicate complex technical concepts, risks, decisions, and roadmaps to non\-technical, technical, and executive audiences. * Works effectively in a team environment, including geographically dispersed technical, security, infrastructure, vendor, architecture, and business teams. * High degree of focus on quality, reliability, efficiency, risk reduction, governance, strategic alignment, and measurable business and operational outcomes. * Thrives in a fast\-paced environment, adapts to changing priorities, operates with minimal supervision, and provides leadership through ambiguity. * Self\-motivated, takes initiative, drives issues to resolution, removes obstacles, and influences others to deliver results across teams. * Ability to assess impact, quantify risk, evaluate alternatives, and make sound architecture decisions in complex, high\-visibility situations. * Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail. * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple responsibilities. Travel as needed. *Education and Experience Requirements* * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field required. Advanced degree preferred. * 10\+ years of Information Technology experience, including 5\+ years of technical leadership, enterprise solution design, architecture planning, or strategic tech dentifies, assesses, and manages technical debt, platform rationalization opportunities, modernization initiatives, architectural risks, and strategic investment needs. * Technology Modernization \& Innovation: Leads initiatives involving AI\-enabled operations, workforce analytics, predictive remediation, automation, self\-healing technologies, cloud management, and autonomous endpoint management capabilities. * Evaluates emerging technologies and develops strategic recommendations supporting business objectives, operational excellence, security improvement, employee productivity, and user experience. * Leads proof\-of\-concept activities, technology assessments, vendor evaluations, architecture comparisons, adoption strategies, and implementation recommendations. * Strategic Leadership: Provides technical leadership and mentorship to engineers, analysts, project teams, and technical stakeholders; collaborates with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Application, vendor, and business teams; establishes platform health indicators and metrics used to measure reliability, security, performance, lifecycle readiness, and employee experience outcomes. * Collaborates with Enterprise Architecture, Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, and Application teams to ensure alignment across technology domains. * Engage vendors for POC/POV as needed to determine the applicability of emerging technologies within the Southern Enterprise. * Develops capacity, performance, resiliency, and lifecycle strategies for workplace technology platforms. * Establishes architecture metrics and health indicators used to measure platform effectiveness and employee experience outcomes. **About Southern Company** Southern Company (NYSE: SO ) is a leading energy provider serving 9 million customers across the Southeast and beyond through its family of companies. Providing clean, safe, reliable and affordable energy with excellent service is our mission. The company has electric operating companies in three states, natural gas distribution companies in four states, a competitive generation company, a leading distributed energy solutions provider with national capabilities, a fiber optics network and telecommunications services. Through an industry\-leading commitment to innovation, resilience and sustainability, we are taking action to meet customers' and communities' needs while advancing our goal of net\-zero greenhouse gas emissions by 2050\. Our uncompromising values ensure we put the needs of those we serve at the center of everything we do and are the key to our sustained success. We are transforming energy into economic, environmental and social progress for tomorrow. Our corporate culture has been recognized by a variety of organizations, earning the company awards and recognitions that reflect Our Values and dedication to service. To learn more, visit www.southerncompany.com . Southern Company invests in the well\-being of its employees and their families through a comprehensive total rewards strategy that includes competitive base salary, annual incentive awards for eligible employees and health, welfare and retirement benefits designed to support physical, financial, and emotional/social well\-being. This position may also be eligible for additional compensation, such as an incentive program, with the amount of any bonus/awards subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable incentive plan(s). A summary of the benefits offered for this position can be found here https://seo.nlx.org/southernco/pdf/SOCO\-Benefits.pdf . Additional and specific details about total compensation and beneﬁts will also be provided during the hiring process. Southern Company is an equal opportunity employer where an applicant's qualifications are considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other basis prohibited by law.

jobs.description: **Position Title**: IT Systems Engineer I **FLSA Status**: Exempt (17E) **Reports to**: IT Infrastructure Services Manager **Location:** Tyler Technology Center Tyler, TX or White Settlement, Fort Worth, TX **Benefits:** * Medical, Prescription Drugs, Dental, and Vision Insurance * Insurance Eligibility for Team Members and Dependents Starting on the First Day of Employment * 401(k) with a Match * Basic, Voluntary, and Dependent Life Insurance * Paid Time Off * Paid Bank Holidays * Workplace Wellness Programs * Employee Assistance Programs * Tuition Reimbursement **Job Summary**: Support systems infrastructure by maintaining system configuration, performing system installation, and enforcing system standards. Administration of physical and virtualized systems: System support, troubleshooting system, application, network and client operating system security, vulnerability remediation, network and system performance optimization, client machine imaging and lifecycle, system monitoring and high availability, automation, and other client and server tasks. Maintain quality documentation for compliance, configuration, inventory, disaster recovery, and security purposes. Contribute to and lead enterprise technology related implementations and projects. Have and maintain a high level of professional ethics. **Essential Functions**: * Operation of controls on a timely basis and drive continuous process improvement at all levels. * Documents policies, operating standards and procedures for IT processes identified or specified. * Secures physical and virtual clients/servers by following and enforcing policies, verifying and monitoring access. * Assists in set up, configuration, and supports internal and external systems and network and client operating systems as appropriate. * Maintains all systems, infrastructure applications, security, and network and client operating systems configurations. * Troubleshoots system performance issues, develops and implements technical solutions related to infrastructure applications, software and other corporate systems. * Ensures issues are tracked and resolved in a timely fashion. * Provides support during business and non\-business hours. * Maintains a thorough knowledge of industry concepts, practices, and procedures. * Manages the performance of multiple hardware and software platforms. * Provides Level 2 data and/or telecommunication support for team members and end\-users and appropriately communicates the actions to resolve issues; contacts the appropriate vendor for service when a problem cannot be resolved. * Maintains documentation for the systems, infrastructure applications, security, network and client operating system design, layout, and connectivity. * Maximizes systems performance by monitoring performance, troubleshooting network problems and outages, scheduling upgrades and collaborating with team on network optimization. * Maintains information technology operational information, system utilization logs, policies, procedures, standards and other department documentation as appropriate. * Communicates effectively with other members of the department; participates in department meetings, projects, and functions; suggests methods for improvement of departmental procedures * Follows change management requests procedures for all changes in production infrastructure. * Maintains confidentiality of all sensitive Bank information. * Maintains a positive and caring atmosphere for customers and employees consistent with Southside Bank’s mission, CORE Values, and Blue Book culture guide. * Provides enthusiastic, professional, and courteous service to Southside Bank customers and employees. * Participates in proactive team efforts to achieve departmental and company goals. * Understands and agrees to abide by the policies and procedures established at Southside Bank. * Responsible for complying with audit policies and procedures as they pertain to this position. * Performs duties in compliance with applicable laws and regulations, including but not limited to the Bank Secrecy Act (BSA) and related anti\-money laundering laws, and in accordance with the Bank’s Information Security Program. * Must comply with all applicable laws and regulations. **Additional Functions:** * Participates in special projects as assigned. * Complies with all safety policies, practices, and procedures. Report all unsafe activities to supervisor and/or Human Resources. * Performs additional duties, as assigned or directed. **Required Education/Experience**: * Associate’s degree in computer or business\-related field or equivalent education or experience. * Minimum one (1\) year in systems infrastructure field with medium enterprise base preferred. * Minimum one (1\) year Microsoft Windows Server and Desktop experience required, , additional VmWare experience preferred. * Microsoft, Linux, or VmWare Certification is highly preferred. * Experience with Microsoft SCCM, Intune, M365, Entra ID required. * Experience with DNS, DHCP, network backup and recovery, multi\-function printers, inventory, anti\-virus, lifecycle management, and scripting. * Understanding of Microsoft and VmWare concepts. * Extensive hands\-on experience with designing, implementing, patching, and configuring client/server automation, imaging, files and print servers. **Necessary Skills**: * Able to manage multiple assignments/projects. * Strong technical, analytical, and critical thinking skills. * Self\-motivated, dependable, analytical and a problem solver. * Excellent oral and written communication skills. * Handles complex problems, maintaining continuity of normal workflow, ensuring compliance with department, company and regulatory standards and regulations, solving new or unfamiliar problems. * Communicates problems and unusual situations, orally and/or in a written format, to upper management in a timely manner. * Operate in a team\-oriented infrastructure and maintain effective communication. **Physical Activity/Dexterity:** * Manual dexterity sufficient to reach/handle items and work with fingers. Works with fingers and perceives attributes of objects and materials. * Ability to occasionally lift boxes and equipment of up to 20 pounds. **Physical Environment Demands:** * Must be able to remain in a stationary position 90% of the time. * The person in this position needs to occasionally move about inside the office to visit other offices, conference rooms, office machinery, etc. * Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and telephone. * Constantly positions self to operate on a computer. * The person in this position frequently communicates with other people throughout each day. Must be able to exchange accurate information when conversing. **Working Conditions/Infrastructure:** * Well\-lighted, heated and/or air\-conditioned indoor office setting with adequate ventilation. * Moderate noise (e.g. business office with computers and printers, light traffic). **Work Schedule/Hours:** * Monday through Friday; 8:00am – 5:00pm. * Available for overtime, as needed. **Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities** The contractor will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information. 41 CFR 60\-1\.35(c)

jobs.title: Senior Software Developer
jobs.description: **ABOUT US** SPARK Business Works is a great team, with thriving clients, which results in proud moments. We are a fun, collaborative team that provides custom software development, web development, and digital marketing services for organizations across the country. You’ll find SPARK Ignitors hard at work, full of energy and ready to solve the toughest challenges for our clients. We celebrate creative problem solving and encourage you to invest in yourself and your talents. Our team was recently named to the “Best and Brightest Companies to Work For” and “Inc 5000 Fastest\-Growing Private Companies” for our ability to help clients digitize and grow with innovative and practical digital solutions. SPARK is headquartered in Michigan (Kalamazoo \& Grand Rapids) with additional offices in Houston, Texas, Bloomington, Illinois, and India. SPARK’s team has served over 400 clients across many industries, including construction, manufacturing, healthcare, and agriculture, to name a few. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** As a Senior Software Developer, you’ll create, maintain, and support the entire functions of projects for our amazing clients. In this role, you’ll be working with a variety of languages, frameworks, and databases, primarily Advanced Javascript, Typescript, PHP, SQL, HTML/CSS, .NET/VB/ASP, and REST APIs technologies. On any given day you might be architecting new features for our clients, refactoring existing code to be more scalable, on\-site with a client to understand their business, guiding other developers and seeing changes through to completion in a live environment. You will work in a collaborative team environment with product managers, other developers, systems analysts, and designers throughout the entire project lifecycle to execute and launch applications for clients. You will be a valued contributor on the software development team. Some travel may occasionally be required to meet with clients and project teams. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES*** Embrace and deliver our BOLT Core Values to each other and our clients * + **B**e empathetic and inclusive + **O**verdeliver + **L**ove what you do + **T**ake ownership and follow through * Participate in the entire application lifecycle, with a focus on solution architecture, implementation, documentation, delivery, and support. * Write clean, maintainable, and testable code to develop functional web applications. * Write unit and integration tests. * Troubleshoot and debug applications. * Ensure optimal application performance \& scaling. * Leverage cutting\-edge technologies to improve legacy applications. * Gather and address technical and design requirements, translating them into clear specifications and tasks for yourself and others. * Provide training and support to internal teams. * Build reusable code and libraries for future use. * Act as a technical resource and guide for cross\-functional teams, including developers, designers, and product managers, to identify and define new features. * Implementation of DevSecOps environment and initiatives. * Provide feedback around the DevSecOps environment and initiatives. * Provide technical direction based on emerging technology exploration. * Guide less experienced developers, fostering their technical growth and confidence, by occasionally onboarding, mentoring, training, and pair\-programming. * Occasionally, research and evaluate new integrations, tools, and libraries to enhance the project or development environment. * Conduct critical code reviews and provide feedback that encourages best practices and improved implementation strategies. * Contribute to documentation efforts for use by the team and/or clients to promote a shared understanding of the codebase, development processes, and application workflow. **WHAT YOU NEED*** 7\+ years of relevant experience (preferably a combination of education and professional) * Confidence and experience using high\-level or object\-oriented programming languages and technologies like PHP, Advanced JavaScript, TypeScript, Node.js, HTML5, and CSS3\. * Familiarity with DevSecOps or Cloud Platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Strong work ethic and willingness to “go above and beyond”, bringing a passionate and positive approach to delivering results and encouraging teamwork. * Ability to write and detail implementation specs or user stories that support effective development and execution. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to convey complex technical information clearly. * Experience in business strategy and solutions. * Knowledge of software, web development, databases (relational and experience), mobile development, and technology solutions. * Ability to communicate with web developers and designers. * Large capacity for attention to detail. * Ability to meet tight deadlines. * Capable of prioritizing multiple projects in order to meet goals without management oversight. * Comfortable with Git version control. * Ability to optimize database queries. * Ability to refactor and optimize existing code. * Comfortable using the Linux terminal. * Familiar with Docker in a local development environment. * Understanding of accessibility and server security standards and compliance. * Exceptional debugging skills. **NICE TO HAVE*** A solid understanding of or strong desire to learn the following and other programming languages: Python, .NET, C\#, Java, etc. * Comfortable with writing automated unit and integration tests. * Familiar with building and compiling public assets like CSS and JS with tools like SASS and Webpack or Rollup. * Previous experience working with multiple platforms (Desktop, Mobile, Tablet, etc.) * Experience managing multiple tasks/projects in an agency environment. * Ability to lead inside sales with the best interest of the client. * Ability to work with leadership to align on sales and marketing strategies and solutions. **BENEFITS*** Medical Insurance * Dental Insurance * Vision Insurance * 401(k) * $50,000 Company\-Paid Basic Life Insurance * Short \& Long Term Disability Provided by Company * Flexible PTO (Paid Time Off) * Annual Learning \& Development Fund * Strong Emphasis on Work\-Life Balance * Flexible Work Arrangements \- Please Note, this is a Hybrid Role. The Selected Candidate is Expected to be In Office at Least 2 Days Per Week **SALARY RANGE** $70,000 \- $80,000 annually SPARK Business Works is an equal opportunity employer and celebrates diversity, equity, and inclusion. **Know someone at SPARK?** Be sure to submit them as a referral.
